title.zh: 卷4 本紀四 世祖本紀一
title.raw: 卷4 本紀四 世祖本紀一

sentences.zh: 世祖體天隆運定統建極英睿欽文顯武大德弘功至仁純孝章皇帝，諱福臨，太宗第九子。

translations.literal: Shizu, [with the honorific] Embodying Heaven, Elevating Fortune, Fixing the Succession, Establishing the Pole, Sagacious and Brilliant, Revering Culture and Displaying Martial Prowess, Great Virtue, Grand Achievement, Supreme Benevolence, Pure Filiality, August Emperor—taboo name Fulin, ninth son of Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu, the Shunzhi Emperor—full posthumous title: Embodying Heaven, Elevating Fortune, Fixing the Succession, Establishing the Pole, Sagacious and Brilliant, Revering Culture and Displaying Martial Prowess, Great Virtue, Grand Achievement, Supreme Benevolence, Pure Filiality, August Emperor—was named Fulin, the ninth son of Taizong (Hong Taiji).

sentences.zh: 母孝莊文皇后方娠，紅光繞身，盤旋如龍形。

translations.literal: When his mother Empress Xiaozhuangwen was pregnant, red light encircled her body, coiling and turning like a dragon's form.
translations.idiomatic: While his mother, Empress Xiaozhuangwen, was still pregnant, a red radiance wound about her body, spiraling like a dragon.

sentences.zh: 誕之前夕，夢神人抱子納-{后}-懷曰：「此統一天下之主也。

translations.literal: On the eve of his birth, [she] dreamed a divine man bore a child and placed him in the empress's bosom, saying: "This is the lord who will unite all under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: On the night before his birth she dreamed that a godlike figure brought a child to her breast, saying, "This is he who will unite the realm."

sentences.zh: 」寤，以語太宗。

translations.literal: " Awakening, she told Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: When she woke, she told Taizong.

sentences.zh: 太宗喜甚，曰：「奇祥也，生子必建大業。

translations.literal: Taizong was greatly pleased and said: "A wondrous omen; the son born will surely establish a great enterprise."
translations.idiomatic: Taizong was overjoyed. "A miraculous sign," he said. "The child born of this will surely found a great undertaking."

sentences.zh: 」翌日上生，紅光燭宮中，香氣經日不散。

translations.literal: " The next day the Emperor was born; red light illuminated the palace; fragrance lingered a full day without dispersing.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the emperor was born. Red light filled the palace, and a sweet scent hung in the air for a whole day.

sentences.zh: 上生有異稟，頂髮聳起，龍章鳳姿，神智天授。

translations.literal: From birth the Emperor had an unusual endowment: the hair on his crown stood erect; dragon markings and phoenix bearing; divine intelligence heaven-bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: From birth he showed an uncommon nature: the hair on his crown stood up; his bearing was that of dragon and phoenix; his wit seemed heaven-sent.

sentences.zh: 八年秋八月庚午，太宗崩，儲嗣未定。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, autumn, eighth month, day gengwu, Taizong died; the heir was not yet fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on the gengwu day of the eighth month of autumn, Taizong died, and the succession remained unsettled.

sentences.zh: 和碩禮親王代善會諸王、貝勒、貝子、文武群臣定議，奉上嗣大位，誓告天地，以和碩鄭親王濟爾哈朗、和碩睿親王多爾袞輔政。

translations.literal: Prince of the First Rank of Li Daishan convened the princes, beiles, beises, and civil and military officials to settle the matter; they elevated the Emperor to succeed the great throne, swore oath to Heaven and Earth, and appointed Prince of the First Rank of Zheng Jirhalang and Prince of the First Rank of Rui Dorgon to assist in government.
translations.idiomatic: Daishan, Prince of Li, assembled the princes, beiles, beises, and the civil and military bureaucracy. They raised the boy to the great throne, swore the oath before Heaven and Earth, and named Jirhalang, Prince of Zheng, and Dorgon, Prince of Rui, as regents.

sentences.zh: 丙子，阿濟格尼堪等率師防錦州。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Ajige, Nikan, and others led troops to defend Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Ajige, Nikan, and others took the field to hold Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，多羅郡王阿達禮、固山貝子碩託謀立和碩睿親王多爾袞。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Duoluo Junwang Adai and Gushan Beizi Shuotuo plotted to install Prince of the First Rank of Rui Dorgon [as emperor].
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Adai, Prince of Duoluo, and Shuotuo, beizi of the gushan, conspired to set Dorgon, Prince of Rui, on the throne.

sentences.zh: 禮親王代善與多爾袞發其謀。

translations.literal: Prince of Li Daishan and Dorgon exposed their plot.
translations.idiomatic: Daishan, Prince of Li, and Dorgon brought the plot to light.

sentences.zh: 阿達禮、碩託伏誅。

translations.literal: Adai and Shuotuo were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Adai and Shuotuo were put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，諸王、貝勒、貝子、群臣以上嗣位期祭告太宗。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: princes, beiles, beises, and officials performed sacrificial rites reporting to Taizong the date of the Emperor's succession.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the princes, beiles, beises, and ministers offered sacrifice to inform Taizong of the day the emperor would succeed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以即位期祭告郊廟。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: performed sacrificial rites at the suburban altars and temples for the accession date.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu they reported the enthronement to the suburban altars and the dynastic temples.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上即皇帝位於篤恭殿。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Emperor ascended the throne at Dugong Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor took the throne in the Hall of Sincere Reverence.

sentences.zh: 詔以明年為，肆赦常所不原者。

translations.literal: An edict declared the next year as [reign title missing in text], and granted amnesty to those not usually pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named the coming year as the first of the new reign—here the Draft History omits the era name Shunzhi—and proclaimed a general amnesty, including crimes normally excluded from pardon.

sentences.zh: 頒哀詔於朝鮮、蒙古。

translations.literal: Mourning edicts were promulgated in Korea and Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts of mourning were sent to Korea and Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，地震，自西北而南有聲。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinchou: earthquake; from northwest toward south there was a sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou, the earth quaked; a rumble rolled from the northwest toward the south.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，濟爾哈朗、阿濟格征明，攻寧遠衛。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Jirhalang and Ajige campaigned against Ming, attacking Ningyuan Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Jirhalang and Ajige marched against the Ming and laid siege to Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，頒即位詔於朝鮮、蒙古。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the accession edict was promulgated in Korea and Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the enthronement edict was issued to Korea and Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 以太宗遺詔減朝鮮歲貢。

translations.literal: By Taizong's testamentary edict, Korea's annual tribute was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In accordance with Taizong's deathbed edict, Korea's yearly tribute was cut.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，昭陵成。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhaoling was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Zhaoling mausoleum was finished.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大軍攻明中後所，丁巳拔之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the grand army attacked Ming's Zhonghousuo; day dingsi captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the main force struck the Ming fortress of Zhonghousuo; on dingsi it fell.

sentences.zh: 庚申，攻前屯衛。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: attacked Qiantun Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen they assaulted Qiantun.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉朔，克之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day xinyou: captured it.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the first day of the tenth month, xinyou, the place was taken.

sentences.zh: 阿濟格尼堪等率師至中前所，明總兵官黃色棄城遁。

translations.literal: Ajige, Nikan, and others led troops to Zhongqiansuo; Ming regional commander Huang Se abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Ajige, Nikan, and others advanced on Zhongqiansuo. Huang Se, the Ming regional commander, deserted the city and ran.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，濟爾哈朗、阿濟格師還。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Jirhalang and Ajige's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the armies of Jirhalang and Ajige came home.

sentences.zh: 壬午，篇古、博和託、伊拜、杜雷代戍錦州。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Pangu, Bohetho, Yibai, and Dulei relieved the garrison at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Pangu, Bohetho, Yibai, and Dulei took over the Jinzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，明守備孫友白自寧遠來降。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renxu: Ming garrison commander Sun Youbai came from Ningyuan to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renxu, the Ming officer Sun Youbai surrendered from Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，朝鮮來賀即位。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Korea came to congratulate the accession.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei envoys from Korea arrived to felicitate the new reign.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，罷諸王、貝勒、貝子管部院事。

translations.literal: Day yihai: abolished princes', beiles', and beises' management of ministry and court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the princes, beiles, and beises were stripped of their oversight of the ministries.

sentences.zh: 鄂羅塞臣、巴都禮率師征黑龍江。

translations.literal: Orosangchen and Baduli led troops to campaign in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Orosangchen and Baduli marched into the Heilongjiang region.

sentences.zh: 壬午，譚泰、准塔代戍錦州。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Tantai and Zhuntata relieved the garrison at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Tantai and Zhuntata replaced the Jinzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮暨土默特部章京古祿格，庫爾喀部賴達庫及炎楮庫牙喇氏二十六戶，索倫部章京崇內，喀爾喀部土謝圖汗、馬哈撒嘛諦塞臣汗、查薩克圖汗，圖白忒部甸齊喇嘛俱來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea; Tümed janggin Guluge; Khalkha's Laidaku and twenty-six households of the Yanzhukuyala clan; Solon janggin Chongnei; Khalkha's Tusheet Khan, Mahasamadi Setsen Khan, and Zhasakt Khan; and Tibet's Diqi lama all came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute arrived from Korea; Guluge, janggin of the Tümed; Laidaku of the Khalkha and twenty-six households of the Yanzhukuyala; Chongnei, janggin of the Solon; the Tusheet, Setsen, and Zhasakt khans of the Khalkha; and the Diqi lama of Tibet.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，艾度禮戍錦州。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi: Aidume garrisoned Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi, Aidume took up the Jinzhou post.

sentences.zh: 戊子，祔葬太妃博爾濟錦氏於福陵，改葬妃富察氏於陵外。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: secondary burial of Great Consort Borjijin at Fuling; reburial of Consort Fuca outside the mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the late Grand Consort Borjijin was enshrined at Fuling, and Consort Fuca was reinterred outside the tomb precinct.

sentences.zh: 富察氏，太祖時以罪賜死者。

translations.literal: Fuca, in Taizu's time, was given death as punishment for a crime.
translations.idiomatic: Fuca had been condemned to death for an offense in the days of Taizu (Nurhaci).

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，地震。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingshen, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復震。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: earthquake again.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu it shook again.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大學士希福等進刪譯遼、金、元史。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Grand Secretaries Xifu and others presented abridged translations of the Liao, Jin, and Yuan histories.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the grand secretaries led by Xifu submitted abridged Manchu renderings of the Liao, Jin, and Yuan histories.

sentences.zh: 是月，流賊李自成陷燕京，明帝自經。

translations.literal: That month, the bandit Li Zicheng took Yanjing; the Ming emperor hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Li Zicheng's rebels seized Beijing. The Ming emperor died by his own hand.

sentences.zh: 自成僭稱帝，國號大順，改元永昌。

translations.literal: Zicheng presumptuously declared himself emperor; state name Great Shun; era name Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng declared himself emperor of the Great Shun and adopted the era name Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午朔，固山額真何洛會等訐告肅親王豪格悖妄罪，廢豪格為庶人，其黨俄莫克圖等皆論死。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day wuwu: banner chief He Luohui and others impeached Prince Su Haoge for insolent and arrogant crimes; Haoge was degraded to commoner; his partisans including Emoketu were all sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the wuwu day—the first of the fourth month—He Luohui and other banner chiefs accused Prince Su, Haoge, of arrogance and lèse-majesté. Haoge was reduced to commoner status; his followers, among them Emoketu, were condemned to die.

sentences.zh: 己未，晉封多羅饒餘貝勒阿巴泰為多羅饒餘郡王。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: promoted Duoluo Raoyu Beile Abatai to Duoluo Raoyu Junwang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Abatai, beile of Duoluo Raoyu, was raised to junwang of the same title.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大學士范文程啟睿親王入定中原。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Grand Secretary Fan Wencheng memorialized the Prince of Rui to enter and settle the Central Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Grand Secretary Fan Wencheng urged Dorgon, Prince of Rui, to march in and master the Central Plain.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以大軍南伐祭告太祖、太宗。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: for the great army's southern campaign, performed sacrifice and reported to Taizu and Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, before the great southern expedition, rites were offered to notify Taizu and Taizong.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上御篤恭殿，命和碩睿親王多爾袞為奉命大將軍，賜敕印便宜行事，並賜王及從征諸王、貝勒、貝子等服物有差。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Emperor presided at Dugong Hall, appointed Prince of the First Rank of Rui Dorgon as Grand General on Commission, granted sealed patent and discretionary authority, and bestowed robes and gear in varying measure on the prince and the princes, beiles, beises, and others accompanying the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, from the Hall of Sincere Reverence, the emperor named Dorgon, Prince of Rui, Grand General on Imperial Commission, gave him the seal and full discretion in the field, and issued arms and vestments in due rank to the princes, beiles, beises, and officers who marched with him.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，師行。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the army marched.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the host set out.

sentences.zh: 壬申，睿親王多爾袞師次翁後，明山海關守將吳三桂遣使致書，乞師討賊。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Prince of Rui Dorgon's army halted at Weng hou; Ming Shanhaiguan garrison commander Wu Sangui sent envoys with a letter begging troops to suppress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Dorgon's column camped at Weng hou. Wu Sangui, Ming commander at Shanhaiguan, sent envoys with a plea for soldiers to crush the rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，師次連山，三桂復致書告急，大軍疾馳赴之。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the army halted at Lianshan; Sangui again sent a letter in urgent alarm; the grand army galloped to his aid.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou they halted at Lianshan. Sangui wrote again in desperate haste, and the main force spurred forward to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，李自成率眾圍山海關，我軍逆擊之，敗賊將唐通於一片石。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Li Zicheng led masses besieging Shanhaiguan; our army met and struck them, defeating the bandit general Tang Tong at Yipianshi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Zicheng brought a host against Shanhaiguan. Our vanguard met them and broke the rebel general Tang Tong at Yipianshi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，師至山海關，三桂開關出迎，大軍入關。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the army reached Shanhaiguan; Sangui opened the pass to welcome them; the grand army entered the pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the army came to the pass. Sangui opened the gates in welcome, and the main force crossed into China proper.

sentences.zh: 自成率眾二十餘萬，自北山橫亙至海，嚴陣以待。

translations.literal: Zicheng led more than two hundred thousand men, stretching from the northern hills across to the sea, in tight formation awaiting battle.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng drew up more than two hundred thousand men in a battle line that ran from the northern hills to the shore.

sentences.zh: 是日，大風，塵沙蔽天。

translations.literal: That day, great wind; dust and sand obscured the sky.
translations.idiomatic: That day a gale rose; dust blotted out the sky.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞命擊賊陣尾，以三桂居右翼，大呼薄之。

translations.literal: Prince of Rui Dorgon ordered attack on the bandit rear; placed Sangui on the right wing; shouted orders to press close.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon, Prince of Rui, struck at the rebel rear, set Sangui on the right wing, and drove the line forward with a great shout.

sentences.zh: 風旋定，賊兵大潰，追奔四十餘里，自成遁還燕京。

translations.literal: The wind whirled and stilled; the bandit army collapsed utterly; pursued the rout more than forty li; Zicheng fled back to Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: The wind swung round and fell. The rebel host shattered. Our men chased them more than forty li, and Zicheng fled back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 封三桂為平西王，以馬步軍一萬隸之，直趨燕京。

translations.literal: Sangui was enfeoffed as Prince Who Pacifies the West; ten thousand horse and foot were placed under him; [the army] pressed straight toward Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Sangui was made Prince Who Pacifies the West and given ten thousand horse and foot. The army drove straight on the capital.

sentences.zh: 誓諸將勿殺不辜，掠財物，焚廬舍，不如約者罪之。

translations.literal: Oath to the generals: do not kill the innocent, plunder goods, or burn dwellings—those not keeping the covenant would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: The generals were sworn: no killing of the guiltless, no looting, no burning of homes—whoever broke faith would answer for it.

sentences.zh: 諭官民以取殘不殺之意，民大悅，竄匿山谷者爭還鄉里迎降。

translations.literal: Proclaimed to officials and people the meaning of conquering the ruthless yet not slaughtering; the people greatly rejoiced; those hiding in valleys vied to return home and welcome surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The proclamation explained that the conquerors would spare the people. Joy spread; men and women who had fled to the hills hurried home to submit.

sentences.zh: 大軍所過州縣及沿邊將吏皆開門款附。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties the grand army passed through, and frontier garrison officers, all opened their gates in sincere submission.
translations.idiomatic: Every district the army crossed, and every border post along the way, opened its gates in welcome.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，自成棄燕京西走，我軍疾追之。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Zicheng abandoned Yanjing and fled west; our army pursued hotly.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zicheng quit Beijing and fled west. Our forces pressed hard on his heels.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子朔，以捷書宣示朝鮮、蒙古。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day wuzi: the victory bulletin was announced to Korea and Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuzi—the first of the month—the news of victory was sent to Korea and Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大軍抵燕京，故明文武諸臣士庶郊迎五里外。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the grand army reached Yanjing; former Ming civil and military officials and commoners welcomed them from five li outside the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the army entered Beijing. Ming officials, soldiers, and townspeople came out five li beyond the walls to receive them.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞入居武英殿。

translations.literal: Prince of Rui Dorgon took residence in the Wuying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon, Prince of Rui, established himself in the Hall of Martial Glory.

sentences.zh: 令諸將士乘城，廝養人等毋入民家，百姓安堵如故。

translations.literal: Ordered officers and soldiers to man the walls; servants and camp followers must not enter civilian homes—the populace remained secure as before.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were posted on the walls; orderlies and camp followers were forbidden to enter private houses. The city kept its peace.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，令兵部傳檄直省郡縣，歸順者官吏進秩，軍民免遷徙，文武大吏籍戶口錢糧兵馬親賚至京，觀望者討之。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: ordered the Ministry of War to issue a proclamation to the provinces and counties: those who submit—officials promoted in rank, military and civilians exempt from relocation; high civil and military officers to register households, grain levies, troops, and horses and personally deliver the registers to the capital; those who hesitate would be chastised.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Ministry of War sent a manifesto through the provinces: submit, and officials would rise in rank and the people would not be moved from their homes; great officers must file registers of population, revenue, and arms and bring them to court in person; waverers would be punished.

sentences.zh: 故明諸王來歸者，不奪其爵。

translations.literal: Former Ming princes who came to submit would not have their titles taken away.
translations.idiomatic: Ming princes who surrendered would keep their ranks.

sentences.zh: 在京職官及避賊隱匿者，各以名聞錄用，卒伍欲歸農者聽之。

translations.literal: Officials in the capital and those hiding from the bandits—each to report his name for appointment; soldiers wishing to return to farming were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials, and those in hiding from the rebels, were to register for office; soldiers who wished to go back to the fields were allowed to do so.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，令官吏軍民為明帝發喪，三日後服除，禮部太常寺具帝禮以葬。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: ordered officials, military, and people to conduct mourning for the Ming emperor; mourning garments removed after three days; the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to prepare imperial rites for burial.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court ordered mourning for the last Ming emperor. After three days the mourning dress was set aside, and the Ministry of Rites with the Court of Imperial Sacrifices arranged his burial with due honor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，俄羅塞臣、巴都禮、沙爾虎達等征黑龍江師還。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the Heilongjiang expedition under Orosangchen, Baduli, Sarhuda, and others returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Heilongjiang columns under Orosangchen, Baduli, and Sarhuda came back.

sentences.zh: 故明山海關總兵官高第來降。

translations.literal: Former Ming Shanhaiguan regional commander Gao Di came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Di, former Ming commander at Shanhaiguan, submitted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，令故明內閣、部院諸臣以原官同滿洲官一體辦理。

translations.literal: Day guisi: ordered former Ming Grand Secretariat and ministry officials to handle affairs together with Manchu officials as one body.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi former Ming grand secretaries and ministers were told to serve alongside Manchu colleagues in a single administration.

sentences.zh: 乙未，阿濟格等追擊李自成於慶都，敗之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Ajige and others pursued Li Zicheng at Qingdu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Ajige and his captains caught Li Zicheng at Qingdu and routed him.

sentences.zh: 譚泰、准塔等追至真定，又破走之。

translations.literal: Tantai, Zhuntata, and others pursued to Zhending and again routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Tantai and Zhuntata chased him to Zhending and beat him again.

sentences.zh: 燕京迤北各城及天津、真定諸郡縣皆降。

translations.literal: Cities north of Yanjing, and the prefectures and counties of Tianjin and Zhending, all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The towns north of Beijing, and the districts of Tianjin and Zhending, all gave themselves up.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，徵故明大學士馮銓至京。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: summoned former Ming Grand Secretary Feng Quan to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the court called the former Ming grand secretary Feng Quan to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬故明莊烈帝后周氏、妃袁氏，熹宗后張氏，神宗妃劉氏，並如制。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: buried former Ming Chongzhen Empress Zhou and Consort Yuan, Xizong Empress Zhang, and Shenzong Consort Liu—all according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the court buried Empress Zhou and Consort Yuan of Chongzhen, Empress Zhang of the Xizong reign, and Consort Liu of the Wanli era, each with proper rite.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳朔，令洪承疇仍以兵部尚書同內院官佐理機務。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day dingsi: ordered Hong Chengchou to continue as Minister of War and, together with inner-court officials, assist in affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingsi—the first of the month—Hong Chengchou was kept as minister of war and paired with inner-court ministers to help govern.

sentences.zh: 己未，以駱養性為天津總督。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: appointed Luo Yangxing as Tianjin governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Luo Yangxing was made governor-general of Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣戶部右侍郎王鰲永招撫山東、河南。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: dispatched Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Aoyong to win over Shandong and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Aoyong was sent to bring Shandong and Henan over by persuasion.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，故明大同總兵官姜瓖斬賊首柯天相等，以大同來降。

translations.literal: Day renxu: former Ming Datong regional commander Jiang Xiang beheaded the bandit chiefs Ke Tianxiang and others, and surrendered Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Jiang Xiang, Ming commander at Datong, killed the rebel leaders Ke Tianxiang and his fellows and handed the city to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣巴哈納、石廷柱率師定山東。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: dispatched Bahana and Shi Tingzhu to lead troops to pacify Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Bahana and Shi Tingzhu were sent to secure Shandong by force of arms.

sentences.zh: 免京城官用廬舍賦稅三年，與同居者一年，大軍所過州縣田畝稅之半，河北府州縣三之一。

translations.literal: Exempted taxes on official residences in the capital for three years, and for co-residents one year; in counties the grand army passed through, half the land tax; in Hebei prefectures and counties, one-third.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on government housing in the capital were waived for three years, and for those living in the same compounds for one year. Where the army had marched, land tax was cut by half; in Hebei, by a third.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，睿親王多爾袞及諸王、貝勒、貝子、大臣定議建都燕京，遣輔國公屯齊喀、和託、固山額真何洛會奉迎車駕。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Prince of Rui Dorgon and the princes, beiles, beises, and ministers decided to establish the capital at Yanjing; dispatched Duke Fuyiguo Tunjiqa, Hoton, and banner chief He Luohui to escort the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Dorgon and the princely council resolved to move the capital to Beijing. Tunjiqa, duke of Fuyiguo, Hoton, and the banner chief He Luohui were sent to bring the emperor south.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣固山額真葉臣率師定山西。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: dispatched banner chief Ye Chen to lead troops to pacify Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Ye Chen was dispatched to subdue Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，故明三邊總督李化熙降。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: former Ming Three Borders governor Li Huaxi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Huaxi, the Ming governor of the three borders, came over.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上遣使勞軍。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Emperor dispatched envoys to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the emperor sent envoys to honor the troops.

sentences.zh: 癸未，艾度禮有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Aidume was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Aidume was found guilty and put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遷故明太祖神主於歷代帝王廟。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: moved the spirit tablet of former Ming Taizu to the Hall of Emperors of Successive Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the tablet of the Ming founder was installed in the hall of successive dynasties.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鑄各官印兼用國書。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: cast official seals using both the national script and [Chinese].
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou new seals for every office were cast in both Manchu and Chinese.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，考定曆法，為時憲歷。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai: examined and fixed the calendar; named Shixian Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on dinghai of the seventh month, the calendar was revised and promulgated as the Shixian (Temporal Model) calendar.

sentences.zh: 戊子，巴哈納、石廷柱會葉臣軍定山西。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Bahana and Shi Tingzhu joined Ye Chen's army to pacify Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Bahana and Shi Tingzhu united with Ye Chen's force to finish Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以吳孳昌為宣大山西總督，方大猷為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Day renchen: appointed Wu Xuechang as Xuan-Da-Shanxi governor-general and Fang Dayou as Shandong provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Wu Xuechang was named governor-general of Xuanfu, Datong, and Shanxi, and Fang Dayou provincial surveillance commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以遷都祭告上帝、陵廟。

translations.literal: Day guisi: for the relocation of the capital, performed sacrificial rites reporting to God and the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, before the move to Beijing, sacrifice was offered to Heaven and the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，故明德王朱由縢降。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: former Ming Prince of De Zhu Yousong surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhu Yousong, the Ming Prince of De, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 時故明福王朱由崧即位江南，改元弘光，以史可法為大學士，駐揚州督師，總兵劉澤清、劉良佐、黃得功、高傑分守江北。

translations.literal: At that time the former Ming Prince Fu Zhu Yousong had ascended the throne south of the Yangtze, era name Hongguang; he appointed Shi Kefa grand secretary, stationed at Yangzhou as supreme commander; and set the generals Liu Zeqing, Liu Liangzuo, Huang Degong, and Gao Jie to guard the north bank of the river separately.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Zhu Yousong, the Prince of Fu, had declared himself emperor in the south under the era Hongguang. He made Shi Kefa grand secretary and commander at Yangzhou, and posted Liu Zeqing, Liu Liangzuo, Huang Degong, and Gao Jie along the north Yangtze line.

sentences.zh: 己亥，山東巡按朱朗鑅啟新補官吏仍以紗帽圓領臨民蒞事。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Shandong surveillance censor Zhu Langheng memorialized that newly appointed officials should still wear gauze hat and round collar when receiving the people and conducting affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Shandong censor Zhu Langheng urged that new appointees continue to wear the Ming gauze hat and round-collared robe when they took up office before the people.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞諭：「軍事方殷，衣冠禮樂未遑制定。

translations.literal: Prince of Rui Dorgon instructed: "Military affairs are pressing; caps and robes, rites and music—there is not yet leisure to fix regulations."
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon, Prince of Rui, replied: "The armies are still in the field. Court dress and ritual music must wait—we have no time to draft new rules yet."

sentences.zh: 近簡各官，姑依明式。

translations.literal: Recently various offices were simplified; for the present follow the Ming style.
translations.idiomatic: "For the offices just filled, let them keep the Ming forms for now."

sentences.zh: 」庚子，設故明長陵以下十四陵官吏。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, officials were established for the fourteen tombs of the former Ming from Changling downward.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, custodians were appointed for the fourteen Ming imperial tombs from Changling downward.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免盛京滿、漢額輸糧草布疋。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the Manchu and Han quota contributions of grain, fodder, and cloth in Shengjing were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Shengjing’s Manchu and Han quota levies of grain, fodder, and cloth were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大赦，除正額外一切加派。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, a general amnesty was proclaimed; all surcharges beyond the regular quota were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, a general amnesty was declared and every levy beyond the standard quota was cancelled.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷內監徵收涿州、寶坻皇莊稅糧。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, the eunuch collection of grain taxes from the imperial estates at Zhuozhou and Baodi was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, eunuch tax collectors were withdrawn from the Zhuozhou and Baodi crown estates.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以楊方興為河南總督，馬國柱為山西巡撫，陳錦為登萊巡撫。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Yang Fangxing was made Grand Coordinator of Henan, Ma Guozhu Provincial Governor of Shanxi, and Chen Jin Provincial Governor of Deng-Lai.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Yang Fangxing was appointed Grand Coordinator of Henan, Ma Guozhu governor of Shanxi, and Chen Jin governor of Deng-Lai.

sentences.zh: 免山東稅，如河北例。

translations.literal: Shandong taxes were remitted, following the Hebei precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong taxes were waived on the same terms as Hebei.

sentences.zh: 壬子，睿親王以書致史可法，勸其主削號歸籓。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the Prince Regent Dorgon sent a letter to Shi Kefa urging his sovereign to drop the imperial title and return to vassal status.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Prince Regent Dorgon wrote to Shi Kefa, urging the Southern Ming ruler to abandon the imperial title and accept tributary status.

sentences.zh: 可法答書不屈。

translations.literal: Kefa replied in a letter without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Kefa answered in a defiant letter and would not submit.

sentences.zh: 以王文奎為保定巡撫，羅綉錦為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Wang Wenkui was made Provincial Governor of Baoding, and Luo Xiujin Provincial Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wenkui was appointed governor of Baoding, and Luo Xiujin governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 裁六部蒙古侍郎。

translations.literal: The Mongol vice-ministers of the Six Boards were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol assistant ministers in the Six Boards were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 是月，建乾清宮。

translations.literal: That month, the Qianqing Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: That month, construction of the Qianqing Palace began.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day bingchen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, bingchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以何洛會為盛京總管，尼堪、碩詹統左右翼，鎮守盛京。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, Heluohe was made commander-general of Shengjing; Nikan and Shuozhan commanded the left and right wings to garrison Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Heluohe was made commander-general of Shengjing, with Nikan and Shuozhan commanding the left and right wings to hold the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大學士希福有罪，免。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Grand Secretary Hifu was guilty and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Grand Secretary Hifu was found guilty and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，行總甲法。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, the collective household responsibility law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the baojia collective-responsibility system was put into effect.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，免景州、河間、阜城、青縣本年額賦。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, this year’s quota levies in Jingzhou, Hejian, Fucheng, and Qing County were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the annual land tax was waived for Jingzhou, Hejian, Fucheng, and Qing County.

sentences.zh: 己巳，定在京文武官薪俸。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, salaries for civil and military officials in the capital were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, stipends for capital officials, civil and military, were set.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，車駕發盛京。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the imperial carriage departed Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the emperor left Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，次蘇爾濟，察哈爾固倫公主及蒙古王貝勒等朝行在。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, the court halted at Su’erji; the Gurun Princess of the Chahar and Mongol princes and banner lords paid audience at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the court stopped at Su’erji, where the Chahar Gurun Princess and Mongol princes and banner lords came to audience at the mobile palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，徵故明大學士謝升入內院辦事。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, the former Ming Grand Secretary Xie Sheng was summoned to serve in the Inner Court.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the former Ming Grand Secretary Xie Sheng was called to serve in the Inner Court.

sentences.zh: 癸未，次廣寧，給故明十三陵陵戶祭田，禁樵牧。

translations.literal: On the guimai day, the court halted at Guangning; sacrificial fields were granted to households of the thirteen Ming tombs, and woodcutting and grazing were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimai day, the court halted at Guangning, granted sacrificial lands to the households of the thirteen Ming tombs, and forbade logging and grazing there.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，車駕入山海關。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the jiawu day, the imperial carriage entered Shanhai Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the ninth month, the emperor passed through Shanhai Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，次永平。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, the court halted at Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the court halted at Yongping.

sentences.zh: 始嚴稽察逃人之令。

translations.literal: The regulations on investigating fugitives were first strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: The edicts on apprehending fugitives were enforced with new rigor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，建堂子於燕京。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, the tangzi spirit hall was built at Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, a tangzi spirit hall was erected at Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賊將唐通殺李自成親族乞降。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, the rebel general Tang Tong killed Li Zicheng’s kin and begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the rebel commander Tang Tong slew Li Zicheng’s relatives and offered surrender.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣和託、李率泰、額孟格等率師定山東、河南。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, Hetuo, Li Shuaitai, E Mengge, and others were dispatched with troops to pacify Shandong and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Hetuo, Li Shuaitai, E Mengge, and others were sent with armies to secure Shandong and Henan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，車駕至通州。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, the imperial carriage reached Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the emperor reached Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞率諸王、貝勒、貝子、文武群臣朝上於行殿。

translations.literal: The Prince Regent Dorgon led the princes, beile, beizi, and civil and military officials to pay homage at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Regent Dorgon led the princes, beile, beizi, and the civil and military officials in homage at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上自正陽門入宮。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, the emperor entered the palace through the Zhengyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the emperor entered the Forbidden City through the Zhengyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Venus appeared in the daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，初定郊廟樂章。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, sacrificial music for the suburban altars and temples was first established.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the ritual music for suburban and temple sacrifices was first fixed.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞率諸王及滿、漢官上表勸進。

translations.literal: The Prince Regent Dorgon led the princes and Manchu and Han officials in memorials urging the emperor to ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Regent Dorgon led the princes and Manchu and Han officials in memorials urging enthronement.

sentences.zh: 故明福王遣其臣左懋第、馬紹愉、陳洪範齎白金十餘萬兩、黃金千兩、幣萬匹求成。

translations.literal: The former Ming Prince Fu sent his ministers Zuo Maodi, Ma Shaoyu, and Chen Hongfan bearing more than one hundred thousand taels of silver, one thousand taels of gold, and ten thousand bolts of silk to sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Ming Prince of Fu sent Zuo Maodi, Ma Shaoyu, and Chen Hongfan with over a hundred thousand taels of silver, a thousand taels of gold, and ten thousand bolts of silk to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，奉安太祖武皇帝、孝慈武皇后、太宗文皇帝神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, the spirit tablets of Taizu the Martial Emperor, Empress Xiaoci the Martial, and Taizong the Literary Emperor were installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the spirit tablets of Taizu the Martial Emperor, Empress Xiaoci the Martial, and Taizong the Literary Emperor were placed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯朔，上親詣南郊告祭天地，即皇帝位，遣官告祭太廟、社稷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day yimao, the emperor personally proceeded to the southern suburbs to announce sacrifice to Heaven and Earth and assumed the imperial throne; officials were dispatched to announce sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the Altar of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, yimao, the emperor sacrificed at the southern suburbs to Heaven and Earth and took the throne, while envoys announced the rites at the ancestral temple and the altar of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 初頒時憲歷。

translations.literal: The Shixian calendar was first promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Shixian calendar was promulgated for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以孔子六十五代孫允植襲封衍聖公，其五經博士等官襲封如故。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, Kong Yunzhi, sixty-fifth-generation descendant of Confucius, was enfeoffed as Duke Yansheng; the Doctors of the Five Classics and other offices were enfeoffed as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Kong Yunzhi, sixty-fifth-generation descendant of Confucius, was invested as Duke Yansheng, and the Five Classics Doctors and related posts were confirmed in their hereditary ranks as before.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以睿親王多爾袞功最高，命禮部建碑紀績。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, because the Prince Regent Dorgon’s merit was highest, the Board of Rites was ordered to erect a stele recording his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, because Prince Regent Dorgon’s service stood highest, the Board of Rites was ordered to raise a stele commemorating his deeds.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上太宗尊諡，告祭郊廟社稷。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Taizong’s posthumous honorific was bestowed; sacrifice was announced at the suburban altars, the temple, and the altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Taizong was given his posthumous title and the rites were announced at the suburban altars, the ancestral temple, and the altar of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，流賊餘黨趙應元偽降，入青州，殺招撫侍郎王鰲永，和託等討斬之。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, the bandit remnant Zhao Yingyuan feigned surrender, entered Qingzhou, and killed Pacification Vice Minister Wang Aoyong; Hetuo and others pursued and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the bandit remnant Zhao Yingyuan pretended to submit, entered Qingzhou, and killed Pacification Vice Minister Wang Aoyong; Hetuo and others hunted him down and executed him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上御皇極門，頒詔天下，大赦。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, the emperor took the throne at the Huangji Gate, promulgated an edict to all under Heaven, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the emperor appeared at the Huangji Gate, issued an edict to the realm, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：

translations.literal: The edict said:
translations.idiomatic: The edict read:

sentences.zh: :我國家受天眷佑，肇造東土。

translations.literal: Our state received Heaven’s favor and founded its realm in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty received Heaven’s grace and founded its realm in the east.

sentences.zh: 列祖創興宏業，皇考式廓前猷，遂舉舊邦，誕膺新命。

translations.literal: Successive ancestors built up great enterprises; our late father expanded the former designs, thereby raising the old state and receiving the new mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Our forebears built a great enterprise; our late father broadened their design, raised up the old domain, and received the new Mandate.

sentences.zh: 迨朕嗣服，越在沖齡，敬念紹庭，永綏厥位。

translations.literal: When I succeeded to the throne I was still in tender years; respectfully I thought to continue the ancestral hall and forever secure my position.
translations.idiomatic: When I succeeded to the throne I was still a child, yet I resolved to carry on the ancestral charge and keep the throne secure.

sentences.zh: 頃緣賊氛洊熾，極禍中原，是用倚任親賢，救民塗炭。

translations.literal: Recently, because bandit troubles grew fierce and disaster reached the heartland, I therefore relied on trusted kinsmen to rescue the people from fire and flood.
translations.idiomatic: Lately, as rebels ravaged the land and calamity engulfed the central plains, I entrusted kinsmen of proven loyalty to deliver the people from ruin.

sentences.zh: 方馳金鼓，旋奏澄清，用解倒懸，非富天下。

translations.literal: As soon as we sounded the drums of war we at once achieved restoration; it was to relieve the people hanging upside down, not to enrich the realm for ourselves alone.
translations.idiomatic: Once the drums of war sounded, order was swiftly restored—not to seize the empire for private gain, but to lift the people from their torment.

sentences.zh: 而王公列辟文武群臣暨軍民耆老合詞勸進，懇請再三。

translations.literal: Yet princes, dukes, ministers civil and military, and elders of army and people jointly petitioned, earnestly requesting again and again.
translations.idiomatic: Yet princes, nobles, civil and military officials, and elders of the army and people joined in repeated, urgent petitions.

sentences.zh: 乃以今年十月乙卯朔，祗告天地宗廟社稷，定鼎燕京，仍建有天下之號曰大清，紀元順治。

translations.literal: Thus on the first day yimao of the tenth month of this year I announced to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altar of soil and grain; established the capital at Yanjing; still bearing the title that possesses all under Heaven, called Great Qing; the reign era Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, on the first day of the tenth month this year, yimao, I announced the Mandate to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altar of soil and grain, fixed the capital at Yanjing, and took for the realm the name Great Qing, with the reign title Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 緬維峻命不易，創業尤艱。

translations.literal: Reflecting that the lofty mandate is not easy; founding the enterprise is especially difficult.
translations.idiomatic: The Mandate of Heaven is hard to hold, and the founding of a dynasty is harder still.

sentences.zh: 況當改革之初，爰沛維新之澤。

translations.literal: Moreover, at the beginning of reform we now pour forth the bounty of renewal.
translations.idiomatic: At this dawn of reform we therefore pour out the blessings of renewal.

sentences.zh: 親王佐命開國，濟世安民，有大勛勞，宜加殊禮。

translations.literal: Princes who assisted the mandate in founding the state, aided the age and settled the people, with great merit and toil, should receive special honors.
translations.idiomatic: Princes who aided the founding of the state, steadied the age, and settled the people—whose merit and labor were great—shall receive exceptional honors.

sentences.zh: 郡王子孫弟侄應得封爵，所司損益前典以聞。

translations.literal: For sons and younger brothers of imperial princes who should receive enfeoffment, the relevant offices should adjust the former statutes and report.
translations.idiomatic: As for sons and younger brothers of imperial princes entitled to enfeoffment, the responsible offices shall revise the former regulations and report.

sentences.zh: 滿洲開國諸臣，運籌帷幄，決勝廟堂，汗馬著勛，開疆拓土，應加公、侯、伯世爵，錫以誥券。

translations.literal: Founding ministers of the Manchu state who plotted within the tent and decided victory in the hall, who sweated on horseback and showed merit, who opened territory and expanded soil, should receive hereditary ranks of duke, marquis, and earl, bestowed with patents of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu ministers who from the first counseled in the tent and won battles in council, who rode in hardship and opened new lands, shall receive hereditary ranks of duke, marquis, and earl, with patents of investiture.

sentences.zh: 大軍入關以來，文武官紳，倡先慕義，殺賊歸降，亦予通行察敘。

translations.literal: Since the great army entered the passes, civil and military officials and gentry who took the lead in admiring righteousness, killed bandits, and submitted shall also be examined and rewarded according to uniform procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Since the armies entered the passes, civil and military officers and gentry who were first to declare loyalty, fought rebels, and submitted shall likewise be reviewed and rewarded under a single standard.

sentences.zh: 自五月朔昧爽以前，官吏軍民罪犯，非叛逆十惡死在不赦者，罪無大小，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Before dawn on the first day of the fifth month, for crimes of officials, soldiers, and people—except for rebellion and the ten capital offenses punishable by death without pardon—whatever the size of the crime, all are pardoned and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: For officials, soldiers, and commoners alike, all offenses committed before dawn on the first day of the fifth month—save treason and the ten capital crimes that carry death without pardon, whatever their gravity—are forgiven.

sentences.zh: 官吏貪賄枉法，剝削小民，犯在五月朔以後，不在此例。

translations.literal: Officials guilty of corrupt bribery and perverting the law, exploiting the common people—crimes committed after the first day of the fifth month are not under this provision.
translations.idiomatic: Officials guilty of bribery, corruption, or oppression after the first day of the fifth month are excluded from this amnesty.

sentences.zh: 地畝錢糧，悉照前明會計錄，自五月朔起，如額徵解。

translations.literal: Land-field grain levies shall all follow the former Ming accounting records; from the first of the fifth month they shall be collected and forwarded as assessed.
translations.idiomatic: Land taxes shall follow the Ming revenue registers; from the first of the fifth month they shall be collected and remitted at the regular rates.

sentences.zh: 凡加派遼餉、新餉、練餉、召買等項，俱行蠲免。

translations.literal: All surcharges such as Liaopay, new pay, training pay, and procurement levies are abolished.
translations.idiomatic: All surcharges—Liaopay, the new levy, training pay, procurement taxes, and the like—are abolished.

sentences.zh: 大軍經過地方，仍免正糧一半，歸順州縣非經過者，免本年三分之一。

translations.literal: Places through which the great army passed still receive exemption of half the regular grain levy; districts that submitted but were not traversed are exempt one third for this year.
translations.idiomatic: Districts through which the main armies marched shall pay only half the regular grain tax; districts that submitted without being traversed are exempted one third for this year.

sentences.zh: 直省起存拖欠本折錢糧，如金花、夏稅、秋糧、馬草、人丁、鹽鈔、民屯、牧地、灶課、富戶、門攤、商稅、魚課、馬價、柴直、棗株、鈔貫、果品及內供顏料、蠟、茶、芝麻、棉花、絹、布、絲釂等項，念小民困苦已極，自五月朔以前，凡屬逋徵，概予豁除。

translations.literal: Provincial stored and overdue principal and converted grain levies—such as gilded-flower tax, summer tax, autumn grain, horse fodder, poll tax, salt certificates, civilian colonies, pasture lands, saltworks dues, rich-household levies, gate surcharges, commercial tax, fishing dues, horse prices, firewood payments, jujube trees, paper strings, fruit, and palace supplies of pigments, wax, tea, sesame, cotton, silk, cloth, and brewing materials—reflecting that the common people’s hardship has reached its limit, all arrears before the first of the fifth month are wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial arrears on stored and overdue taxes—gilded-flower dues, summer and autumn grain, horse fodder, poll tax, salt certificates, civilian colonies, pastures, saltworks levies, shop taxes, gate dues, commercial and fishing taxes, and countless items of palace supply, from pigments and wax to tea, cotton, silk, and brewing materials—since the people’s distress has reached its limit, all debts owed before the first of the fifth month are cancelled.

sentences.zh: 兵民散居京城，實不獲已，其東中西三城已遷徙者，准免租賦三年；

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians scattered through the capital could not be helped otherwise; for those in the eastern, central, and western cities who have already moved, rent and levies are approved remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Troops and civilians quartered in the capital could not be left without relief: those already moved from the eastern, central, and western districts are granted three years’ exemption from rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 南北二城雖未遷徙，亦免一年。

translations.literal: Although the northern and southern districts have not yet moved, they are also remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Even in the northern and southern districts, where relocation is not yet complete, one year’s taxes are waived.

sentences.zh: 丁銀原有定額，年來生齒凋耗，版籍日削，孤貧老弱，盡苦追呼，有司查覈，老幼廢疾，並與豁免。

translations.literal: The poll-tax silver had a fixed quota, but in recent years population has declined and registers daily shrink; the solitary, poor, aged, and weak have all suffered from relentless collection—officials are to investigate and the aged, infirm, and disabled are to be exempted together.
translations.idiomatic: Poll-tax quotas were fixed, yet as population dwindled and registers shrank, the aged, poor, and helpless were hounded for payment; magistrates shall review the rolls and exempt the old, the sick, and the disabled.

sentences.zh: 軍民年七十以上者，許一丁侍養，免其徭役；

translations.literal: For soldiers and civilians seventy years of age and above, one adult son may be allowed to serve and support them, exempt from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians aged seventy or more may keep one adult son at home to support them, free of corvée.

sentences.zh: 八十以上者，給與絹釂米肉；

translations.literal: For those eighty years of age and above, silk, rice, and meat are granted.
translations.idiomatic: Those eighty or older shall receive gifts of silk, rice, and meat.

sentences.zh: 有德行著聞者，給與冠帶；

translations.literal: For those whose virtue and conduct are renowned, a cap and belt are granted.
translations.idiomatic: Those of outstanding moral repute shall be given cap and belt as marks of honor.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨、廢疾不能自存者，官與給養。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, the disabled, and those unable to support themselves shall be maintained by the government.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, the destitute, and the disabled who cannot support themselves shall be fed at public charge.

sentences.zh: 孝子順孫義夫節婦，有司諮訪以聞。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives shall be investigated and reported by the officials.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, dutiful grandsons, faithful husbands, and chaste widows shall be sought out and reported by local officials.

sentences.zh: 故明建言罷謫諸臣及山林隱逸懷才抱德堪為世用者，撫按薦舉，來京擢用。

translations.literal: Former Ming officials who were demoted for remonstrance and recluses of mountain and forest with talent and virtue fit for employment shall be recommended by surveillance and pacification commissioners and brought to the capital for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Former Ming officials punished for remonstrance, and recluses of talent in hills and forests fit for service, shall be recommended by provincial commissioners and summoned to the capital for appointment.

sentences.zh: 文武制科，仍於辰戌丑未年舉行會試，子午卯酉年舉行鄉試。

translations.literal: Civil and military examination cycles shall still hold metropolitan examinations in the years chen, xu, chou, and wei, and provincial examinations in the years zi, wu, mao, and you.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military examinations shall continue on the old schedule: metropolitan exams in chen, xu, chou, and wei years, provincial exams in zi, wu, mao, and you years.

sentences.zh: 前明宗室首倡投誠者，仍予祿養。

translations.literal: Members of the former Ming imperial clan who were first to submit shall still receive stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Former Ming imperial clansmen who were first to submit shall continue to receive stipends.

sentences.zh: 明國諸陵，春秋致祭，仍用守陵員戶。

translations.literal: The tombs of the Ming state shall receive seasonal sacrifices, still using the tomb households as guardians.
translations.idiomatic: Ming imperial tombs shall receive seasonal sacrifices, still tended by their guardian households.

sentences.zh: 帝王陵寢及名臣賢士墳墓毀者修之，仍禁樵牧。

translations.literal: Imperial tombs and the graves of renowned ministers and worthy scholars that have been destroyed shall be repaired; woodcutting and grazing are still forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial tombs and the graves of eminent ministers and scholars that have been damaged shall be restored, and logging and grazing remain forbidden.

sentences.zh: 京、外文武職官應得封誥廕敘，一體頒給。

translations.literal: Civil and military offices inside and outside the capital entitled to patents of enfeoffment and inheritance shall all be granted together.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officers within and beyond the capital entitled to patents of rank and inheritance shall receive them in full.

sentences.zh: 北直、河南、山東節裁銀，山西太原、平陽二府新裁銀，前明已經免解，其二府舊裁銀，與各府新舊節裁銀兩，又會同館馬站、驢站館夫及遞運所車站夫價等銀，又直省額解工部四司料銀、匠價銀、甎料銀、苧蔴銀、車價銀、葦夫銀、葦課銀、漁課銀、野味銀、翎毛銀、活鹿銀、大鹿銀、小鹿銀、羊皮銀、弓箭撒袋折銀、扣剩水腳銀、牛角牛筋銀、鵝翎銀、天鵝銀、民夫銀、椿草子粒銀、狀元袍服銀、衣糧銀、砍柴夫銀、搬運木柴銀、抬柴夫銀、蘆課等折色銀、盔甲、腰刀、弓箭、弦條、胖襖、褲、鞋、狐麂兔狸皮、山羊毛課、鐵、黃櫨、榔、桑、胭脂、花梨、南棗、紫榆、杉條等木、椴木、桐木、板枋、冰窖物料、蘆席、蒲草、榜紙、赩罈、槐花、烏梅、梔子、筆管、芒帚、竹掃帚、席草、粗細銅絲、鐵線、鍍白銅絲、鐵條、碌子、青花棉、松香、光葉書籍紙、嚴漆、罩漆、桐油、毛、筀、紫、水斑等竹、實心竹、棕毛、白圓藤、翠毛、石磨、川二硃、生漆、沙葉、廣膠、焰硝、螺殼等本色錢糧，自五月朔以前逋欠在民，盡予蠲免，以甦民困。

translations.literal: Savings silver of Zhili, Henan, and Shandong; the new savings silver of Taiyuan and Pingyang prefectures in Shanxi already remitted under the former Ming; the old savings silver of those two prefectures together with new and old savings silver of every prefecture; silver for the Huìtóng courier stations, donkey stations, station laborers, and transport-depot cart fees; provincial quota deliveries to the four bureaus of the Ministry of Works in materials silver, artisan-price silver, brick materials, ramie, cart fees, reed labor, reed dues, fishing dues, game, feathers, live deer, large deer, small deer, sheepskin, bow-and-quiver conversion silver, retained freight silver, horn and sinew, goose feathers, swan feathers, civilian labor, thatch grain, graduate robes, clothing rations, woodcutters, timber transport, firewood carriers, reed dues in converted silver, armor, waist knives, bows, bowstrings, padded jackets, trousers, shoes, fox, roe, rabbit, and raccoon-dog pelts, goat-hair dues, iron, yellow oak, betel, mulberry, rouge, rosewood, southern jujube, purple elm, fir timber, basswood, paulownia, planks, ice-cellar supplies, reed mats, bulrush, presentation paper, red jars, pagoda tree flowers, dark plums, gardenia, brush tubes, broom grass, bamboo brooms, mat grass, coarse and fine copper wire, iron wire, white-plated copper wire, iron bars, millstones, blue-flowered cotton, rosin, glazed book paper, yan lacquer, topcoat lacquer, tung oil, hair, bamboo, purple bamboo, water-marked bamboo, solid bamboo, palm fiber, white round rattan, kingfisher feathers, stone mills, cinnabar, raw lacquer, sand leaves, wide glue, saltpeter, and shells in kind and converted grain levies—arrears owed by the people before the first of the fifth month are wholly remitted to relieve the people’s distress.
translations.idiomatic: Every category of provincial savings silver, courier and transport charges, and the long roster of goods levied in kind or cash to the Ministry of Works—from artisan fees, bricks, and ramie to game, furs, timber, lacquers, metals, stationery, and palace stores—together with all arrears still on the people before the first of the fifth month, is remitted entirely to ease their burden.

sentences.zh: 後照現行事例，分別蠲除。

translations.literal: Thereafter, according to current practice, remissions shall be made separately.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, further exemptions shall follow the standing regulations case by case.

sentences.zh: 京師行商車戶等役，每遇僉役，頓至流離，嗣後永行豁除。

translations.literal: For merchant cart households and similar corvée in the capital, whenever they were impressed for service they at once fell into destitution; henceforth this is permanently abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Capital merchants and cart households, ruined whenever they were pressed into service, are permanently exempted from such impressment.

sentences.zh: 運司鹽法，遞年增加，有新餉、練餉雜項加派等銀，深為厲商，盡行豁免，本年仍免額引三分之一。

translations.literal: The salt monopoly law had increased year by year; new-pay and training-pay miscellaneous surcharges and similar silver deeply harmed merchants—all are remitted, and for this year one third of the quota certificates is still waived.
translations.idiomatic: Salt monopoly dues, swollen year by year with new levies and training surcharges that crippled trade, are abolished; this year’s salt certificates are reduced by one third as well.

sentences.zh: 關津抽稅，非欲困商，准免一年，明末所增，並行豁免。

translations.literal: Pass duties were not meant to burden merchants; they are approved remitted for one year, and late-Ming increases are likewise remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Transit tolls, never meant to crush commerce, are waived for one year, including every surcharge added in the late Ming.

sentences.zh: 直省州縣零星稅目，概行嚴禁。

translations.literal: Petty taxes of prefectures and counties in the provinces are wholly strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Petty local taxes in the provinces are strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 曾經兵災地方應納錢糧，已經前明全免者，仍與全免，不在免半、免一之例。

translations.literal: Where places that suffered military disaster should pay grain levies already wholly remitted under the former Ming, they are still wholly remitted and do not fall under the half or one-third exemptions.
translations.idiomatic: Districts ravaged by war whose taxes the late Ming had already cancelled shall remain fully exempt, and do not come under the half- or third-tax rules.

sentences.zh: 直省報解屯田司助工銀兩，亦出加派，准予豁除。

translations.literal: Provincial deliveries of aid-to-works silver to the colony bureau were also from surcharges; remission is granted.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial ‘aid-to-works’ silver paid to the land bureau, being another surcharge, is cancelled.

sentences.zh: 直省領解錢糧被賊劫失，在五月朔以前，一併豁免。

translations.literal: Provincial forwarded grain levies robbed by bandits before the first of the fifth month are remitted together.
translations.idiomatic: Tax grain lost to bandits before the first of the fifth month shall not be collected from the provinces.

sentences.zh: 山、陝軍民被流寇要挾，悔過自新，概從赦宥，脅從自首者前罪勿論。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians of Shanxi and Shaanxi coerced by roving bandits who repent and renew themselves are broadly pardoned; those compelled who surrender themselves are not punished for prior crimes.
translations.idiomatic: People of Shanxi and Shaanxi forced into service by bandits who repent and return to loyalty are pardoned; those who were coerced and now surrender shall not be punished for earlier offenses.

sentences.zh: 巡按以訪拿為名，聽信衙蠹，誣罰良民，最為弊政，今後悉行禁革。

translations.literal: Surveillance commissioners who under the name of investigation trusted yamen runners and falsely punished good people created the worst abuses; hereafter this is wholly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioners who, in the name of investigation, let yamen bullies frame innocent people created the worst abuses; such practices are now abolished.

sentences.zh: 勢家土豪，重利放債，致民傾家蕩產，深可痛恨，今後有司勿許追比。

translations.literal: Powerful families and local bullies who lent at heavy interest and drove the people to ruin their households are deeply hateful; hereafter the officials shall not be allowed to press collection.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful landlords and local bullies who lent at crushing interest and beggared their neighbors are detestable; officials may no longer enforce such debts.

sentences.zh: 越訴誣告，敗俗傷財，大赦以後，戶婚小事，俱就有司歸結，如有訟師誘陷愚民入京越訴者，加等反坐。

translations.literal: False accusations and suits across jurisdictions corrupt custom and waste wealth; after the great amnesty, petty household and marriage matters shall all be settled by the local officials; if litigation masters entice foolish people to sue in the capital across jurisdiction, they shall be punished in reverse by increased degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After this amnesty, petty domestic suits belong to local magistrates; anyone who induces litigants to bring trivial cases to the capital shall be punished by added degrees of penalty.

sentences.zh: 贖鍰之設，勸人自新，追比傷生，轉為民害，今後並行禁止，不能納者，速予免追。

translations.literal: The institution of redemption fines was meant to encourage people to reform; pressing collection harmed life and turned into harm to the people; hereafter it is wholly forbidden, and those unable to pay are quickly to be exempted from pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fines were meant to encourage reform, yet harsh collection ruined lives; they are abolished, and those who cannot pay shall not be pursued.

sentences.zh: 惟爾萬方，與朕一德。

translations.literal: Only you of the myriad regions, be of one virtue with me.
translations.idiomatic: People of every quarter, join me in single-hearted loyalty.

sentences.zh: 播告遐邇，咸使聞知。

translations.literal: Proclaim far and near; cause all to hear and know.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be proclaimed far and wide, that all may hear and know.

sentences.zh: 加封和碩睿親王多爾袞為叔父攝政王。

translations.literal: The Prince Regent Dorgon was further enfeoffed as Imperial Uncle and Regent.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Regent Dorgon was further raised to Imperial Uncle and Regent.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以雷興為天津巡撫。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Lei Xing was made Provincial Governor of Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Lei Xing was appointed governor of Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，加封和碩鄭親王濟爾哈朗為信義輔政叔王，復封豪格為和碩肅親王，進封多羅武英郡王阿濟格為和碩英親王，多羅豫郡王多鐸為和碩豫親王，貝勒羅洛宏為多羅衍禧郡王，封碩塞為多羅承澤郡王。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, the Prince of Zheng Jirhalang was further enfeoffed as Prince of Trust and Righteousness, Assistant Regent Uncle King; Hooge was again enfeoffed as Prince Su; Prince Ying Ajige was advanced to Prince Ying; Prince Yu Dodo was advanced to Prince Yu; Beile Luoluo Hong was enfeoffed as Prince Yanxi; Suose was enfeoffed as Prince Chenze.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Prince of Zheng Jirhalang was further made Trusted and Righteous Assistant Regent Uncle King; Hooge was restored as Prince Su; Ajige was advanced to Prince Ying; Dodo to Prince Yu; Luoluo Hong was made Prince Yanxi; and Suose Prince Chenze.

sentences.zh: 葉臣等克太原。

translations.literal: Ye Chen and others captured Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Chen and others took Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 故明副將劉大受自江南來降。

translations.literal: The former Ming vice general Liu Dashou came from Jiangnan to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming vice commander Liu Dashou came from Jiangnan to submit.

sentences.zh: 辛未，封貝子尼堪、博洛為多羅貝勒，輔國公滿達海、吞齊、博和託、吞齊喀、和託、尚善為固山貝子。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Beizi Nikan and Boluo were enfeoffed as Beile; Assistant Banner Princes Mandahai, Tunqi, Bohetuo, Tunqika, Hetuo, and Shangshan were enfeoffed as Gushan Beizi.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Beizi Nikan and Boluo were raised to Beile rank; Assistant Banner Princes Mandahai, Tunqi, Bohetuo, Tunqika, Hetuo, and Shangshan were made Gushan Beizi.

sentences.zh: 定諸王、貝勒、貝子歲俸。

translations.literal: Annual stipends for princes, beile, and beizi were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Annual stipends for princes, beile, and beizi were established.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以英親王阿濟格為靖遠大將軍，率師西討李自成。

translations.literal: Guiyou day: Prince Ying Ajige was appointed Grand General Pacifying the Distant Regions, leading troops west to attack Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Prince Ying Ajige was made Grand General Pacifying the Distant Regions and marched west against Li Zicheng.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，定攝政王冠服宮室之制。

translations.literal: Wuyin day: regulations were fixed for the regent prince's caps, robes, and palace quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the court set the regent's insignia of rank, dress, and palace protocol.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以豫親王多鐸為定國大將軍，率師征江南。

translations.literal: Jimao day: Prince Yu Dodo was appointed Grand General Stabilizing the State, leading troops to conquer Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Prince Yu Dodo was made Grand General Stabilizing the State and took the field against Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 檄諭故明南方諸臣，數其不能滅賊復讎，擁眾擾民，自生反側，及無明帝遺詔擅立福王三罪。

translations.literal: A proclamation was issued instructing former Ming officials in the south, enumerating three crimes: inability to destroy the bandits and avenge [the dynasty], gathering crowds and harassing the people while raising rebellion on their own, and establishing the Prince of Fu without the late Ming emperor's testamentary edict.
translations.idiomatic: An edict went out to the former Ming south, charging its ministers with three offenses: failing to destroy the rebels and avenge the throne, mustering mobs to trouble the people and turn against the new order, and enthroning the Prince of Fu without a testament from the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉朔，設滿洲司業、助教，官員子孫有欲習國書、漢書者，併入國子監讀書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon of yiyou: Manchu Vice Directors and Assistant Instructors were established; officials' sons and grandsons wishing to study the national script or Han books were all enrolled to study at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the eleventh month the court appointed Manchu vice directors and tutors at the Imperial Academy, and enrolled officials' sons who wished to study Manchu or Chinese.

sentences.zh: 故明福王使臣陳洪範南還，中途密啟請留左懋第、馬紹愉，自欲率兵歸順，招徠南中諸將。

translations.literal: The former Ming Prince of Fu's envoy Chen Hongfan was returning south; midway he secretly memorialized requesting that Zuo Maodi and Ma Shaoyu be retained, while he himself wished to lead troops in submission and win over generals in the south.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hongfan, envoy of the Ming Prince of Fu, was sent home south; en route he secretly asked that Zuo Maodi and Ma Shaoyu be kept at court while he himself led his forces in and rallied the southern commanders.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，石廷柱、巴哈納、席特庫等敗賊於平陽，山西悉平。

translations.literal: Renchen day: Shi Tingzhu, Bahana, Sitiku, and others defeated bandits at Pingyang; Shanxi was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Shi Tingzhu, Bahana, Sitiku, and others routed the rebels at Pingyang and brought all Shanxi under control.

sentences.zh: 庚子，封唐通為定西侯。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Tang Tong was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dingxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Tang Tong was created Marquis of Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，罷故明定陵守者，其十二陵仍設太監二名，量給歲時祭品。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: the guards of the former Ming Ding Mausoleum were dismissed; for the twelve mausoleums two eunuchs each were still appointed, and seasonal sacrificial offerings were allotted in due measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the guard at the Ming Ding tomb was abolished; for the twelve imperial tombs two eunuchs apiece were kept on duty and given seasonal offerings as needed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor offered sacrifice to Heaven at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封勒克德渾為多羅貝勒。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: Leke dehun was enfeoffed as Prince of the Second Degree.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Leke dehun was created a doroi beile.

sentences.zh: 遣朝鮮質子李𣳫歸國，並制減其歲貢。

translations.literal: The Korean hostage Li Ho was sent home, and orders were also issued to reduce their annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Korean hostage prince Li Ho was sent home and the court ordered a reduction of Korea's annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，出故明府庫財物，賞八旗將士及蒙古官員。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingsi day: valuables from the former Ming treasury were distributed to reward Eight Banner officers and soldiers and Mongol officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the twelfth month goods from the Ming treasury were handed out to reward Eight Banner troops and Mongol officers.

sentences.zh: 葉臣等大軍平直隸、河南、山西府九、州二十七、縣一百四十一。

translations.literal: Ye chen and others with the great army pacified Zhili, Henan, and Shanxi—nine prefectures, twenty-seven departments, and one hundred forty-one districts.
translations.idiomatic: Ye chen and the main army pacified Zhili, Henan, and Shanxi, taking nine prefectures, twenty-seven subprefectures, and one hundred forty-one counties.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以太宗第六女固倫公主下嫁固山額真阿山子誇扎。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: the Sixth Daughter of Emperor Taizong, Princess Imperial, was married to Kuazha, son of Gushan Ejen Ashan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Emperor Taizong's sixth daughter, a gulun princess, was given in marriage to Kuazha, son of the gushan ejen Ashan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，多鐸軍至孟津，賊將黃士欣等遁走，濱河十五寨堡望風納款，睢州賊將許定國來降。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: Dodo's army reached Mengjin; bandit generals Huang Shixin and others fled; fifteen stockaded forts along the river submitted at the first rumor; Xu Dingguo, bandit general of Suizhou, came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Dodo reached Mengjin; rebel generals such as Huang Shixin fled; fifteen river forts surrendered at once; and Xu Dingguo of Suizhou defected.

sentences.zh: 己巳，多鐸軍至陝州，敗賊將張有曾於靈寶。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Dodo's army reached Shanzhou and defeated bandit general Zhang Youceng at Lingbao.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Dodo's army reached Shanzhou and defeated the rebel Zhang Youceng at Lingbao.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，諭戶部清查無主荒地給八旗軍士。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: the Ministry of Revenue was instructed to investigate and register ownerless wasteland to grant to Eight Banner soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Board of Revenue was ordered to survey abandoned land without owners and allot it to Banner soldiers.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣何洛會等祭福陵，鞏阿岱等祭昭陵，告武成。

translations.literal: Jimao day: He Luohui and others were dispatched to sacrifice at Fu Mausoleum; Gong Adai and others at Zhao Mausoleum, announcing military success.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day He Luohui was sent to offer at the Fu Mausoleum and Gong Adai to the Zhao Mausoleum to report the triumph of arms.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，有劉姓者自稱明太子，內監楊玉引入故明嘉定侯周奎宅，奎以聞。

translations.literal: Xinsi day: a man surnamed Liu claiming to be the Ming crown prince was brought by eunuch Yang Yu into the residence of former Ming Marquis Zhou Kui of Jiading; Kui reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day a Liu who called himself the Ming heir was led by the eunuch Yang Yu into the house of the former Ming marquis Zhou Kui of Jiading, and Kui reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 故明宮人及東宮舊僚辨視皆不識。

translations.literal: Former Ming palace women and former Eastern Palace retainers examined him and none recognized him.
translations.idiomatic: Former palace women and staff of the Eastern Palace were brought to identify him, and none knew him.

sentences.zh: 下法司勘問，楊玉及附會之內監常進節、指揮李時廕等十五人皆棄市。

translations.literal: He was sent down to the judicial authorities for investigation; Yang Yu and the eunuch Chang Jinjie and others who colluded, Commander Li Shiyin, and fifteen persons in all were executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: The case went to the courts; Yang Yu, the eunuch Chang Jinjie, Commander Li Shiyin, and twelve others who had abetted the fraud were put to death in the market.

sentences.zh: 仍諭中外，有以故明太子來告者給賞，太子仍加恩養。

translations.literal: Still an edict was issued at home and abroad: whoever reported the former Ming crown prince would be given reward; the crown prince would still receive generous care.
translations.idiomatic: An edict nonetheless went out at home and abroad promising reward to anyone who brought word of the true Ming heir, who would be treated with honor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮暨虎什喀里等八姓部，鄂爾多斯部濟農，索倫部章京敖爾拖木爾，歸化城土默特部古祿格，喀爾喀部塞臣綽爾濟、古倫地瓦胡土克圖、餘古折爾喇嘛、土謝圖汗，蘇尼特部騰機思阿喇海，烏朱穆秦部台吉滿瞻俱來貢。

translations.literal: That year Korea, the eight surname tribes including Husihali, the jinong of the Ordos tribe, the Solon banner officer Aortuomuer, Guluge of the Tumed tribe of Guihua city, the Khalkha nobles Sechen, Gurun Diwa Khutukhtu, Yugier Lama, the Tüsiyetü Khan, Tenggis Alakhai of the Sunid tribe, and Taji Manzhan of the Ujimqin tribe all came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Korea; the Husihali and seven allied tribes; the jinong of the Ordos; the Solon officer Aortuomuer; Guluge of the Guihua Tumed; and from Khalkha, Sechen, Gurun Diwa Khutukhtu, the Yugier lama, the Tüsiyetü Khan, Tenggis Alakhai of the Sunid, and Manzhan of the Ujimqin.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊子，圖賴等破李自成於潼關，賊倚山為陣，圖賴率騎兵百人掩擊，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, wuzi day: Tulai and others defeated Li Zicheng at Tong Pass; the bandits relied on the mountains for their formation; Tulai led one hundred cavalry in a flanking attack and beheaded and captured many.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on wuzi day of the first spring month, Tulai routed Li Zicheng at Tong Pass; when the rebels held the heights Tulai struck with a hundred horse and took a heavy toll.

sentences.zh: 至是，自成親率馬步兵迎戰，又數敗之，賊眾奔潰。

translations.literal: At this time Zicheng personally led horse and foot soldiers to give battle and was again repeatedly defeated; the bandit masses fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng then came up in person with horse and foot, was beaten again and again, and his host broke and ran.

sentences.zh: 己未，大軍圍潼關，賊築重壕，堅壁以守。

translations.literal: Jiwei day: the great army besieged Tong Pass; the bandits dug deep moats and held the walls in a stubborn defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the main force invested Tong Pass; the rebels dug deep trenches and clung to their walls.

sentences.zh: 穆成格、俄羅塞臣先登，諸軍繼進，復大敗之。

translations.literal: Muchengge and Orosachen scaled first; the armies followed and again inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Muchengge and Orosachen went over the top first; the rest of the army poured in and won another great victory.

sentences.zh: 自成遁走西安。

translations.literal: Zicheng fled toward Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng fled toward Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 丙申，阿濟格、尼堪等率師抵潼關，賊將馬世堯降，旋以反側斬之。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: Ajige, Nikan, and others led troops to Tong Pass; bandit general Ma Shiyao surrendered and was soon executed for disloyalty.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Ajige and Nikan reached Tong Pass; the rebel Ma Shiyao submitted and was soon beheaded for treachery.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命多羅饒餘郡王阿巴泰為總統，固山額真准塔為左翼，梅勒章京譚泰為右翼，代豪格征山東。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: Prince Raoyu Abatai was appointed commander-in-chief, Gushan Ejen Cuiha as left wing, meirei janggin Tantai as right wing, to replace Hooge in the Shandong campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Prince Raoyu Abatai was made supreme commander, with the gushan ejen Cuiha on the left and the meirei janggin Tantai on the right, taking Hooge's place in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以太宗第七女固倫公主下嫁內大臣鄂齊爾桑子喇瑪思。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: the Seventh Daughter of Emperor Taizong, Princess Imperial, was married to Lamasi, son of Grand Secretary Ejeilasan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Taizong's seventh daughter, a gulun princess, was married to Lamasi, son of the grand secretary Ejeilasan.

sentences.zh: 河南孟縣河清二日。
