translations.literal: The river at Meng county in Henan ran clear for two days.
translations.idiomatic: For two days the Yellow River at Meng county ran clear.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，多鐸師至西安，自成奔商州。

translations.literal: Renyin day: Dodo's army reached Xi'an; Zicheng fled to Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Dodo entered Xi'an and Zicheng fled toward Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大學士謝升卒。

translations.literal: Guimao day: Grand Secretary Xie Sheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Grand Secretary Xie Sheng died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，真定、大名、順德、廣平山賊悉平。

translations.literal: Yisi day: mountain bandits in Zhending, Daming, Shunde, and Guangping were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the mountain rebels in Zhending, Daming, Shunde, and Guangping were all put down.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命房山縣歲以太牢祭金太祖、世宗陵。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: orders were given that Fangshan county should each year offer the great sacrifice at the mausoleums of the Jin founders Taizu and Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Fangshan was charged to offer the great sacrifice yearly at the tombs of the Jin founders Taizu and Shizong.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免山西今年額賦之半。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: half of this year's land tax in Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Shanxi was granted remission of half its land tax for the year.

sentences.zh: 更國子監孔子神位為大成至聖文宣先師孔子。

translations.literal: The spirit tablet of Confucius in the Imperial Academy was changed to read: Great Completer, Ultimate Sage, Cultured Exemplar, First Teacher Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius's tablet at the Imperial Academy was retitled Great Completer, Ultimate Sage, Cultured Exemplar, First Teacher Confucius.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禁包衣大等私收投充漢人，冒占田宅，違者論死。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: bond servants and great servants were forbidden privately to receive surrendered Han Chinese in attachment, or falsely to register fields and houses; violators were punished with death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day bondsmen and senior servants were forbidden to enroll surrendered Han Chinese on their own account or seize land and houses; offenders faced death.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免濟源、武陟、孟、溫四縣今年額賦及磁、安陽等九州縣之半。

translations.literal: Renzi day: this year's land tax was remitted for Jiyuan, Wuzhi, Meng, and Wen, and half the tax for Ci, Anyang, and nine other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Jiyuan, Wuzhi, Meng, and Wen were freed of the year's land tax, and half the tax was cut in Ci, Anyang, and nine other districts.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免修邊民壯八千餘人。

translations.literal: Guichou day: more than eight thousand corvée laborers on border works were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day more than eight thousand men pressed for frontier labor were released.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，阿巴泰敗賊於徐州。

translations.literal: Second month, bingchen day: Abatai defeated bandits at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day of the second month Abatai defeated the rebels at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，修律例。

translations.literal: Jiwei day: the legal code was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the statutes were revised.

sentences.zh: 以李鑒為宣大總督，馮聖兆為宣府巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Jian was appointed Governor-General of Xuan and Da; Feng Shengzhao was appointed Xuanfu Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jian was made governor-general of Xuan and Da, and Feng Shengzhao intendant of Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 降將許定國襲殺明興平伯高傑於睢州。

translations.literal: The surrendered general Xu Dingguo treacherously killed the Ming Xingping Earl Gao Jie at Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The defector Xu Dingguo murdered the Ming earl Gao Jie of Xingping at Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，諭豫親王多鐸移師定江南，英親王阿濟格討流寇餘黨。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: an edict ordered Prince Yu Dodo to shift his army to settle Jiangnan, and Prince Ying Ajige to pursue the remaining roving bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Prince Yu Dodo was ordered south to complete the conquest of Jiangnan, and Prince Ying Ajige to mop up the rebel remnants.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，禁管庄撥什庫毀民墳塋。

translations.literal: Bingyin day: estate stewards and clerks were forbidden to destroy the people's graves.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day managers of Banner estates were forbidden to desecrate common graves.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以祁充格為內弘文院大學士。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Qi Chongge was appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Hongwen Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Qi Chongge was made grand secretary of the Inner Hongwen Academy.

sentences.zh: 庚午，阿濟格剿陝西餘寇，克四城，降三十八城。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: Ajige suppressed the remaining bandits in Shaanxi, took four cities, and received the surrender of thirty-eight cities.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Ajige cleared Shaanxi of rebel holdouts, stormed four cities, and accepted the submission of thirty-eight more.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，多鐸師至河南，賊將劉忠降。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: Dodo's army reached Henan; bandit general Liu Zhong surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Dodo entered Henan and the rebel Liu Zhong surrendered.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申朔，始祀遼太祖、金太祖、世宗、元太祖、明太祖於歷代帝王廟，以其臣耶律曷魯、完顏粘沒罕、斡離不、木華黎、伯顏、徐達、劉基從祀。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon of jiashen: sacrifice began at the Temple of Former Emperors to Liao Taizu, Jin Taizu, Shizong, Yuan Taizu, and Ming Taizu, with their ministers Yelü Helu, Wanyan Nianhan, Wolibu, Muqali, Bayan, Xu Da, and Liu Ji enshrined in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the third month the Temple of Former Emperors opened with Liao Taizu, Jin Taizu and Shizong, Yuan Taizu, and Ming Taizu, attended by Yelü Helu, Wanyan Nianhan, Wolibu, Muqali, Bayan, Xu Da, and Liu Ji.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，多鐸師出虎牢關，分遣固山額真拜伊圖等出龍門關，兵部尚書韓岱、梅勒章京宜爾德、侍郎尼堪等由南陽合軍歸德，所過迎降，河南悉平。

translations.literal: Gengyin day: Dodo's army left Hulao Pass; separate orders sent Gushan Ejen Bayitu and others out through Longmen Pass; Minister of War Han Dai, meirei janggin Yierde, Vice Minister Nikan, and others by way of Nanyang joined forces at Guide; wherever they passed they were met with submission, and Henan was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Dodo marched out of Hulao; Bayitu and other banner commanders were sent through Longmen; Han Dai, Yierde, Nikan, and others came down from Nanyang and united at Guide; the route was littered with surrenders and all Henan was secured.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免山東荒賦。

translations.literal: Xinmao day: land tax on wasteland in Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Shandong's tax on abandoned fields was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚子，故明大學士李建泰來降。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: the former Ming Grand Secretary Li Jiantai came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the former Ming grand secretary Li Jiantai submitted.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣八旗官軍番戍濟寧。

translations.literal: Yisi day: Eight Banner garrison officers were dispatched in rotation to guard Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Banner officers were sent in turn to garrison Jining.

sentences.zh: 丙午，朝鮮國王次子李淏歸。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: the Korean king's second son Li Hao returned home.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Korean king's second son Li Hao went home.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免薊州元年額賦。

translations.literal: Jiyou day: Jizhou's land tax for the first year of the reign was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Jizhou was freed of its first-year land tax.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太行諸賊悉平。

translations.literal: Renzi day: all bandits in the Taihang region were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Taihang bandits were all suppressed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，遣漢軍八旗官各一員駐防盛京。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingchen day: one Han Banner officer each was stationed to garrison Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day in the fourth summer month one Han Banner officer apiece was posted to guard Mukden.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以王文奎為陝西總督，焦安民為寧夏巡撫，黃圖安為甘肅巡撫，故明尚書張忻為天津巡撫，郝晉為保定巡撫，雷興為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: Wang Wenkui was appointed Shaanxi Governor-General; Jiao Anmin Ningxia Intendant; Huang Tu'an Gansu Intendant; the former Ming Minister Zhang Xin Tianjin Intendant; Hao Jin Baoding Intendant; Lei Xing Shaanxi Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Wang Wenkui became governor-general of Shaanxi, Jiao Anmin intendant of Ningxia, Huang Tu'an of Gansu, the former Ming minister Zhang Xin of Tianjin, Hao Jin of Baoding, and Lei Xing of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，葬故明殉難太監王承恩於明帝陵側，給祭田，建碑。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: the former Ming eunuch Wang Chengen, who died in loyalty, was buried beside the Ming emperor's tomb, given sacrificial fields, and provided with a stele.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Ming eunuch Wang Chengen, who had died loyal to his master, was buried by the imperial tombs with sacrificial land and a memorial stele.

sentences.zh: 己丑，多鐸師至泗州。

translations.literal: Jichou day: Dodo's army reached Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Dodo reached Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 阿山等取泗北淮河橋，明守將焚橋遁，我軍遂夜渡淮。

translations.literal: Ashan and others took the Huai River bridge north of Sizhou; the Ming defenders burned the bridge and fled, and our army crossed the Huai that night.
translations.idiomatic: Ashan seized the Huai bridge north of Sizhou; the Ming garrison burned it and fled, and the Qing forces crossed the river by night.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諭曰：「流賊李自成殺君虐民，神人共憤。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: an edict said: "The roving bandit Li Zicheng murdered his sovereign and tyrannized the people; gods and men alike loathe him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the throne proclaimed: "Li Zicheng the rebel slew his prince and oppressed the people; Heaven and earth cry out against him.

sentences.zh: 朕誕膺天命，撫定中華，尚復竊據秦川，抗阻聲教。

translations.literal: I have received Heaven's mandate and pacified China, yet he still clings to the Qin lands and resists our civilizing rule.
translations.idiomatic: I have received Heaven's mandate and pacified the empire, yet he still holds Shaanxi and defies our rule.

sentences.zh: 爰命和碩豫親王移南伐之眾，直搗崤、函，和碩英親王秉西征之師，濟自綏德，旬月之間，全秦底定。

translations.literal: Therefore I ordered the Prince Yu to move the army that was marching south to strike straight at Xiao and Han; the Prince Ying took the western expeditionary force, crossed from Suide, and within a month all Qin was settled.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore sent Prince Yu with the southern army straight through the Tong Pass, and Prince Ying with the western host across from Suide; within a month all Shaanxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 憫茲黎庶，咸與維新。

translations.literal: Pitying the common people, all are to be made new.
translations.idiomatic: Pitying the people, I would make them new.

sentences.zh: 其為賊所脅誤者，悉赦除之，並蠲一切逋賦。

translations.literal: Those who were coerced or misled by the bandits are all pardoned and cleared, and all arrears in tax are remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All who were forced or misled into following the rebels are pardoned, and every unpaid levy is forgiven.

sentences.zh: 大軍所過，免今年額賦之半，餘免三之一。

translations.literal: Where the great army passes, half of this year's land tax is remitted; elsewhere one-third is remitted."
translations.idiomatic: Along the line of march half the year's land tax is remitted; elsewhere one-third."

sentences.zh: 」庚午，豫親王多鐸師至揚州，諭故明閣部史可法、翰林學士衛胤文等降。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: Prince Yu Dodo's army reached Yangzhou and ordered the former Ming Grand Secretary Shi Kefa, Hanlin Academician Wei Yiwen, and others to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Dodo reached Yangzhou and called on the former Ming grand secretary Shi Kefa, the academician Wei Yiwen, and others to submit.

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: They did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: They refused.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以孟喬芳為陝西三邊總督。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day: Meng Qiaofang was appointed Governor-General of the Three Borders of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Meng Qiaofang was made governor-general of the Shaanxi three borders.

sentences.zh: 以太宗第八女固倫公主下嫁科爾沁土謝圖親王巴達禮子巴雅斯護朗。

translations.literal: The Eighth Daughter of Emperor Taizong, Princess Imperial, was married to Bayasihulang, son of Prince Badai of the Khorchin Tüsiyetü.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong's eighth daughter, a gulun princess, was given to Bayasihulang, son of the Khorchin Tüsiyetü prince Badai.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，拜尹圖、圖賴、阿山等克揚州，故明閣部史可法不屈，殺之。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: Bayitu, Tulai, Ashan, and others took Yangzhou; the former Ming Grand Secretary Shi Kefa would not submit and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Bayitu, Tulai, and Ashan stormed Yangzhou; Shi Kefa would not yield and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，初行武鄉試。

translations.literal: Xinsi day: military examinations at the district level were held for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the first military examinations at the district level were held.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔，河道總督楊方興進瑞麥。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon of renwu: Grand Canal Director Yang Fangxing presented auspicious wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the fifth month the canal director Yang Fangxing presented wheat with double ears.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「歲豐民樂，即是禎祥，不在瑞麥。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "A year of plenty and a people at ease are themselves auspicious signs; they do not lie in miraculous wheat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Plenty and a contented people are blessing enough; miracle wheat means nothing.

sentences.zh: 當惠養元元，益加撫輯。

translations.literal: One should nurture the masses and all the more strengthen care and soothing rule."
translations.idiomatic: Nourish the people and govern them all the more gently."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，以旱諭刑部慮囚。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: because of drought an edict ordered the Ministry of Punishments to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, with drought prevailing, the Board of Punishments was ordered to review the jails.

sentences.zh: 命內三院大學士馮銓、洪承疇、李建泰、范文程、剛林、祁充格等纂修明史。

translations.literal: Orders were given to the Inner Three Academies grand secretaries Feng Quan, Hong Chengchou, Li Jiantai, Fan Wencheng, Ganglin, Qi Chongge, and others to compile and revise the History of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Quan, Hong Chengchou, Li Jiantai, Fan Wencheng, Ganglin, Qi Chongge, and other grand secretaries of the Inner Three Academies were charged to compile the History of the Ming.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，多鐸師至揚子江，故明鎮海伯鄭鴻逵等以舟師分守瓜洲、儀真，我軍在江北，拜尹圖、圖賴、阿山率舟師自運河潛濟，梅勒章京李率泰乘夜登岸，黎明，我軍以次畢渡，敵眾咸潰。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: Dodo's army reached the Yangzi; the former Ming Zhenhai Earl Zheng Hongkui and others with a fleet guarded Guazhou and Yizhen in detachments; our army was on the north bank; Bayitu, Tulai, and Ashan led boats secretly across by the Grand Canal; meirei janggin Li Shuaitai landed by night; at dawn our troops had all crossed in turn and the enemy masses all fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Dodo reached the Yangzi; Zheng Hongkui and other Ming commanders held Guazhou and Yizhen with the fleet while the Qing army lay north of the river; Bayitu, Tulai, and Ashan ferried troops up the canal by night, Li Shuaitai went ashore in the dark, and by dawn the whole force was across and the enemy scattered.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以王志正為延綏巡撫。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: Wang Zhizheng was appointed Yan-Gui Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Wang Zhizheng was made intendant of Yan and Gui.

sentences.zh: 免高密元年額賦。

translations.literal: Gaomi's land tax for the first year of the reign was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Gaomi was freed of its first-year land tax.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王以下及百官冰，著為令。

translations.literal: Ice was bestowed on princes down to all officials, and this was established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Ice was granted to the princes and the whole bureaucracy, and the practice was written into law.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宣府妖民劉伯泗謀亂伏誅。

translations.literal: Jichou day: the sorcerer Liu Bosi of Xuanfu, who plotted rebellion, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Liu Bosi, a Xuanfu sorcerer who had plotted revolt, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以王文奎為淮揚總督，趙福星為鳳陽巡撫。

translations.literal: Gengyin day: Wang Wenkui was appointed Huai-Yang Governor-General; Zhao Fuxing Fengyang Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Wang Wenkui became governor-general of Huai and Yang, and Zhao Fuxing intendant of Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，多鐸師至南京，故明福王朱由崧及大學士馬士英遁走太平，忻城伯趙之龍、大學士王鐸、禮部尚書錢謙益等三十一人以城迎降。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: Dodo's army reached Nanjing; the former Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong and Grand Secretary Ma Shiying fled to Taiping; Xincheng Earl Zhao Zhilong, Grand Secretary Wang Duo, Minister of Rites Qian Qianyi, and thirty-one others opened the city in welcome and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Dodo entered Nanjing; the Ming Prince of Fu Zhu Yousong and Ma Shiying fled to Taiping; Zhao Zhilong, Wang Duo, Qian Qianyi, and thirty-one others surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 興平伯高傑子元照、廣昌伯劉良佐等二十三人率馬步兵二十三萬餘人先後來降。

translations.literal: Gao Jie's son Yuanzhao of Xingping, Liu Liangzuo of Guangchang, and twenty-three others with more than two hundred thirty thousand horse and foot came to surrender in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jie's son Yuanzhao, Liu Liangzuo of Guangchang, and twenty-three other commanders followed with more than two hundred thirty thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以郝晉為保定巡撫。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: Hao Jin was appointed Baoding Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Hao Jin was reappointed intendant of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 免平度、壽光等六州縣元年額賦。

translations.literal: Pingdu, Shouguang, and six other prefectures and counties had their first-year land tax remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Pingdu, Shouguang, and six other districts were freed of the first-year land tax.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命滿洲子弟就學，十日一赴監考課，春秋五日一演射。

translations.literal: Wuxu day: orders were given that Manchu youths should attend school, present themselves every ten days for examination at the Academy, and drill in archery every five days in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Manchu students were ordered to study, report to the Academy every ten days for examination, and practice archery every five days in spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 故明中書張朝聘輸木千章助建宮殿，自請議敘。

translations.literal: The former Ming Secretariat drafter Zhang Chaopin contributed a thousand timbers toward palace construction and asked to be considered for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming secretariat drafter Zhang Chaopin donated a thousand logs for the palaces and asked for an office in return.

sentences.zh: 諭以用官惟賢，無因輸納授官之理，令所司給直。

translations.literal: An edict said that offices are given only to the worthy, and there is no principle of granting office because of contributions in goods; the relevant office was ordered to pay the fair price.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied that office goes only to the worthy, not to donors, and ordered fair payment for the timber.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免章丘、濟陽京班匠價，並令直省除匠籍為民。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: the corvée price for capital artisans in Zhangqiu and Jiyang was remitted, and all provinces were ordered to strike artisan registers and make the craftsmen commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Zhangqiu and Jiyang were freed of the capital-artisan levy, and every province was told to erase artisan households from the registers and make them ordinary subjects.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，定叔父攝政王儀注，凡文移皆曰皇叔父攝政王。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: ritual protocol for the regent uncle was fixed; in all documents he was styled Imperial Uncle Regent Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the ceremonial of the regent uncle was settled; all papers were to address him as Imperial Uncle Regent Prince.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免皇后租，並崇文門米麥稅。

translations.literal: Yisi day: the empress's rent was remitted, and the grain and wheat tax at Chongwen Gate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the empress's land rent was forgiven and the grain and wheat toll at Chongwen Gate was lifted.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宣平定江南捷音。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: victory in the pacification of Jiangnan was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the court announced the pacification of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 乾清宮成，復建太和殿、中和殿、位育宮。

translations.literal: The Palace of Heavenly Purity was completed, and the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the Hall of Central Harmony, and the Palace of Cultivating Harmony were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace of Heavenly Purity was finished, and work resumed on the halls of Supreme Harmony, Central Harmony, and Cultivating Harmony.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，免興濟縣元年額賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guichou day: remitted the first-year assessed land tax of Xingji County.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the sixth month, the first-year land tax of Xingji County was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免近畿圈地今年額賦三之二。

translations.literal: Jiayin day: remitted two-thirds of this year's assessed tax on encircled land in the metropolitan districts near the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, two-thirds of this year's tax on banner-encircled land near the capital was remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以丁文盛為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Yimao day: appointed Ding Wensheng Shandong Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Ding Wensheng was made Governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，諭南中文武軍民薙髮，不從者治以軍法。

translations.literal: Bingchen day: ordered civil and military officials and the people south of the Yangtze to shave the head; those who did not comply were punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict commanded all officials and commoners in the south to adopt the shaved head; defiance was punished under military law.

sentences.zh: 是月，始諭直省限旬日薙髮如律令。

translations.literal: That month, it was first ordered that each province within the direct jurisdiction shave the head within ten days as the statute commanded.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the provinces were first ordered to enforce the hair-shaving statute within ten days.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，豫親王多鐸遣軍追故明福王朱由崧於蕪湖。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: Prince Yu Dodo sent troops to pursue the former Ming Prince Fu Zhu Yousong at Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Prince Dodo sent forces after the former Ming Prince Fu, Zhu Yousong, toward Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 明靖國公黃得功逆戰，圖賴大敗之，得功中流矢死。

translations.literal: The Ming Jingguo Duke Huang Degong fought in resistance; Tulai routed him greatly, and Degong died of an arrow wound.
translations.idiomatic: Ming's Duke of Jingguo, Huang Degong, met them in battle; Tulai routed his force, and Degong was killed by an arrow.

sentences.zh: 總兵官田雄、馬得功執福王及其妃來獻，諸將皆降。

translations.literal: Brigade-generals Tian Xiong and Ma Degong seized the Prince Fu and his consort and presented them in surrender; all the generals submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadiers Tian Xiong and Ma Degong seized the Prince Fu and his consort and brought them in; the other commanders all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 免永寧等四縣元年荒賦。

translations.literal: Remitted the first-year famine tax arrears of Yongning and three other counties.
translations.idiomatic: The first-year famine tax arrears of Yongning and three other counties were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，申薙髮之令。

translations.literal: Bingyin day: the hair-shaving order was reissued.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the hair-shaving edict was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 免深、衡水等七州縣元年荒賦。

translations.literal: Remitted the first-year famine tax arrears of Shen, Hengshui, and five other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Famine tax arrears for the first year were remitted in Shen, Hengshui, and five other prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，陝西妖賊胡守龍倡亂，孟喬芳討平之。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: in Shaanxi the demonic bandit Hu Shoulong raised rebellion; Meng Qiaofang suppressed and pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the sectarian rebel Hu Shoulong rose in Shaanxi; Meng Qiaofang put the disturbance down.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，皇太妃薨。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: the Grand Imperial Consort died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the Grand Imperial Consort died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，何洛會率師駐防西安。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Hošoi led troops to garrison and defend Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Hošoi marched to garrison Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 命江南於十月行鄉試。

translations.literal: Ordered that Jiangnan hold the provincial examination in the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan was ordered to hold the provincial civil examination in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔曰：「本朝立國東陲，歷有年所，幅員既廣，無意併兼。

translations.literal: Jimao day: an edict said: "Our dynasty was founded on the eastern marches and has stood these many years; our territory is already vast, and we had no wish to annex more.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict said: "Our dynasty was founded on the eastern marches and has stood these many years; our realm is already vast, and we had no wish to swallow more territory.

sentences.zh: 昔之疆場用兵，本冀言歸和好。

translations.literal: Former campaigns on the frontier were undertaken in hope that matters would return to peace and good relations.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier campaigns on the frontier were meant to bring affairs back to peace and amity.

sentences.zh: 不幸寇凶極禍，明祚永終，用是整旅入關，代明雪憤。

translations.literal: Sadly, bandits and calamity ran their course to the limit, and the Ming destiny came to its end; for this reason we marshaled our hosts and entered the Pass to avenge the Ming on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits and disaster ran to the utmost and the Ming mandate ended, we marshaled our armies, entered the Pass, and took up the Ming cause of vengeance.

sentences.zh: 猶以賊渠未殄，不遑啟居，爰命二王，誓師西討。

translations.literal: Still, because the bandit chiefs were not yet destroyed, we had no leisure to take up residence; we then ordered the two princes to swear the army westward for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Because the rebel chiefs were not yet destroyed, we could not yet settle the court; we therefore ordered the two princes to swear the armies west for punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 而南中乘釁立君，妄竊尊號，亟行亂政，重虐人民。

translations.literal: Yet the south seized the occasion to set up a ruler, presumptuously usurped exalted titles, hurriedly pursued disorderly government, and further oppressed the people.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the south seized the moment to enthrone a ruler, stole exalted titles, rushed into misrule, and oppressed the people all the more.

sentences.zh: 朕夙夜祗懼，思拯窮黎，西賊既摧，乃事南伐。

translations.literal: We day and night stand in reverent fear, thinking to rescue the destitute masses; once the western bandits were broken, we then turned to campaign south.
translations.idiomatic: Day and night we stand in reverent dread, resolved to rescue the afflicted people; once the western rebels were crushed, we turned south.

sentences.zh: 兵無血刃，循汴抵淮。

translations.literal: Our arms met no blood on the blades; we followed the Bian route to the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Our armies advanced without blood on the blades, following the Bian route to the Huai.

sentences.zh: 甫克維揚，遂平江左。

translations.literal: Having just taken Weiyang, we forthwith pacified the lands east of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly had Weiyang fallen when the lands east of the river were pacified.

sentences.zh: 金陵士女，昭我天休。

translations.literal: The men and women of Jinling have shown forth our Heaven-granted felicity.
translations.idiomatic: The men and women of Jinling have displayed Heaven's blessing upon us.

sentences.zh: 既俘福籓，南服略定，特弘大賚，嘉與維新。

translations.literal: Having already captured the Fu fief-prince, the southern realms are largely settled; we specially extend great bounty and rejoice in renewal with you.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Prince of Fu is captive and the south largely settled, we extend great grace and share renewal with you.

sentences.zh: 其河南、江北、江南官民絓誤，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Those officials and people of Henan, Jiangbei, and Jiangnan who were entangled in error—all are pardoned and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and people of Henan, Jiangbei, and Jiangnan who were caught in error are all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 所有橫徵逋賦，悉與蠲免。

translations.literal: All irregular levies and arrears in tax are wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Every irregular levy and tax arrear is wholly remitted.

sentences.zh: 大軍所過，免今年額賦之半，餘免三之一。

translations.literal: Where the great army passed, half of this year's assessed tax is remitted, and of the remainder one-third is remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Where the main army passed, half of this year's land tax is remitted, and one-third of the remainder.

sentences.zh: 閏六月甲申，阿濟格敗李自成於鄧州，窮追至九江，凡十三戰，皆大敗之。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, jiashen day: Ajige defeated Li Zicheng at Dengzhou, pursued relentlessly to Jiujiang—in thirteen battles altogether, all were great victories.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the intercalary sixth month, Ajige defeated Li Zicheng at Dengzhou and pursued him to Jiujiang; in thirteen engagements he won every one.

sentences.zh: 自成竄九宮山，自縊死，賊黨悉平。

translations.literal: Zicheng fled into Jiugong Mountain and hanged himself; the bandit faction was wholly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng fled to Jiugong Mountain and hanged himself; his followers were entirely subdued.

sentences.zh: 故明寧南侯左良玉子夢庚、總督袁繼咸等率馬步兵十三萬、船四萬自東流來降。

translations.literal: The former Ming Ningnan Marquis Zuo Liangyu's son Menggeng, Governor Yuan Jixian, and others led 130,000 horse and foot and forty thousand boats to surrender at Dongliu.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Menggeng, son of the former Ming Marquis of Ningnan Zuo Liangyu, Governor Yuan Jixian, and others brought 130,000 infantry and cavalry and forty thousand boats to surrender at Dongliu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，定群臣公以下及生員耆老頂戴品式。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: fixed the styles of official caps for ministers from dukes down, licentiates, and elders.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the official cap styles for ministers from dukes downward, licentiates, and elders were fixed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，河決王家園。

translations.literal: Jichou day: the Yellow River burst at Wangjiayuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the Yellow River broke through at Wangjiayuan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔阿濟格等班師。

translations.literal: Gengyin day: an edict ordered Ajige and others to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered Ajige and his forces to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改江南民解漕、白二糧官兌官解。

translations.literal: Xinmao day: changed Jiangnan so that the people's delivery of tribute grain and white rice was converted to official transport and official delivery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Jiangnan was changed so that the people's delivery of grain tribute and white rice was taken over by official transport and official collection.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，諭曰：「明季台諫諸臣，竊名貪利，樹黨相攻，眩惑主心，馴致喪亂。

translations.literal: An edict said: "In the late Ming, censorial officials stole reputation and coveted profit, formed factions and attacked one another, bewildered the ruler's mind, and thereby brought ruin and chaos.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "In the late Ming, censorial officials traded on reputation and chased profit, formed factions and assailed one another, confused the throne, and so brought ruin.

sentences.zh: 今天下初定，百事更始，諸臣宜公忠體國，各盡職業，毋蹈前轍，自貽顛越。

translations.literal: Now that the realm is newly settled and all affairs begin anew, ministers should serve the state with public loyalty, each fulfilling his office, and not tread the old path to overthrow themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the realm is newly settled and everything begins afresh, you should serve the state with loyal integrity, each doing his duty, and not repeat the old errors to your own destruction.

sentences.zh: 」定滿洲文武官品級。

translations.literal: "Fixed the official ranks of Manchu civil and military officers.
translations.idiomatic: The ranks of Manchu civil and military officers were fixed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命大學士洪承疇招撫江南各省。

translations.literal: Guisi day: ordered Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou to win over and pacify each province of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou was ordered to win over and pacify the provinces of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，定諸王、貝勒、貝子、宗室公頂戴式。

translations.literal: Jiawu day: fixed the cap styles for princes, beiles, beises, and imperial clansmen of ducal rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the cap styles for princes, beiles, beises, and ducal clansmen were fixed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，除割腳筋刑。

translations.literal: Weimao day: abolished the punishment of cutting the tendons of the feet.
translations.idiomatic: On the weimao day, the punishment of severing the leg tendons was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命吳惟華招撫廣東，孫之獬招撫江西，黃熙允招撫福建，江禹緒招撫湖廣，丁之龍招撫雲、貴。

translations.literal: Guimao day: ordered Wu Weihua to win over Guangdong, Sun Zhifu Jiangxi, Huang Xiyun Fujian, Jiang Yuxu Huguang, and Ding Zhilong Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Wu Weihua was sent to win over Guangdong, Sun Zhifu Jiangxi, Huang Xiyun Fujian, Jiang Yuxu Huguang, and Ding Zhilong Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 多鐸遣貝勒博洛及拜尹圖、阿山率師趣杭州，故明潞王出降，淮王自紹興來降。

translations.literal: Dodo sent Beile Boluo, with Bayintu and Ashan, to lead troops toward Hangzhou; the former Ming Prince of Lu came out to surrender, and the Prince of Huai came from Shaoxing to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Dodo sent Prince Boluo, with Bayintu and Ashan, toward Hangzhou; the former Ming Prince of Lu surrendered, and the Prince of Huai came in from Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 嘉興、湖州、嚴州、寧波諸郡悉平。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Jiaxing, Huzhou, Yanzhou, and Ningbo were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxing, Huzhou, Yanzhou, Ningbo, and the other prefectures were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 分遣總兵官吳勝兆克廬州、和州。

translations.literal: Dispatched brigade-general Wu Shengzhang separately to take Luzhou and Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadier Wu Shengzhang was sent separately to take Luzhou and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，改南京為江南省，應天府為江寧府。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: changed Nanjing to Jiangnan Province and Yingtian Prefecture to Jiangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Nanjing was renamed Jiangnan Province and Yingtian Prefecture became Jiangning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 命陝西於十月行鄉試。

translations.literal: Ordered that Shaanxi hold the provincial examination in the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi was ordered to hold the provincial civil examination in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌朔，享太廟。

translations.literal: Seventh month, gengxu first day of the month: offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, the Emperor sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命貝勒勒克德渾為平南大將軍，同固山額真葉臣等往江南代多鐸。

translations.literal: Renzi day: appointed Beile Lekedehun Grand General Who Pacifies the South, together with Banner Commander Yechen and others, to go to Jiangnan in place of Dodo.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Prince Lekedehun was made Grand General Who Pacifies the South and, with Banner Commander Yechen and others, sent to Jiangnan to replace Dodo.

sentences.zh: 設明太祖陵守陵太監四人，祀田二千畝。

translations.literal: Established four eunuch wardens for the tomb of the Ming Founder, with two thousand mu of sacrificial fields.
translations.idiomatic: Four eunuch wardens were appointed for the tomb of the Ming Founder, with two thousand mu of sacrificial fields.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，故明東平侯劉澤清率所部降。

translations.literal: Guichou day: the former Ming Dongping Marquis Liu Zeqing led his command in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the former Ming Marquis of Dongping Liu Zeqing surrendered with his troops.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以劉應賓為安廬巡撫，土國寶為江寧巡撫。

translations.literal: Yimao day: appointed Liu Yingbin Anlu Governor and Tu Guobao Jiangning Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Liu Yingbin was made Governor of Anlu and Tu Guobao Governor of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命謝弘儀招撫廣西。

translations.literal: Bingchen day: ordered Xie Hongyi to win over Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Xie Hongyi was ordered to win over Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，禁中外軍民衣冠不遵國制。

translations.literal: Wuwu day: forbade civil and military officials within and without the court to wear caps and robes not in accord with the national regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, officials and soldiers at court and beyond were forbidden to wear dress that did not conform to the national code.

sentences.zh: 己未，以何鳴鑾為湖廣巡撫，高斗光為偏沅巡撫，潘士良撫治鄖陽。

translations.literal: Jiwei day: appointed He Mingluan Huguang Governor, Gao Douguang Bian Governor, and Pan Shiliang Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, He Mingluan was made Governor of Huguang, Gao Douguang Governor of Bian, and Pan Shiliang Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上太祖武皇帝、孝慈武皇后、太宗文皇帝玉冊玉寶於太廟。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: elevated the jade registers and seals of the Martial Emperor Taizu, the Martial and Kind Empress, and the Literary Emperor Taizong in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the jade registers and seals of Martial Emperor Taizu, the Martial and Kind Empress, and Literary Emperor Taizong were installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免西安、延安本年額賦之半，餘免三之一。

translations.literal: Yichou day: remitted half of this year's assessed tax for Xi'an and Yan'an, and one-third of the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, half of this year's land tax for Xi'an and Yan'an was remitted, and one-third of the remainder.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，西平賊首劉洪起伏誅，汝寧州縣悉平。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: the western bandit chief Liu Hongqi was executed after rising in rebellion; the prefectures and counties of Runing were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the western rebel leader Liu Hongqi was put to death after rising; the districts of Runing were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 河決兗西新築月堤。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst the newly built moon embankment west of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke through the newly built moon embankment west of Yan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔自今內外章奏由通政司封進。

translations.literal: Jisi day: an edict ordered that from now on all memorials within and without the court be sealed and forwarded through the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, an edict ordered that henceforth all memorials at court and beyond pass through the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以陳錦提督操江，兼管巡撫。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: appointed Chen Jin Grand Coordinator of the Yangtze patrol, with additional charge as Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Chen Jin was made Grand Coordinator of Yangtze patrol, with additional duties as Governor.

sentences.zh: 故明總漕田仰陷通州、如皋、海門，鳳陽巡撫趙福星、梅勒章京譚布等討平之。

translations.literal: The former Ming Director-General of Grain Transport Tian Yang was trapped at Tongzhou, Rugao, and Haimen; Fengyang Governor Zhao Fuxing, Meire Janggin Tan Bu, and others suppressed and pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming grain-transport director Tian Yang was cornered at Tongzhou, Rugao, and Haimen; Fengyang Governor Zhao Fuxing, Meire Janggin Tan Bu, and others suppressed him.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以楊聲遠為登萊巡撫。

translations.literal: Jimao day: appointed Yang Shengyuan Denglai Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Yang Shengyuan was made Governor of Denglai.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，免霸、順義等八州縣災賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinsi day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Ba and Shunyi and six other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the eighth month, disaster tax assessments were remitted in Ba, Shunyi, and six other prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，免彰德、衛輝、懷慶、河南各府荒賦。

translations.literal: Yiyou day: remitted famine tax assessments of Zhangde, Weihui, Huaqing, and the prefectures of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, famine tax assessments were remitted in Zhangde, Weihui, Huaqing, and the Henan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己丑，英親王阿濟格師還，賜從征外籓王、台吉、將佐金帛有差。

translations.literal: Jichou day: Prince Ying Ajige's army returned; rewarded the participating outer-banner princes, taijis, and officers with gold and silks in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince Ajige's army returned; the outer-banner princes, taijis, and officers who had joined the campaign were rewarded with gold and silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免真定、順德、廣平、大名災額賦。

translations.literal: Guisi day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, disaster tax assessments were remitted in Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming.

sentences.zh: 丙午，降將金聲桓討故明益王，獲其從官王養正等誅之，並獲鍾祥王朱孳菪等九人。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: the surrendered general Jin Shengheng campaigned against the former Ming Prince of Yi, captured his attendant Wang Yangzheng and others and executed them, and also captured the Prince of Zhongxiang Zhu Zichong and nine others.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the surrendered general Jin Shengheng attacked the former Ming Prince of Yi, seized his attendant Wang Yangzheng and others and put them to death, and also took the Prince of Zhongxiang Zhu Zichong and nine others.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以英親王阿濟格出師有罪，降郡王，譚泰削公爵，降昂邦章京，鰲拜等議罰有差。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: because Prince Ying Ajige was guilty on campaign, he was demoted to Prince of the Commandery; Tatai was stripped of ducal rank and demoted to Angbang Janggin; Oboi and others were penalized in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Prince Ajige was found guilty on campaign and reduced to a commandery prince; Tatai was stripped of his dukedom and reduced to Angbang Janggin; Oboi and others were punished in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，故明魯王將方國安、王之仁犯杭州，張存仁擊走之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengxu day: the former Ming Prince of Lu's generals Fang Guo'an and Wang Zhiren attacked Hangzhou; Zhang Cunren drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the ninth month, the former Ming Prince of Lu's generals Fang Guo'an and Wang Zhiren attacked Hangzhou; Zhang Cunren repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命鎮國公傅勒赫、輔國公札喀納等率師協防江西。

translations.literal: Guichou day: ordered Defender of the State Fu Lehe and Assistant State Defender Zhakana and others to lead troops in joint defense of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Defender of the State Fu Lehe and Assistant State Defender Zhakana were ordered to garrison Jiangxi in support.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，故明懷安王來降。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: the former Ming Prince of Huai'an came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the former Ming Prince of Huai'an surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，故明新昌王據云台山，攻陷興化，准塔討斬之。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: the former Ming Prince of Xinchang held Yuntai Mountain, attacked and took Xinghua; Zhuntata campaigned against him and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the former Ming Prince of Xinchang held Yuntai Mountain and seized Xinghua; Zhuntata attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以河間、灤州、遵化荒地給八旗耕種，故明勛戚內監餘地並分給之。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: allotted wasteland in Hejian, Luanzhou, and Zunhua to the Eight Banners for cultivation; remaining lands of former Ming enfeoffed kin and inner-court eunuchs were also distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, wasteland in Hejian, Luanzhou, and Zunhua was given to the Eight Banners to farm; surplus land of former Ming nobles and palace eunuchs was also distributed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，田仰寇福山，土國寶擊敗之。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: Tian Yang raided Fushan; Tu Guobao defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Tian Yang raided Fushan; Tu Guobao defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，江西南昌十一府平。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: the eleven prefectures of Nanchang in Jiangxi were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the eleven prefectures of Nanchang in Jiangxi were pacified.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，以馬國柱為宣大總督。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guiwei day: appointed Ma Guozhu Xuan-Da Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the tenth month, Ma Guozhu was made Governor-General of Xuan and Da.

sentences.zh: 戊子，故明翰林金聲受唐王敕起兵於徽州，眾十餘萬。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: the former Ming Hanlin Jin Sheng, receiving an order from the Tang Prince, raised troops at Huizhou with a host of more than 100,000.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the former Ming Hanlin Jin Sheng, commissioned by the Tang Prince, raised an army of more than a hundred thousand at Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 洪承疇遣提督張天祿連破之於績溪，獲金聲，不屈，殺之。

translations.literal: Hong Chengchou sent Grand Coordinator Zhang Tianlu to defeat him repeatedly at Jixi, captured Jin Sheng, and because he would not submit, killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chengchou sent Grand Coordinator Zhang Tianlu to rout him repeatedly at Jixi, took Jin Sheng captive, and executed him when he refused to yield.

sentences.zh: 是時，故明唐王朱聿釗據福建，魯王朱彝垓據浙江，馬士英等兵渡錢塘結營拒命。

translations.literal: At this time the former Ming Tang Prince Zhu Yujian held Fujian, the Lu Prince Zhu Yihuan held Zhejiang, and Ma Shiying and others crossed the Qiantang and encamped in resistance.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the former Ming Tang Prince Zhu Yujian held Fujian, the Lu Prince Zhu Yihuan held Zhejiang, and Ma Shiying and others crossed the Qiantang and encamped in defiance.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，免寶坻縣荒賦。

translations.literal: Gengyin day: remitted famine tax assessments of Baodi County.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, famine tax assessments of Baodi County were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免太原等府州災賦。

translations.literal: Renchen day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Taiyuan and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, disaster tax assessments were remitted in Taiyuan and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，豫親王多鐸師還，上幸南苑迎勞之。

translations.literal: Guisi day: Prince Yu Dodo's army returned; the Emperor went to the Southern Park to welcome and reward him.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Prince Dodo's army returned; the Emperor went to the Southern Park to welcome and honor him.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以苗胙土為南贛巡撫。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: appointed Miao Zhengtu Southern Gan Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Miao Zhengtu was made Governor of Southern Gan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以太宗次女固倫公主下嫁察哈爾汗子阿布鼐。

translations.literal: Yisi day: the second daughter of Taizong, the Imperial Princess, was given in marriage to Abunai, son of the Chakhar Khan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Taizong's second daughter, an imperial princess, was married to Abunai, son of the Chakhar khan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以申朝紀為山西巡撫，李翔鳳為江西巡撫，蕭起元為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: appointed Shen Chaoji Shanxi Governor, Li Xiangfeng Jiangxi Governor, and Xiao Qiyuan Zhejiang Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Shen Chaoji was made Governor of Shanxi, Li Xiangfeng of Jiangxi, and Xiao Qiyuan of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，加封和碩豫親王多鐸為和碩德豫親王，賜從征王、貝勒、貝子、公及外籓台吉、章京金幣有差。

translations.literal: Wushen day: advanced Prince Yu Dodo to Prince Yu the Virtuous, and rewarded the participating princes, beiles, beises, dukes, outer-banner taijis, and janggin with gold and coin in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Prince Dodo was advanced to Prince Dodo the Virtuous, and the princes, beiles, beises, dukes, outer-banner taijis, and janggin who had joined the campaign were rewarded with gold and coin according to rank.

sentences.zh: 命孔有德、耿仲明還盛京。

translations.literal: Ordered Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming to return to Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming were ordered to return to Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，以張存仁為浙閩總督，羅綉錦為湖廣四川總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renzi day: appointed Zhang Cunren Zhe-Fujian Governor-General and Luo Xiujin Huguang-Sichuan Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the eleventh month, Zhang Cunren was made Governor-General of Zhe and Fujian, and Luo Xiujin Governor-General of Huguang and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，故明大學士王應熊、四川巡撫龍文光請降。

translations.literal: Guichou day: the former Ming Grand Secretary Wang Yingxiong and Sichuan Governor Long Wenguang requested to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the former Ming Grand Secretary Wang Yingxiong and Sichuan Governor Long Wenguang asked to surrender.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以吳景道為河南巡撫，命巴山、康喀賴為左右翼，同洪承疇駐防江寧，朱瑪喇駐防杭州，貝勒勒克德渾率鞏阿岱、葉臣討湖廣流賊二隻虎等。

translations.literal: Jiayin day: appointed Wu Jingdao Henan Governor, and ordered Bahan and Kangkalai as left and right wings, together with Hong Chengchou to garrison Jiangning; Zhumarha to garrison Hangzhou; Prince Lekedehun to lead Gongadai and Yechen against the Huguang bandit called the Two Tigers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Wu Jingdao was made Governor of Henan; Bahan and Kangkalai were named left and right wings to garrison Jiangning with Hong Chengchou; Zhumarha was posted to Hangzhou; and Prince Lekedehun led Gongadai and Yechen against the Huguang rebel known as the Two Tigers.

sentences.zh: 己未，朝鮮國王李倧請立次子淏為世子，許之。

translations.literal: Jiwei day: the King of Korea Yi Jong requested that his second son Ho be established as heir; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, King Yi Jong of Korea asked that his second son Ho be named heir; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，朱瑪喇敗馬士英於餘杭，和託敗方國安於富陽。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: Zhumarha defeated Ma Shiying at Yuhang, and Hotoo defeated Fang Guo'an at Fuyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Zhumarha defeated Ma Shiying at Yuhang, and Hotoo defeated Fang Guo'an at Fuyang.

sentences.zh: 士英、國安復窺杭州，梅勒章京濟席哈等擊走之。

translations.literal: Shiying and Guo'an again watched for an opening at Hangzhou; Meire Janggin Jixihaha and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Shiying and Guo'an probed Hangzhou again; Meire Janggin Jixihaha and others drove them back.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以何洛會為定西大將軍，遣巴顏、李國翰帥師會之，討四川流賊張獻忠。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: appointed Hošoi Grand General Who Pacifies the West, and dispatched Bayan and Li Guohan with armies to join him in campaigning against the Sichuan bandit Zhang Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Hošoi was made Grand General Who Pacifies the West; Bayan and Li Guohan were sent with armies to join him against the Sichuan rebel Zhang Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以陳之龍為鳳陽巡撫。

translations.literal: Wuyin day: appointed Chen Zhilong Fengyang Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Chen Zhilong was made Governor of Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jimao first day of the month: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，故明閣部黃道周寇徽州，洪承疇遣張天祿擊敗之。

translations.literal: Yiyou day: the former Ming Grand Secretary Huang Daozhou raided Huizhou; Hong Chengchou sent Zhang Tianlu to defeat him.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the former Ming Grand Secretary Huang Daozhou attacked Huizhou; Hong Chengchou sent Zhang Tianlu to defeat him.

sentences.zh: 故明總兵高進忠率所部自崇明來降。

translations.literal: The former Ming brigade-general Gao Jinzhong led his command to surrender from Chongming.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming brigadier Gao Jinzhong surrendered from Chongming with his troops.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，佟養和、金聲桓進討福建，分兵攻南贛，敗故明永寧王、羅川王、閣部黃道周等數十萬眾。

translations.literal: Guisi day: Tong Yanghe and Jin Shengheng advanced to campaign in Fujian, detached troops to attack Southern Gan, and defeated the former Ming Princes of Yongning and Luochuan, Grand Secretary Huang Daozhou, and others—a host of several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Tong Yanghe and Jin Shengheng marched into Fujian, sent columns against Southern Gan, and routed the former Ming Princes of Yongning and Luochuan, Grand Secretary Huang Daozhou, and others—forces numbering in the hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 丙午，更定朝儀，始罷內監朝參。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: court ceremonial was revised anew; eunuchs were first barred from attending court audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, court ritual was revised, and palace eunuchs were for the first time excluded from morning audience.

sentences.zh: 丁未，朱瑪喇等敗方國安、馬士英於浙東。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: Zhu Mala and others defeated Fang Guo'an and Ma Shiying in eastern Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Zhu Mala and others defeated Fang Guo'an and Ma Shiying in eastern Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 固原賊武大定作亂，總兵官何世元等死之。

translations.literal: The bandit Wu Dading of Guyuan raised rebellion; Commander-in-Chief He Shiyuan and others died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dading, a rebel of Guyuan, rose in revolt; Commander He Shiyuan and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮，歸化城土默特部章京古祿格，鄂爾多斯部喇嘛塔爾尼齊，烏朱穆秦部車臣親王，席北部額爾格訥，喀爾喀部土謝圖汗、古倫迪瓦胡土克圖喇嘛、石勒圖胡土克圖、嘛哈撒馬諦塞臣汗，厄魯特部顧實汗子多爾濟達賴巴圖魯台吉及回回國，天方國俱來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea; Guluge, janggin of the Guihuacheng Tumed; the lama Tarni of the Ordos; the Chechen Wang of the Ujimqin; Ergene of the Xibu; the Tüshe Wang, the Gurun Diwa Hutuktu Lama, the Shiretu Hutuktu, and the Mahasamadi Sechen Khan of the Khalkha; Dorji Dalai Batür Taiji, son of Gush Khan of the Oirat; and the Hui states and the Tianfang state all came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Korea; Guluge, janggin of the Guihuacheng Tumed; the Ordos lama Tarni; the Ujimqin Chechen wang; Ergene of the Xibu; the Khalkha Tüshe khan, Gurun Diwa hutuktu lama, Shiretu hutuktu, and Mahasamadi Sechen khan; Dorji Dalai Batür taiji, son of Gush Khan of the Oirats; and from the Muslim states and Tianfang.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮四至。

translations.literal: Korea [presented records of] the four boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Korea submitted a register of its territorial bounds.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月戊午，貝勒勒克德渾遣將敗流賊於臨湘，進克岳州。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, wuwu day: Prince Lekedehun sent generals to defeat roving bandits at Linxiang and advanced to take Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the wuwu day of the first spring month, Prince Lekedehun's generals defeated bandits at Linxiang and captured Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，固山額真阿山、譚泰有罪，阿山免職，下譚泰於獄。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: Gushan Ejen Ashan and Tantai were guilty; Ashan was removed from office and Tantai was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Banner Commanders Ashan and Tantai were found guilty; Ashan was dismissed and Tantai jailed.

sentences.zh: 流賊賀珍、孫守法、胡向化犯西安，何洛會等擊敗之。

translations.literal: Roving bandits He Zhen, Sun Shoufa, and Hu Xianghua attacked Xi'an; Heluohe and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits He Zhen, Sun Shoufa, and Hu Xianghua struck Xi'an; Heluohe and others drove them off.

sentences.zh: 金聲桓遣將攻故明永寧王於撫州，獲之，並獲其子朱孳榮等，遂平建昌。

translations.literal: Jin Shengheng sent generals to attack the former Ming Prince of Yongning at Fuzhou, captured him together with his son Zhu Zirong and others, and then pacified Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shengheng sent generals against the former Ming Prince of Yongning at Fuzhou, took him and his son Zhu Zirong, and pacified Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，故明潞安王、瑞昌王率眾犯江寧，侍郎巴山等擊敗之。

translations.literal: Bingyin day: the former Ming Princes of Lu'an and Ruichang led masses to attack Jiangning; Vice Minister Bashan and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the former Ming Princes of Lu'an and Ruichang attacked Jiangning with a large force; Vice Minister Bashan and others repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以宋權為國史院大學士。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: Song Quan was made Grand Academician of the Historiographical Institute.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Song Quan was appointed grand academician of the Historiographical Institute.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以肅親王豪格為靖遠大將軍，暨多羅衍禧郡王羅洛宏、貝勒尼堪、貝子屯齊喀、滿達海等帥師征四川。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Prince Su Hooge was made Grand General Who Pacifies the Distant, together with Prince of the Commandery Luoluo Hong, Beile Nikan, Beizi Tunqika, Mandahai, and others to command an army to campaign in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Prince Su Hooge was made Grand General Who Pacifies the Distant and, with Prince Luoluo Hong, Beile Nikan, Beizi Tunqika, Mandahai, and others, took command of the Sichuan expedition.

sentences.zh: 故明唐王朱聿釗兵犯徽州，洪承疇遣張天祿等擊敗之，獲其閣部黃道周殺之，進克開化。

translations.literal: The former Ming Tang Prince Zhu Yuzhao's army attacked Huizhou; Hong Chengchou sent Zhang Tianlu and others to defeat him, captured his Grand Secretary Huang Daozhou and executed him, and advanced to take Kaihua.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming Tang Prince Zhu Yuzhao attacked Huizhou; Hong Chengchou sent Zhang Tianlu to defeat him, seized Huang Daozhou and put him to death, and took Kaihua.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，貝勒勒克德渾破流賊於荊州，奉國將軍巴布泰等追至襄陽，斬獲殆盡。

translations.literal: Second month, jimao day: Prince Lekedehun broke the bandits at Jingzhou; State-Founding General Babutai and others pursued to Xiangyang and killed or captured nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the second month, Prince Lekedehun routed the bandits at Jingzhou; State-Founding General Babutai pursued to Xiangyang and all but annihilated them.

sentences.zh: 大軍進次夷陵，李自成弟李孜等以其眾來降。

translations.literal: The main army halted at Yiling; Li Zi, younger brother of Li Zicheng, came to surrender with his following.
translations.idiomatic: The main force camped at Yiling; Li Zicheng's brother Li Zi surrendered with his troops.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，免密雲荒賦。

translations.literal: Xinsi day: remitted wasteland tax assessments of Miyun.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, wasteland taxes of Miyun were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，罷江南舊設部院，差在京戶、兵、工三部滿、漢侍郎各一人駐江寧，分理部務。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: abolished the old Jiangnan provincial bureaus; dispatched one Manchu and one Han vice minister each from the capital Boards of Revenue, War, and Works to garrison Jiangning and divide departmental affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the former Jiangnan ministries were abolished; one Manchu and one Han vice minister each from the capital Boards of Revenue, War, and Works were posted to Jiangning to handle their respective duties.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，明魯王將劉福援撫州，梅勒章京屯泰擊敗之。

translations.literal: Yiyou day: the former Ming Lu Prince's general Liu Fu came to relieve Fuzhou; Meire Janggin Tun Tai defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the former Ming Prince of Lu's general Liu Fu marched to relieve Fuzhou; Meire Janggin Tun Tai defeated him.

sentences.zh: 何洛會遣將破流賊劉文炳於蒲城，賊渠賀珍奔武功。

translations.literal: Heluohe sent generals to defeat the bandit Liu Wenbing at Pucheng; the bandit chieftain He Zhen fled to Wugong.
translations.idiomatic: Heluohe's generals defeated the bandit Liu Wenbing at Pucheng; the rebel chief He Zhen fled to Wugong.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以柳寅東為順天巡撫。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: Liu Yindong was made Xun-Tian Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Liu Yindong was made governor of Xun-Tian.

sentences.zh: 命肅親王豪格分兵赴南陽，討流賊二隻虎、郝如海等。

translations.literal: Ordered Prince Su Hooge to detach troops for Nanyang to suppress the bandits called the Two Tigers, Hao Ruhai, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Su Hooge was ordered to send a column to Nanyang against the bandits known as the Two Tigers, Hao Ruhai, and others.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣侍郎巴山、梅勒章京張大猷率師鎮守江寧，甲喇章京傅誇蟾、梅勒章京李思忠率師鎮守西安。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: dispatched Vice Minister Bashan and Meire Janggin Zhang Dayou with armies to garrison Jiangning; Jalan Janggin Fu Kuachan and Meire Janggin Li Sizhong with armies to garrison Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Vice Minister Bashan and Meire Janggin Zhang Dayou were sent to garrison Jiangning; Jalan Janggin Fu Kuachan and Meire Janggin Li Sizhong to garrison Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 潛山、太湖賊首石應璉擁故明樊山王朱常闒為亂，洪承疇遣將擊斬之。

translations.literal: The bandit chieftain Shi Yinglian of Qianshan and Taihu supported the former Ming Prince of Fanshan Zhu Changque in rebellion; Hong Chengchou sent generals to attack and behead him.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yinglian, a rebel chief of Qianshan and Taihu, set up the former Ming Prince of Fanshan Zhu Changque; Hong Chengchou's generals attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命貝勒博洛為征南大將軍，同圖賴率師征福建、浙江。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: ordered Beile Boluo Grand General Who Conquers the South, together with Tulai to lead armies to campaign in Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Beile Boluo was made Grand General Who Conquers the South and, with Tulai, ordered into Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，譯《洪武寶訓》成，頒行中外。

translations.literal: Third month, xinhai day: the translation of the Hongwu Precious Instructions was completed and promulgated within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the third month, the translated Hongwu Precious Instructions were finished and issued throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免近京居民田宅圈給旗人別行撥補者租賦一年。

translations.literal: Yimao day: remitted one year's rent for lands near the capital whose dwellings had been encircled and allotted to Banner people and replaced from other holdings.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, one year's rent was waived for metropolitan householders whose property had been taken for Banner allotments and compensated elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，何洛會敗賊劉體純于山陽。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: Heluohe defeated the bandit Liu Tichun at Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Heluohe defeated the bandit Liu Tichun at Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，以王來用總督山、陝、四川糧餉，馬鳴佩總督江南諸省糧儲。

translations.literal: Jiwei day: Wang Laiyong was made grain intendant-general of Shan, Shaan, and Sichuan; Ma Mingpei grain intendant-general of the Jiangnan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Wang Laiyong was made grain intendant for Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Sichuan; Ma Mingpei for the Jiangnan provinces.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜傅以漸等進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Yichou day: Fu Yijian and other jinshi were granted differing ranks in the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Fu Yijian and other metropolitan graduates were ranked in the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 己巳，何洛會擊賊二隻虎於商州，大敗之。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Heluohe attacked the bandit Two Tigers at Shangzhou and routed him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Heluohe met the bandit Two Tigers at Shangzhou and routed him.

sentences.zh: 昌平民王科等盜發明帝陵，伏誅。

translations.literal: Changping commoner Wang Ke and others illicitly opened the tomb of the Ming emperor and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ke of Changping and others robbed the Ming imperial tomb and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 壬申，多羅饒餘郡王阿巴泰薨。

translations.literal: Renshen day: Prince Raoyu Abatai died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Prince Raoyu Abatai died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封烏朱穆秦部塞冷、蒿齊忒部薄羅特為貝勒，阿霸垓部多爾濟為貝子。

translations.literal: Guiyou day: enfeoffed Saileng of the Ujimqin and Borote of the Haoqite as beile, and Dorji of the Abagai as beizi.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Saileng of the Ujimqin and Borote of the Haoqite were made beile, and Dorji of the Abagai beizi.

sentences.zh: 豪格師抵西安，遣工部尚書興能敗賊於邠州，固山額真杜雷敗賊於慶陽。

translations.literal: Hooge's army reached Xi'an; he dispatched Minister of Works Xingneng to defeat bandits at Binzhou, and Gushan Ejen Duloi to defeat bandits at Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Hooge reached Xi'an; Minister of Works Xingneng defeated bandits at Binzhou, and Banner Commander Duloi at Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 故明大學士張四知自江南來降。

translations.literal: The former Ming Grand Secretary Zhang Sizhi came to surrender from Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming grand secretary Zhang Sizhi surrendered from Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，詔貝勒勒克德渾班師，孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜、沈志祥各統所部來京。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jimao day: ordered Prince Lekedehun to withdraw the army; Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, and Shen Zhixiang each led their commands to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fourth summer month, Prince Lekedehun was ordered to withdraw; Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, and Shen Zhixiang each brought their troops to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免錢塘、仁和間架稅。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: remitted the jianjia surcharge tax of Qiantang and Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the jianjia surcharge of Qiantang and Renhe was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命今年八月再行鄉試，明年二月再行會試。

translations.literal: Yiyou day: ordered the provincial examination to be held again this eighth month and the metropolitan examination next second month.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the provincial examination was ordered for the eighth month and the metropolitan examination for the second month of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免睢州、祥符等四州縣災賦。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Suizhou, Xiangfu, and four other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, disaster taxes were remitted in Suizhou, Xiangfu, and four other prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 戊子，除貫耳穿鼻之刑。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: abolished the punishments of piercing the ear and boring the nose.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, ear-piercing and nose-boring punishments were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，除明季加徵太平府姑溪橋米稅、金柱山商稅、安慶府鹽稅。

translations.literal: Guisi day: abolished the Ming-period surcharges of Guxi Bridge rice tax at Taiping Prefecture, Jinzhu Mountain commercial tax, and Anqing salt tax.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Ming surcharges—the Guxi Bridge rice levy at Taiping, the Jinzhu Mountain trade tax, and the Anqing salt tax—were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免靜海、興濟、青縣荒賦。

translations.literal: Yiwei day: remitted wasteland tax assessments of Jinghai, Xingji, and Qing County.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, wasteland taxes were remitted in Jinghai, Xingji, and Qing County.

sentences.zh: 丙申，江西浮梁、餘干賊合閩賊犯饒州，副將鄧雲龍等擊敗之。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: bandits of Fuliang and Yugan in Jiangxi joined Fujian bandits to attack Raozhou; Vice General Deng Yunlong and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, rebels of Fuliang and Yugan in Jiangxi allied with Fujian bandits against Raozhou; Vice General Deng Yunlong and others defeated them.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，攝政王多爾袞諭停諸王大臣啟本。

translations.literal: Wuxu day: Prince Regent Dorgon ordered a halt to memorial submissions by princes and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Prince Regent Dorgon forbade princes and senior ministers from submitting memorials.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以張尚為寧夏巡撫。

translations.literal: Jihai day: Zhang Shang was made Ningxia Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Zhang Shang was made governor of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 罷織造太監。

translations.literal: Abolished the office of the imperial weaving eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: The palace weaving eunuchs were abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，諭曰：「比者蠲除明季橫徵苛稅，與民休息。

translations.literal: Xinchou day: an edict said: "Of late we have abolished the Ming-period irregular levies and harsh taxes so the people may rest.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, an edict said: "We have lately swept away Ming irregular levies and harsh taxes so the people may recover.

sentences.zh: 而貪墨之吏，惡其害己而去其籍，是使朝廷德意不下究，而明季弊政不終釐也。

translations.literal: Yet corrupt officials, hating that this harmed their interests, removed the entries from the registers—thus preventing the court's gracious intent from reaching below and leaving Ming abuses uncorrected to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Yet greedy officials, seeing their profit threatened, struck items from the registers, so the court's grace never reached the ground and Ming abuses were never fully cleared.

sentences.zh: 茲命大臣嚴加察核，並飭所司詳定賦役全書，頒行天下。

translations.literal: We now order great ministers to investigate strictly, and also instruct the relevant offices to compile in detail the complete book of tax and corvée and promulgate it throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: We now command senior ministers to investigate rigorously and direct the offices to compile the full register of taxes and labor service and issue it empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 」諭汰府縣冗員。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the reduction of redundant prefectural and county posts.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict also ordered redundant prefectural and county posts cut.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，修盛京孔子廟。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: repaired the Confucian temple at Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the Confucian temple at Shengjing was repaired.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，蘇尼特部騰機思、騰機特、吳班代、多爾濟思喀布、蟒悟思、額爾密克、石達等各率所部叛奔喀爾喀部碩雷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingwei day: Tengjisi, Tengjite, Wubandai, Dorjisikabu, Mangwusi, Ermiike, Shida, and others of the Sunite each led their tribes in rebellion and fled to join Sure of the Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the fifth month, Tengjisi, Tengjite, Wubandai, Dorjisikabu, Mangwusi, Ermiike, Shida, and other Sunite chiefs rebelled with their tribes and fled to the Khalkha chief Sure.

sentences.zh: 命德豫親王多鐸為揚威大將軍，同承澤郡王碩塞等率師會外籓蒙古兵討之。

translations.literal: Ordered Prince Dodo the Virtuous of Yu Grand General Who Displays Might, together with Prince Chenze Suose and others, to lead armies and join outer-banner Mongol troops in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dodo of Yu was made Grand General Who Displays Might and, with Prince Chenze Suose and others, ordered to take Mongol auxiliaries and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 四子部溫卜、達爾漢卓禮克圖、多克新等追斬吳班代等五台吉。

translations.literal: Wenbu, Darhan Jolaktu, and Duokexin of the Four Sons' Division pursued and beheaded Wubandai and five other taijis.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbu, Darhan Jolaktu, and Duokexin of the Four Sons' banner pursued and killed Wubandai and five other taijis.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，申隱匿逃人律。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: the law on concealing fugitives was tightened.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, penalties for harboring runaway bondsmen were increased.

sentences.zh: 戊午，金聲桓克南贛，獲其帥劉廣胤。

translations.literal: Wuwu day: Jin Shengheng took Southern Gan and captured its commander Liu Guangyin.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Jin Shengheng captured Southern Gan and seized its commander Liu Guangyin.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，豪格遣巴顏、李國翰敗賊於延安。

translations.literal: Jiwei day: Hooge sent Bayan and Li Guohan to defeat bandits at Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Hooge sent Bayan and Li Guohan to rout bandits at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，故明魯王、荊王、衡王世子等十一人謀亂，伏誅。

translations.literal: Gengshen day: the former Ming Prince of Lu, Prince of Jing, Prince of Heng, and eleven princely sons plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the former Ming Princes of Lu, Jing, and Heng and eleven princely sons were executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以葉克書為昂邦章京，鎮守盛京。

translations.literal: Xinhai day: Yekešu was made Angbang Janggin to garrison Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Yekešu was made Angbang Janggin to hold Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 豪格遣貝勒尼堪等敗賊賀珍於雞頭關，遂克漢中，珍走西鄉。

translations.literal: Hooge sent Beile Nikan and others to defeat the bandit He Zhen at Jitou Pass, then took Hanzhong; Zhen fled to Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hooge sent Beile Nikan to defeat He Zhen at Jitou Pass and take Hanzhong; Zhen fled to Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，貝勒博洛遣圖賴等擊敗故明魯王將方國安於錢塘。

translations.literal: Yichou day: Beile Boluo sent Tulai and others to defeat the former Ming Lu Prince's general Fang Guo'an at Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Beile Boluo sent Tulai to defeat the former Ming Prince of Lu's general Fang Guo'an at Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 魯王朱彝垓遁保台州。

translations.literal: The Lu Prince Zhu Yijia fled to hold Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Lu Zhu Yijia withdrew to Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，官軍至漢陰，流賊二隻虎奔四川，孫守法奔岳科寨。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: government troops reached Hanyin; the bandit Two Tigers fled to Sichuan and Sun Shoufa to Yueke Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the army reached Hanyin; the bandit Two Tigers fled to Sichuan and Sun Shoufa to Yueke Stockade.

sentences.zh: 巴顏、李國翰追延安賊至張果老崖敗之。

translations.literal: Bayan and Li Guohan pursued Yan'an bandits to Zhangguolaoyai and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan and Li Guohan pursued Yan'an bandits to Zhangguolaoyai and routed them.

sentences.zh: 辛未，免沛、蕭二縣元、二年荒賦之半。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: remitted half the wasteland tax assessments of the first and second years in Pei and Xiao counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, half the first- and second-year wasteland taxes of Pei and Xiao counties were remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，免懷柔縣荒賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuyin day: remitted wasteland tax assessments of Huairou County.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the sixth month, wasteland taxes of Huairou County were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禁白蓮、大成、混元、無為等教。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: banned the White Lotus, Great Completion, Mixed Origin, Non-Action, and related sects.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the White Lotus, Great Completion, Mixed Origin, Non-Action, and kindred sects were proscribed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以高士俊為湖廣巡撫。

translations.literal: Renchen day: Gao Shijun was made Huguang Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Gao Shijun was made governor of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，張存仁遣將擒故明大學士馬士英及長興伯吳日生等斬之。

translations.literal: Yiwei day: Zhang Cunren sent generals to seize the former Ming Grand Secretary Ma Shiying and the Changxing Earl Wu Risheng and others and behead them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Zhang Cunren's generals captured the former Ming grand secretary Ma Shiying, the Earl of Changxing Wu Risheng, and others and executed them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，貝勒勒克德渾師還。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiayin day: Prince Lekedehun's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the seventh month, Prince Lekedehun's army returned.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，多鐸破騰機思等於毆特克山，斬其台吉毛害，渡土喇河擊斬騰機思子多爾濟等，盡獲其家口輜重。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: Dodo defeated Tengjisi and others at Outek Mountain, beheaded the taiji Maohai, crossed the Tula River and attacked and killed Tengjisi's son Dorji and others, and captured all their families and baggage.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Dodo defeated Tengjisi at Outek Mountain, killed the taiji Maohai, crossed the Tula, slew Tengjisi's son Dorji and others, and seized their families and baggage.

sentences.zh: 又敗喀爾喀部土謝圖汗二子於查濟布喇克上游。

translations.literal: He also defeated the two sons of the Khalkha Tüshe Khan at the upper reaches of Zhajibulake.
translations.idiomatic: He also routed the two sons of the Khalkha Tüshe khan on the upper Zhajibulake.

sentences.zh: 戊午，碩雷子陣查濟布喇克道口，貝子博和託等復大敗之。

translations.literal: Wuwu day: Sure's son formed battle lines at the Zhajibulake crossing; Beizi Bohetuo and others again defeated him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Sure's son drew up at the Zhajibulake ford; Beizi Bohetuo and others routed him again.

sentences.zh: 碩雷以餘眾走塞冷格。

translations.literal: Sure fled with the remnant host to Sailengge.
translations.idiomatic: Sure fled with the survivors to Sailengge.

sentences.zh: 庚申，李國翰、圖賴等拔張果老崖。

translations.literal: Gengshen day: Li Guohan, Tulai, and others took Zhangguolaoyai.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Li Guohan, Tulai, and others captured Zhangguolaoyai.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，江西巡撫李翔鳳進正一真人符四十幅。

translations.literal: Renshen day: Jiangxi Governor Li Xiangfeng presented forty talisman scrolls of the Zhengyi Perfected Man.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Jiangxi Governor Li Xiangfeng presented forty Taoist talismans of the Zhengyi lineage.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「致福之道，在敬天勤民，安所事此，其置之。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The way to secure blessing lies in revering Heaven and toiling for the people—why resort to this? Let it be set aside.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Blessing comes from revering Heaven and laboring for the people—of what use is this? Put it away.

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，豪格遣貝子滿達海、輔國公哈爾楚渾、固山額真准塔趨徽州、階州分討流賊武大定、高如礪、蔣登雷、石國璽、王可臣等，破之。

translations.literal: " Wuchen day: Hooge sent Beizi Mandahai, Assistant State Defender Hartuhun, and Gushan Ejen Zhuntata toward Huizhou and Jiezhou to divide forces and suppress the bandits Wu Dading, Gao Ruli, Jiang Denglei, Shi Guoxi, Wang Kechen, and others, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Hooge sent Beizi Mandahai, Assistant State Defender Hartuhun, and Banner Commander Zhuntata toward Huizhou and Jiezhou to divide forces against the bandits Wu Dading, Gao Ruli, Jiang Denglei, Shi Guoxi, Wang Kechen, and others and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 如礪遁，登雷、國璽、可臣俱降。

translations.literal: Ruli fled; Denglei, Guoxi, and Kechen all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Ruli fled; Denglei, Guoxi, and Kechen all submitted.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，多羅衍禧郡王羅洛宏薨于軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingzi day: Prince of the Commandery Luoluo Hong died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the eighth month, Prince Luoluo Hong died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，豪格遣纛章京哈寧阿攻武大定於三台山，拔之。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: Hooge sent Dasan Janggin Haning'a to attack Wu Dading at Santaishan and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Hooge sent Dasan Janggin Haning'a against Wu Dading at Santaishan and captured the position.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，博洛克金華、衢州，殺故明蜀王朱盛濃、樂安王朱誼石及其將吳凱、項鳴斯等，其大學士謝三賓、閣部宋之普、兵部尚書阮大鋮、刑部尚書蘇壯等降。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: Boluo took Jinhua and Quzhou, killed the former Ming Prince of Shu Zhu Shengnong, Prince of Le'an Zhu Yishi, and their generals Wu Kai and Xiang Mingsi, and the grand secretary Xie Sanbin, Grand Secretary Song Zhipu, Minister of War Ruan Dacheng, Minister of Punishments Su Zhuang, and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Boluo captured Jinhua and Quzhou, killed the former Ming Princes of Shu and Le'an Zhu Shengnong and Zhu Yishi and their generals Wu Kai and Xiang Mingsi, while grand secretary Xie Sanbin, Song Zhipu, Ruan Dacheng, Su Zhuang, and others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 浙江平。

translations.literal: Zhejiang was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang was pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以孔有德為平南大將軍，同耿仲明、沈志祥、金礪、佟代率師征湖廣、廣東、廣西。
