translations.literal: Wuzi day: Kong Youde was made Grand General Who Pacifies the South, together with Geng Zhongming, Shen Zhixiang, Jin Li, and Tongdai to lead armies to campaign in Huguang, Guangdong, and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Kong Youde was made Grand General Who Pacifies the South and, with Geng Zhongming, Shen Zhixiang, Jin Li, and Tongdai, ordered into Huguang, Guangdong, and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 免太湖、潛山二年及今年荒賦。

translations.literal: Remitted the second-year and this year's wasteland tax assessments of Taihu and Qianshan.
translations.idiomatic: Second-year and current wasteland taxes of Taihu and Qianshan were remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命尚可喜率師從孔有德南討。

translations.literal: Guisi day: ordered Shang Kexi to lead troops to follow Kong Youde south in punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Shang Kexi was ordered to march south with Kong Youde.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，故明瑞昌王朱誼氻謀攻江寧，官兵討斬之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiyou day: the former Ming Prince of Ruichang Zhu Yisi plotted to attack Jiangning; government troops suppressed and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the ninth month, the former Ming Prince of Ruichang Zhu Yisi plotted against Jiangning; government troops killed him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免夷陵、石首等十三州縣荒賦十之七，荊門、江陵等四州縣十之五，興國、廣濟等十六州縣十之三。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: remitted seven-tenths of wasteland tax assessments of thirteen prefectures and counties including Yiling and Shishou; five-tenths of Jingmen, Jiangling, and four others; three-tenths of sixteen including Xingguo and Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, wasteland taxes were remitted seven-tenths in thirteen prefectures and counties including Yiling and Shishou, five-tenths in Jingmen, Jiangling, and four others, and three-tenths in sixteen including Xingguo and Guangji.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，故明崇陽王攻歙縣，副將張成功等敗之。

translations.literal: Bingyin day: the former Ming Prince of Chongyang attacked She County; Vice General Zhang Chenggong and others defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the former Ming Prince of Chongyang attacked She County; Vice General Zhang Chenggong and others repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，故明督師何騰蛟等攻岳州，官軍擊敗之。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: the former Ming supreme commander He Tengjiao and others attacked Yuezhou; government troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the former Ming supreme commander He Tengjiao and others attacked Yuezhou; government troops drove them off.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，鄭四維等克夷陵、枝江、宜都，改湖廣承天府為安陸府。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingzi day: Zheng Siwei and others took Yiling, Zhijiang, and Yidu; Huguang's Chengtian Prefecture was renamed Anlu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the tenth month, Zheng Siwei and others captured Yiling, Zhijiang, and Yidu; Chengtian Prefecture in Huguang was renamed Anlu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，和碩德豫親王多鐸師還，上郊勞之。

translations.literal: Jimao day: Prince Dodo the Virtuous of Yu's army returned; the Emperor went to the suburbs to welcome and reward him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Prince Dodo's army returned; the emperor went out to the suburbs to welcome and honor him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金聲桓遣將擒故明王朱常洊及其黨了悟等，誅之。

translations.literal: Xinsi day: Jin Shengheng sent generals to seize the former Ming prince Zhu Changxun and his partisan Liaowu and others and execute them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Jin Shengheng's generals captured the former Ming prince Zhu Changxun and his follower Liaowu and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以胡全才為寧夏巡撫，章於天為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: Hu Quancai was made Ningxia Governor and Zhang Yutian Jiangxi Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Hu Quancai was made governor of Ningxia and Zhang Yutian governor of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 金聲桓遣將克贛州，獲故明閣部楊廷麟殺之。

translations.literal: Jin Shengheng sent generals to take Ganzhou, captured the former Ming Grand Secretary Yang Tinglin and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shengheng's generals took Ganzhou, seized the former Ming grand secretary Yang Tinglin, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以李棲鳳為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Guisi day: Li Qifeng was made Anhui Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Li Qifeng was made governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免懷寧等四縣災賦。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Huaining and four other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, disaster taxes were remitted in Huaining and four other counties.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免延綏、庄浪災賦。

translations.literal: Jihai day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Yan-sui and Zhuanglang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, disaster taxes were remitted in Yan-sui and Zhuanglang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太和宮、中和宮成。

translations.literal: Renyin day: the Taihe Palace and Zhonghe Palace were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the Taihe and Zhonghe palaces were completed.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯朔，貝勒博洛自浙江分軍進取福建，圖賴等敗故明閣部黃鳴駿於仙霞關，遂克浦城、建寧、延平。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guimao new moon: Beile Boluo from Zhejiang divided his army to advance into Fujian; Eidu and others defeated former Ming Grand Secretary Huang Mingjun's forces at Xianxia Pass, then took Pucheng, Jianning, and Yanping.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon of the eleventh month, Prince Boluo detached forces from Zhejiang into Fujian; Eidu routed the former Ming grand secretary Huang Mingjun at Xianxia Pass and took Pucheng, Jianning, and Yanping.

sentences.zh: 故明唐王朱聿釗走汀州，阿濟格尼堪等追斬之，遂定汀州、漳州、泉州、興化，進克福州，悉降其眾。

translations.literal: The former Ming Tang Prince Zhu Yujian fled to Tingzhou; Ajige, Nikan, and others pursued and beheaded him, then pacified Tingzhou, Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, and Xinghua, advanced to take Fuzhou, and all the enemy submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming Tang Prince Zhu Yujian fled to Tingzhou; Ajige, Nikan, and others ran him down and beheaded him, pacified Tingzhou, Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, and Xinghua, took Fuzhou, and received the surrender of the whole region.

sentences.zh: 福建平。

translations.literal: Fujian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian was pacified.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免河間、任丘及大同災賦。

translations.literal: Guichou day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Hejian, Renqiu, and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, disaster tax assessments were remitted in Hejian, Renqiu, and Datong.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 己巳，豪格師至南部，時張獻忠列寨西充，鰲拜等兼程進擊，大破之，斬獻忠於陣，復分兵擊餘賊，破一百三十餘營。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Hooge's army reached the southern sector; at this time Zhang Xianzhong had encamped at Xichong; Oboi and others marched day and night to attack, inflicted a great defeat, and beheaded Xianzhong in battle; they then divided forces to strike the remaining bandits and broke more than 130 camps.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Prince Hooge's army reached the southern front; Zhang Xianzhong had drawn up camps at Xichong; Oboi and others forced the march, routed him utterly, and slew him in battle, then scattered detachments against the remnant rebels and destroyed more than 130 stockades.

sentences.zh: 四川平。

translations.literal: Sichuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉朔，故明遂平王朱紹鯤及其黨楊權等擁兵太湖，結海寇為亂，副將詹世勛等討斬之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guiyou new moon: the former Ming Prince of Suiping Zhu Shaoqi and his faction Yang Quan and others held arms at Taihu, joined sea raiders in rebellion; Vice-general Zhan Shixun and others campaigned and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon of the twelfth month, the former Ming Prince of Suiping Zhu Shaoqi and his follower Yang Quan raised troops on Taihu and allied with sea pirates; Vice-general Zhan Shixun attacked and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，山東賊謝遷攻陷高苑，總兵官海時行討平之。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: Shandong bandit Xie Qian attacked and took Gaoyuan; Commander Hai Shixing suppressed and pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the Shandong rebel Xie Qian seized Gaoyuan; Commander Hai Shixing put the disturbance down.

sentences.zh: 壬午，故明高安王朱常淇及其黨江於東等起兵婺源，張天祿討平之。

translations.literal: Renwu day: the former Ming Prince of Gao'an Zhu Changqi and his faction Jiang Yudong and others raised troops at Wuyuan; Zhang Tianlu suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the former Ming Prince of Gao'an Zhu Changqi and Jiang Yudong and others rose at Wuyuan; Zhang Tianlu suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以於清廉為保定巡撫，劉武元為南贛巡撫，免薊、豐潤等五州縣災賦。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: appointed Yu Qinglian Baoding Governor, Liu Wuyuan Southern Gan Governor; remitted disaster tax assessments of Ji, Fengrun, and five other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Yu Qinglian was made Governor of Baoding and Liu Wuyuan Governor of Southern Gan; disaster taxes were remitted in Ji, Fengrun, and five other districts.

sentences.zh: 甲午，位育宮成。

translations.literal: Jiawu day: the Palace of Enfolding Cultivation was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the Palace of Enfolding Cultivation was completed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，明金華王朱由搵起兵饒州，官軍擊斬之。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: the former Ming Prince of Jinhua Zhu Youwen raised troops at Raozhou; government troops attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the former Ming Prince of Jinhua Zhu Youwen rebelled at Raozhou; government forces attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮，蒙古及歸化城土默特部古祿格，厄魯特部多爾濟達來巴圖魯、顧實汗，喀爾喀部買達里胡土克圖、額爾德尼哈談巴圖魯、戴青哈談巴圖魯、青台吉，科爾沁部多羅冰圖郡王塞冷，蒿齊忒部多羅貝勒額爾德尼，索倫部、使鹿部喇巴奇，鄂爾多斯部濟農台吉查木蘇，庫爾喀部賴達庫及達賴喇嘛，吐魯番俱來貢。

translations.literal: That year Korea, Mongolia, Guluge of the Tumed tribe of Guihua city, Dorji Davachi and Gushan Khan of the Oirat tribe, the Khalkha Buyan Delighu Khutukhtu, Erdeni Khutukhtu, Daichin Khutukhtu, Qing Taiji, Prince Sainang Dobon of Horqin, Doroi Beile Erdeni of Khorchin, the Solon tribe, the Shilu tribe Labachi, Jinong Chamsu of Ordos, Lada of Kurka, the Dalai Lama, and Turfan all came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Korea, Mongolia, Guluge of the Guihua Tumed, the Oirat Dorji Davachi and Gushan Khan, several Khalkha khutukhtus and nobles, Horqin and Khorchin princes, the Solon and Shilu tribes, the Ordos jinong, Kurka, the Dalai Lama, and Turfan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、厄魯特顧實汗、達賴喇嘛皆再至。

translations.literal: Korea, the Oirat Gushan Khan, and the Dalai Lama all came again.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, the Oirat Gushan Khan, and the Dalai Lama all sent tribute again.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月戊申，輔國公鞏阿岱、內大臣吳拜等征宣府。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, wushen day: Defender of the State Gongadai and Inner Minister Wu Bai and others campaigned to Xuande.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the first month of the fourth year, Defender of the State Gongadai and Inner Minister Wu Bai marched against Xuande.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命副都統董阿賴率師駐防杭州。

translations.literal: Renzi day: ordered Vice Banner Commander Dong Alai to lead troops to garrison and defend Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Vice Banner Commander Dong Alai was ordered to garrison Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 興國州賊柯抱沖結故明總督何騰蛟攻陷興國。

translations.literal: Xingguo bandit Ke Baochong joined former Ming Governor-General He Tengjiao, attacked and took Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: The Xingguo rebel Ke Baochong allied with the former Ming governor-general He Tengjiao and seized Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 總兵官柯永盛遣將擒抱沖及其黨陳珩玉斬之。

translations.literal: Commander Ke Yongsheng sent generals to capture Baochong and his follower Chen Hengyu and behead them.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Ke Yongsheng sent officers who seized Baochong and his lieutenant Chen Hengyu and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以楊聲遠為淮揚總督，黃爾性為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Yimao day: appointed Yang Shengyuan Huai-Yang Governor-General, Huang Erxing Shaanxi Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Yang Shengyuan was made Governor-General of Huai and Yang, and Huang Erxing Governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以朱國柱為登萊巡撫。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: appointed Zhu Guozhu Denglai Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Zhu Guozhu was made Governor of Denglai.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，陝西官軍擊延慶賊郭君鎮、終南賊孫守法，敗之。

translations.literal: Renxu day: Shaanxi government troops attacked Yanqing bandit Guo Junzhen and Zhongnan bandit Sun Shoufa and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Shaanxi troops defeated the Yanqing rebel Guo Junzhen and the Zhongnan rebel Sun Shoufa.

sentences.zh: 洪承疇遣將擊賊帥趙正，大破之。

translations.literal: Hong Chengchong sent generals to attack bandit chief Zhao Zheng and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chengchong sent generals against the bandit chief Zhao Zheng and routed him.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，以張儒秀為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Second month, guiyou day: appointed Zhang Ruxiu Shandong Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the second month, Zhang Ruxiu was made Governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，佟養甲平梧州。

translations.literal: Yihai day: Tong Yangjia pacified Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Tong Yangjia pacified Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，副將王平等擊賀珍、劉二虎賊黨於興安，敗之。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: Vice-general Wang Ping and others attacked the bandit followers of He Zhen and Liu Erhu at Xing'an and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Vice-general Wang Ping and others defeated the followers of He Zhen and Liu Erhu at Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔曰：「朕平定中原，惟浙東、全閩尚阻聲教，百姓辛苦墊隘，無所控訴，爰命征南大將軍貝勒博洛振旅而前。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: an edict said: "I have pacified the Central Plain; only Zhedong and all Fujian still resist our transforming instruction; the people suffer in hardship and distress with nowhere to appeal—therefore I have ordered the Grand General Who Conquers the South, Beile Boluo, to shake the army and advance.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, an edict said: "Having pacified the Central Plain, only eastern Zhe and all Fujian still stand outside our rule; the people lie crushed with no one to hear their plea—so I have ordered Grand General Who Conquers the South Prince Boluo to march forward.

sentences.zh: 既定浙東，遂取閩越。

translations.literal: Having settled Zhedong, he then took Min and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Once Zhedong was secured, he turned to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 先聲所至，窮寇潛逋。

translations.literal: Where our renown arrived first, desperate bandits hid themselves in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Where our fame went ahead, cornered rebels slipped away in hiding.

sentences.zh: 大軍掩追，及於汀水。

translations.literal: The great army pressed in pursuit to the Ting River.
translations.idiomatic: The main army followed hard to the Ting River.

sentences.zh: 聿釗授首，列郡悉平。

translations.literal: Yujian was beheaded; the commanderies were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yujian was beheaded and the prefectures were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 顧惟僭號阻兵，其民何罪，用昭大賚，嘉與維新。

translations.literal: Yet those who presumptuously took titles and resisted with arms—what crime had their people committed? Therefore I proclaim great bounty and rejoice in renewal with you.
translations.idiomatic: Those who seized titles and bore arms alone were guilty—what fault lay with the common people? I therefore proclaim great grace and share renewal with you.

sentences.zh: 一切官民罪犯，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: All crimes of officials and people are pardoned and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Every offense of official or commoner is pardoned.

sentences.zh: 橫徵逋賦，概予豁免。

translations.literal: Irregular levies and tax arrears are wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Every irregular levy and tax arrear is wholly remitted.

sentences.zh: 山林隱逸，各以名聞錄用。

translations.literal: Recluses in mountains and forests may each report their names for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Hermits in the hills may present their names for office.

sentences.zh: 民年七十以上，給絹米有差。

translations.literal: People aged seventy and above are given silk and grain in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: Those seventy years of age and above receive silk and grain according to rank.

sentences.zh: 」己丑，洪承疇擒故明瑞昌王朱議貴及湖賊趙正，斬之。

translations.literal: " Jichou day: Hong Chengchong captured the former Ming Prince of Ruichang Zhu Yigui and the lake bandit Zhao Zheng and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: " On the jichou day, Hong Chengchong seized the former Ming Prince of Ruichang Zhu Yigui and the lake rebel Zhao Zheng and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 乙未，朱聿釗弟聿鐭僭號紹武，據廣州，佟養甲、李成棟率師討之，斬聿鐭及周王肅𥄳、益王思、遼王術雅、鄧王器、鉅野王壽圠、通山王蘊越、高密王弘椅、仁化王慈魶、鄢陵王肅汭、南安王企壟等。

translations.literal: Weimi day: Zhu Yujian's younger brother Yuzhen presumptuously styled himself Shaowu, held Guangzhou; Tong Yangjia and Li Chengdong led troops to attack, beheaded Yuzhen and the Zhou Prince Zhu Su, the Yi Prince Zhu Si, the Liao Prince Zhu Shuya, the Deng Prince Zhu Qi, the Prince of Juye Zhu Shouzhi, the Prince of Tongshan Zhu Yunyu, the Prince of Gaomi Zhu Hongyi, the Prince of Renhua Zhu Cina, the Prince of Yanling Zhu Suwei, the Prince of Nan'an Zhu Qilong, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On the weimi day, Zhu Yujian's brother Zhu Yuzhen took the title Shaowu and held Guangzhou; Tong Yangjia and Li Chengdong attacked, beheaded Yuzhen, and executed the Zhou prince Zhu Su, the Yi prince Zhu Si, the Liao prince Zhu Shuya, the Deng prince Zhu Qi, and other Ming clansmen with him.

sentences.zh: 廣州平。

translations.literal: Guangzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以佟國鼐為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Wuxu day: appointed Tong Guonai Fujian Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Tong Guonai was made Governor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，賜呂宮等進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, wuwu day: bestowed metropolitan degrees on Lu Gong and other jinshi in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the third month, Lu Gong and other successful candidates received metropolitan degrees in due rank.

sentences.zh: 己未，以耿焞為順天巡撫，周伯達為江寧巡撫，趙兆麟撫治鄖陽。

translations.literal: Jiwei day: appointed Geng Huang Shuntian Governor, Zhou Boda Jiangning Governor, and Zhao Zhaolin Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Geng Huang was made Governor of Shuntian, Zhou Boda Governor of Jiangning, and Zhao Zhaolin Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，諭京官三品以上及督、撫、提、鎮各送一子入朝侍衛，察才任使，無子者以弟及從子代之。

translations.literal: Gengshen day: ordered capital officials of the third rank and above and each governor-general, governor, provincial commander, and brigade commander to send one son to attend at court as guard, that talent might be observed and offices assigned; where there was no son, a younger brother or a brother's son might substitute.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, officials of the third rank and above at court and every governor-general, governor, provincial commander, and brigadier were ordered to send a son to serve at court so ability might be tested; those without sons might send a younger brother or nephew.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，免崇明縣鹽課、馬役銀。

translations.literal: Renxu day: remitted Chongming County's salt levy and horse-service silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Chongming County's salt tax and horse-corvée silver were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，《大清律》成。

translations.literal: Yichou day: the Great Qing Code was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the Great Qing Code was completed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，佟養甲克高、雷、廉三府。

translations.literal: Bingyin day: Tong Yangjia took the three prefectures of Gao, Lei, and Lian.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Tong Yangjia captured the prefectures of Gao, Lei, and Lian.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命祀郊社太牢仍用腥。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: ordered that sacrifices at the suburban altars and the Grand Sacrifice still use raw meat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, it was ordered that suburban and Grand Sacrifice offerings continue to use raw meat.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禁漢人投充滿洲。

translations.literal: Jisi day: forbade Han people to submit as bond-servants to Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Han people were forbidden to enter Manchu households as bond-servants.

sentences.zh: 庚午，罷圈撥民間田宅，已圈者補給。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: abolished the enclosure and seizure of civilian fields and houses; for lands already enclosed, compensation was given.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the seizure of civilian land and dwellings was abolished and compensation ordered for what had already been taken.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，田仰率所部降。

translations.literal: Fourth month, dingchou day: Tian Yang led his command in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the fourth month, Tian Yang surrendered with his troops.

sentences.zh: 己卯，高士俊克長沙，昂邦章京傅喀蟾討劉文炳、郭君鎮，殲之。

translations.literal: Jimao day: Gao Shijun took Changsha; Angbang Janggin Fukang'an campaigned against Liu Wenbing and Guo Junzhen and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Gao Shijun took Changsha; Angbang Janggin Fukang'an attacked Liu Wenbing and Guo Junzhen and annihilated them.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，貝勒博洛班師。

translations.literal: Yiyou day: Beile Boluo withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Prince Boluo withdrew his army.

sentences.zh: 是役也，貝子和託、固山額真公圖賴皆卒于軍。

translations.literal: In this campaign, Beile Hosotu and Gushan Ejen Eidu both died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In that campaign, Prince Hosotu and Gushan Ejen Eidu both died on service.

sentences.zh: 甲午，陝西官軍斬孫守法。

translations.literal: Jiawu day: Shaanxi government troops beheaded Sun Shoufa.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Shaanxi troops beheaded Sun Shoufa.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，舟山海賊沈廷揚等犯崇明，官軍討擒之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renyin day: Zhoushan sea bandits Shen Tingyang and others raided Chongming; government troops campaigned and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the fifth month, the Zhoushan pirates Shen Tingyang and others raided Chongming; government forces took them captive.

sentences.zh: 己酉，故明在籍通政使侯峒曾遣諜致書魯王，偽許洪承疇、土國寶以公、侯，共定江南，為反間計，柘林游擊獲之以聞。

translations.literal: Jiyou day: the former Ming retired chief of the Office of Transmission Hou Tongzeng sent a spy with a letter to the Lu Prince, falsely promising Hong Chengchong and Tu Guobao the ranks of duke and marquis to settle Jiangnan together—a stratagem of sowing discord; the Zhulin patrol vice-commander seized the letter and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the former Ming transmission chief Hou Tongzeng sent an agent with a letter to the Lu Prince, falsely offering Hong Chengchong and Tu Guobao ducal and marquis rank if they would join in recovering Jiangnan—a counter-intelligence ruse that the Zhulin patrol seized and reported.

sentences.zh: 上覺其詐，命江寧昂邦章京巴山等同承疇窮治其事。

translations.literal: The Emperor perceived the fraud and ordered Jiangning Angbang Janggin Bašan and others, together with Chengchong, to investigate the matter thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor saw through the plot and ordered Jiangning Angbang Janggin Bašan and others, with Chengchong, to investigate to the end.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免興國、江夏等十州縣上年災賦。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: remitted the previous year's disaster tax assessments of Xingguo, Jiangxia, and ten other prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the previous year's disaster taxes were remitted in Xingguo, Jiangxia, and ten other districts.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以佟養甲為兩廣總督，兼廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Guichou day: appointed Tong Yangjia Governor-General of the Two Guangs, with additional charge as Guangdong Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Tong Yangjia was made Governor-General of the Two Guangs, also serving as Guangdong Governor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，投誠伯常應俊、總兵李際遇等坐通賊，伏誅。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: the surrendered noble Chang Yingjun, Commander Li Jiyu, and others were guilty of communicating with bandits and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the surrendered noble Chang Yingjun, Commander Li Jiyu, and others were put to death for collusion with rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Guihai day: the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，班代、峨齊爾、胡巴津自蘇尼特來降。

translations.literal: Yichou day: Banda, Eqi'er, and Hubajin came from Sunid to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Banda, Eqi'er, and Hubajin of the Sunid came in to surrender.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，免成安等七縣上年災賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renshen day: remitted the previous year's disaster tax assessments of Cheng'an and seven other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the sixth month, the previous year's disaster taxes were remitted in Cheng'an and seven other counties.

sentences.zh: 丙子，朝鮮國王李倧遣其子橑來朝。

translations.literal: Bingzi day: the King of Korea Yi Jong sent his son Tiao on a court visit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, King Yi Jong of Korea sent his son Tiao to court.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，故明趙王朱由棪來降。

translations.literal: Gengchen day: the former Ming Prince of Zhao Zhu Youliang came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the former Ming Prince of Zhao Zhu Youliang submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免綏德衛上年災賦。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: remitted the previous year's disaster tax assessments of Suide Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the previous year's disaster taxes of Suide Guard were remitted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，封貝勒博洛為多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Jichou day: enfeoffed Beile Boluo as Prince of the Commandery of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince Boluo was raised to a doroi commandery prince.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，陝西賊武大定陷紫陽，總兵官任珍擊敗之。

translations.literal: Guisi day: Shaanxi bandit Wu Dading took Ziyang; Commander Ren Zhen defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the Shaanxi rebel Wu Dading seized Ziyang; Commander Ren Zhen defeated him.

sentences.zh: 湖廣官軍克衡州、常德及安化、新化等縣。

translations.literal: Huguang government troops took Hengzhou, Changde, and the counties of Anhua and Xinhua.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang troops recovered Hengzhou, Changde, and the counties of Anhua and Xinhua.

sentences.zh: 甲午，蘇松提督吳勝兆謀叛，伏誅。

translations.literal: Jiawu day: Jiangsu-Songjiang Provincial Commander Wu Shengchao plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Jiangsu-Songjiang commander Wu Shengchao was put to death for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免山東上年荒賦。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: remitted Shandong's previous-year famine tax assessments.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Shandong's famine taxes for the previous year were remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，加封和碩德豫親王多鐸為輔政叔德豫親王。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinchou day: further enfeoffed the Prince of the First Rank Dodo, Virtuous Prince of Yu, as Assistant Regent Uncle Virtuous Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the seventh month, Prince Dodo the Virtuous was further advanced to Assistant Regent Uncle Virtuous Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，建射殿於左翼門外。

translations.literal: Guimao day: built the Archery Hall outside the Left Wing Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an Archery Hall was built outside the Left Wing Gate.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免徐州上年荒賦。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: remitted Xuzhou's previous-year famine tax assessments.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Xuzhou's famine taxes for the previous year were remitted.

sentences.zh: 己酉，封敖漢部額駙班第子墨爾根巴圖魯為多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Jiyou day: enfeoffed Mo'ergen Batulu, son of the Khalkha imperial son-in-law Bandi, as Prince of the Commandery of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Mo'ergen Batulu, son of the Khalkha imperial son-in-law Bandi, was created a doroi commandery prince.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以申朝紀為宣大總督。

translations.literal: Guichou day: appointed Shen Chaoji Governor-General of Xuan and Da.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Shen Chaoji was made Governor-General of Xuan and Da.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，鄖陽賊王光代用永曆年號，聚眾作亂，命侍郎喀喀木等剿之。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: Yunyang bandit Wang Guangdai used the Yongli reign title, gathered crowds and made disorder; Vice-minister Kekemu and others were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the Yunyang rebel Wang Guangdai adopted the Yongli reign title and raised a mob; Vice-minister Kekemu and others were sent to destroy him.

sentences.zh: 戊午，改馬國柱為江南江西河南總督。

translations.literal: Wuwu day: changed Ma Guozhu to Governor-General of Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Ma Guozhu was transferred to Governor-General of Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔曰：「中原底定，聲教遐敷。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: an edict said: "The Central Plain is settled and transforming instruction reaches afar.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, an edict said: "The Central Plain is pacified and our teaching reaches far abroad.

sentences.zh: 惟粵東尚為唐籓所阻，嶺海怨咨，已非一日。

translations.literal: Only eastern Guangdong is still blocked by the Tang fief; the people beyond the ranges have long groaned in distress.
translations.idiomatic: Only eastern Guangdong still lies under the Tang prince; the people of the Lingnan passes have groaned under oppression for many days.

sentences.zh: 用移南伐之師，席捲惠、潮，遂達省會。

translations.literal: Therefore the southern punitive army was moved; it swept Hui and Chao and reached the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: We therefore shifted the southern expedition; it rolled through Hui and Chao to the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 念爾官民，初非後至，一切罪犯，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Considering that you officials and people were not the last to submit, all crimes are pardoned and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing that officials and people there were not the last holdouts, every crime is pardoned.

sentences.zh: 逋賦橫徵，概與豁免。

translations.literal: Tax arrears and irregular levies are wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax arrears and irregular levies are wholly remitted.

sentences.zh: 民年七十以上，加錫粟帛。

translations.literal: People aged seventy and above receive additional gifts of grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Those seventy and above receive added grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 所在節孝者旌，山林有才德者錄用。

translations.literal: Where there are chaste and filial persons, they are honored; where there are talented recluses in mountains and forests, they are appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The chaste and filial are honored; hermits of talent in the hills are enrolled for office.

sentences.zh: 南海諸國能鄉化者，待之如朝鮮。

translations.literal: The maritime countries of the southern seas that can turn toward civilization shall be treated like Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Oversea states of the southern seas that accept civilization shall be treated as Korea is.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，以祝世昌為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: " Bingyin day: appointed Zhu Shichang Shanxi Governor.
translations.idiomatic: " On the bingyin day, Zhu Shichang was made Governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上幸邊外閱武。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: the Emperor visited the frontier to review troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the Emperor went beyond the passes to review the army.

sentences.zh: 是日，駐沙河。

translations.literal: That day he halted at Shahe.
translations.idiomatic: That day he encamped at Shahe.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，金聲桓擒故明宗室麟伯王、靄伯王於瀘溪山，誅之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengwu day: Jin Shengheng captured the former Ming clansmen the Prince of Linbo and the Prince of Aibo on Lüxi Mountain and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the eighth month, Jin Shengheng seized the former Ming princes of Linbo and Aibo on Lüxi Mountain and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，次西巴爾台。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day: halted at Xibartai.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, he halted at Xibartai.

sentences.zh: 丙子，次海流土河口。

translations.literal: Bingzi day: halted at the mouth of the Hailiu River.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, he halted at the mouth of the Hailiu River.

sentences.zh: 壬午，次察漢諾爾。

translations.literal: Renwu day: halted at Chahan Nur.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, he halted at Chahan Nur.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，豪格遣貝勒尼堪等先後克遵義、夔州、茂州、內江、榮昌、富順等縣，斬故明王及其黨千餘人。

translations.literal: Yiyou day: Hooge sent Princes Nikan and others in succession to take Zunyi, Kuizhou, Maozhou, Neijiang, Rongchang, Fushun, and other counties, and beheaded more than a thousand former Ming princes and their followers.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Hooge sent Prince Nikan and others to capture Zunyi, Kuizhou, Maozhou, Neijiang, Rongchang, Fushun, and other counties, beheading more than a thousand Ming clansmen and their partisans.

sentences.zh: 四川平。

translations.literal: Sichuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，次胡蘇台。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: halted at Husutai.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, he halted at Husutai.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以張文衡為甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: Xinmao day: appointed Zhang Wenheng Gansu Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Zhang Wenheng was made Governor of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上還宮。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，京師地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinchou day: there was an earthquake in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the ninth month, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，淮安賊張華山等用隆武年號，嘯聚廟灣。

translations.literal: Xinhai day: Huai'an bandits Zhang Huashan and others used the Longwu reign title and gathered in disorder at Miaowan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the Huai'an rebels Zhang Huashan and others adopted the Longwu reign title and mustered a mob at Miaowan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以李猶龍為天津巡撫。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: appointed Li Youlong Tianjin Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Li Youlong was made Governor of Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，官軍討廟灣賊，破之。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: government troops campaigned against the Miaowan bandits and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, government troops attacked the Miaowan bandits and routed them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，以王懩為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, gengwu day: appointed Wang Yong Anhui Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the tenth winter month, Wang Yong was made Governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 壬申，喀喇沁部卓爾弼等率所部來降。

translations.literal: Renshen day: Zhuo'erbi and others of the Kharchin tribe led their tribes to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Zhuo'erbi and others of the Kharchin banner led their followers to submit.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以吳惟華為淮揚總督，線縉為偏沅巡撫。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: appointed Wu Weihua Governor-General of Huai-Yang and Xian Jin Governor of Bianyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Wu Weihua was made Governor-General of Huai-Yang and Xian Jin Governor of Bianyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，定直省官三年大計。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: fixed the triennial grand assessment of officials in the directly administered provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, the three-year grand review of officials in the metropolitan provinces was established.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以廣東採珠病民，罷之。

translations.literal: Renchen day: because pearl-diving in Guangdong harmed the people, it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Guangdong pearl-fishing was abolished because it oppressed the people.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，以陳泰為靖南將軍，同梅勒章京董阿賴征福建餘寇。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengxu day: appointed Chen Tai General Who Pacifies the South, together with Meire Janggin Dong Alai to campaign against remaining bandits in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the eleventh month, Chen Tai was made General Who Pacifies the South and, with Meire Janggin Dong Alai, sent against remnant rebels in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免山西代、靜樂等十四州縣，寧化等六所堡，山東德、歷城等十五州縣災賦。

translations.literal: Xinhai day: remitted disaster tax assessments of fourteen prefectures and counties in Shanxi including Dai and Jingle, six guarded posts including Ninghua, and fifteen prefectures and counties in Shandong including Dezhou and Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, disaster taxes were remitted in fourteen Shanxi districts including Dai and Jingle, six guarded posts including Ninghua, and fifteen Shandong districts including Dezhou and Licheng.

sentences.zh: 裁山東明季牙、雜二稅。

translations.literal: Cut the Ming-period tooth and miscellaneous taxes of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong's Ming-era "tooth" and miscellaneous levies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊午，五鳳樓成。

translations.literal: Wuwu day: the Five Phoenix Tower was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the Five Phoenix Tower was completed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Guihai day: sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，免保定、河間、真定、順德災賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuchen day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Baoding, Hejian, Zhending, and Shunde.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the twelfth month, disaster taxes were remitted in Baoding, Hejian, Zhending, and Shunde.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以陳錦為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Renshen day: appointed Chen Jin Governor-General of Min and Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Chen Jin was made Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以太宗十一女固倫公主下嫁喀爾嗎索納木。

translations.literal: Jimao day: Taizong's eleventh daughter, the Gurun Princess, was given in marriage to Karma Sonam of the Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Taizong's eleventh daughter, a gurun princess, was married to the Khalkha noble Karma Sonam.

sentences.zh: 甲申，蘇尼特部台吉吳巴什等來歸。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: Taiji Ubashi and others of the Sunite tribe came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the Sunite taiji Ubashi and others came in submission.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大軍自岳州收長沙，故明總督何騰蛟等先期遁。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: the main army recovered Changsha from Yuezhou; the former Ming Governor-General He Tengjiao and others had fled beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the main army took Changsha from Yuezhou; the former Ming governor-general He Tengjiao and others had already fled.

sentences.zh: 次湘潭，敗桂王將黃朝選眾十三萬於燕子窩，又敗之于衡州，斬之，遂克寶慶，斬魯王朱鼎兆等。

translations.literal: Next at Xiangtan they defeated the Gui Wang's general Huang Chaoxuan's host of 130,000 at Swallow Nest, defeated him again at Hengzhou and beheaded him, then took Baoqing and beheaded the Lu Wang Zhu Dingzhao and others.
translations.idiomatic: At Xiangtan they routed the Gui prince's general Huang Chaoxuan and 130,000 men at Swallow Nest, defeated him again at Hengzhou and beheaded him, then took Baoqing and executed the Lu prince Zhu Dingzhao and others.

sentences.zh: 進擊武岡，桂王由榔走，追至靖州，下其城。

translations.literal: Advancing on Wugang, the Gui Wang Youlang fled; pursued to Jingzhou, they took the city.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on Wugang, the Gui prince Youlang fled; pursued to Jingzhou, they captured the city.

sentences.zh: 復克沅州，岷王朱埏峻以黎平降。

translations.literal: They recovered Yuanzhou; the Min Wang Zhu Yanjun surrendered from Liping.
translations.idiomatic: They retook Yuanzhou; the Min prince Zhu Yanjun submitted from Liping.

sentences.zh: 湖南平。

translations.literal: Hunan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，故明將鄭彩犯福州，副將鄒必科等敗走之。

translations.literal: Gengyin day: the former Ming general Zheng Cai attacked Fuzhou; Vice-General Zou Biko and others drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the former Ming general Zheng Cai attacked Fuzhou; Vice-General Zou Biko and others repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，科爾沁、喀喇沁、烏朱穆秦、敖漢、翁牛特、蘇尼特、札魯特、郭爾羅斯、蒿齊忒、阿霸垓諸部來朝。

translations.literal: That year the tribes of Khorchin, Kharchin, Ujumchin, Aohan, Udet, Sunite, Jarud, Gorlos, Khorchi, and Abag came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Khorchin, Kharchin, Ujumchin, Aohan, Udet, Sunite, Jarud, Gorlos, Khorchi, and Abag tribes came to court.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮暨喀爾喀部札薩克圖汗、墨爾根綽爾濟、額爾德尼綽爾濟、邁達禮胡土克圖、額爾德尼顧錫、伊拉古克三胡土克圖、嘛哈撒馬諦塞臣汗、俄木布額爾德尼、塞勒胡土克圖、滿珠習禮胡土克圖，札薩克圖汗下俄木布額爾德尼、巴顏護衛、舍晉班第、邁達禮胡土克圖，諾門汗下丹津胡土克圖，土謝圖汗下澤卜尊丹巴胡土克圖，碩雷汗下伊赫額木齊格隆、額參德勒哈談巴圖魯，厄魯特部台吉吳霸錫、顧實汗，羅布藏胡土克圖下巴漢格隆、盆蘇克扎穆蘇，阿布賚諾顏下訥門汗、巴圖魯諾顏、達雲綽爾濟、鄂濟爾圖台吉，蘇尼特部台吉魏正，札魯特部台吉桑圖，鄂爾多斯部濟農，歸化城土默特部章京托博克、諾爾布，唐古忒部及喇布札木綽爾濟、喇嘛班第達等俱來貢。

translations.literal: Korea; the Khalkha Jasagtu Khan, Mergen Janggin, Erdeni Janggin, Maidari Khutukhtu, Erdeni Gushi, Ilagukusan Khutukhtu, Mahasamadi Sechen Khan, Ombo Erdeni, Sele Khutukhtu, Manjusiri Khutukhtu; under the Jasagtu Khan, Ombo Erdeni, Bayan Huyu, Shejin Bandi, and Maidari Khutukhtu; under the Nomun Khan, Danjin Khutukhtu; under the Tüshe Khan, Zebuzanba Khutukhtu; under the Sure Khan, Ihe Emchigeleng and Ertsende Khatan Batür; the Oirat taijis Ubashi and Gushi Khan; under the Lobzang Khutukhtu, Bahanggeleng and Pensikejamusu; under the Abai Noyan, Nomun Khan, Batür Noyan, Dayun Janggin, and Ejeirtu Taiji; the Sunite taiji Wei Zheng; the Jarud taiji Sangtu; the Ordos jinong; the Guihuacheng Tumed janggin Tobok and Norbu; the Tangut lama Jambadampa; and others all came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Korea; numerous Khalkha khans, khutukhtus, and nobles including the Jasagtu, Sechen, and Tüshe khans; Oirat taijis and khans; Ordos, Sunite, and Jarud leaders; the Guihuacheng Tumed janggin Tobok and Norbu; the Tangut lama Jambadampa; and others.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛亥，故明宜春王朱議衍據汀州為亂，總兵官於永綬擒斬之。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, xinhai day: the former Ming Prince of Yichun Zhu Yiyan seized Tingzhou in rebellion; regional commander Yu Yongshou captured and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the xinhai day of the first spring month, the former Ming prince of Yichun Zhu Yiyan rebelled at Tingzhou; regional commander Yu Yongshou seized and executed him.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免太原、平陽、潞安三府，澤、沁、遼三州災賦。

translations.literal: Guichou day: remitted disaster tax assessments of the three prefectures Taiyuan, Pingyang, and Lu'an and the three departments Ze, Qin, and Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, disaster taxes were remitted in Taiyuan, Pingyang, and Lu'an prefectures and Ze, Qin, and Liao departments.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，和碩肅親王豪格師還。

translations.literal: Guihai day: Prince Su Hooge returned with his army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Prince Su Hooge returned with his army.

sentences.zh: 衍禧郡王羅洛宏卒于軍，至是喪歸，輟朝二日。

translations.literal: Prince of Enrichment and Happiness Luoluo Hong had died on campaign; now the bier returned, and court was suspended for two days.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Luoluo Hong had died on campaign; when the funeral train returned, court was suspended for two days.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，金聲桓及王得仁以南昌叛。

translations.literal: Second month, jiaxu day: Jin Shengheng and Wang Deren rebelled at Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the second month, Jin Shengheng and Wang Deren rebelled at Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，江南官軍復無為州，福建官軍復連城、順昌、將樂等縣。

translations.literal: Xinsi day: Jiangnan government troops recovered Wuwei Prefecture; Fujian government troops recovered Liancheng, Shunchang, Jiangle, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Jiangnan forces retook Wuwei Prefecture; Fujian forces retook Liancheng, Shunchang, Jiangle, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 癸未，免濟南、兗州、青州、萊州上年災賦。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: remitted last year's disaster tax assessments of Jinan, Yanzhou, Qingzhou, and Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, last year's disaster taxes were remitted in Jinan, Yanzhou, Qingzhou, and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以固倫公主下嫁巴林部塞卜騰。

translations.literal: Xinmao day: a Gurun Princess was given in marriage to Sebuteng of the Baarin tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, a gurun princess was married to Sebuteng of the Baarin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以呂逢春為山東巡撫，李鑒為寧夏巡撫。

translations.literal: Renchen day: appointed Lü Fengchun Shandong Governor and Li Jian Ningxia Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Lü Fengchun was made Governor of Shandong and Li Jian Governor of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 故明貴溪王朱常彪、恢武伯向登位寇沅州，纛章京線國安等討斬之。

translations.literal: The former Ming Prince of Guixi Zhu Changbiao and Restored Military Earl Xiang Dengwei raided Yuanzhou; Dasheng Janggin Xian Guo'an and others campaigned against them and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: The former Ming prince of Guixi Zhu Changbiao and Earl Xiang Dengwei raided Yuanzhou; Dasheng Janggin Xian Guo'an and others attacked and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，貝子吞齊、尚善等訐告和碩鄭親王濟爾哈朗，罪連莽加、博博爾岱、鰲拜、索尼等，降濟爾哈朗為多羅郡王，莽加等降革有差。

translations.literal: Third month, jihai day: Beizi Tunqi and Shangshan impeached Prince of Zheng Jirhalang; Manggi, Bobodai, Oboi, Sonin, and others were implicated; Jirhalang was reduced to Prince of the Commandery; Manggi and the rest were demoted or dismissed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the third month, Beizi Tunqi and Shangshan impeached Prince Jirhalang of Zheng; Manggi, Bobodai, Oboi, Sonin, and others were implicated; Jirhalang was reduced to a commandery prince; Manggi and the rest were demoted or stripped in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，和碩肅親王豪格有罪，論死。

translations.literal: Xinchou day: Prince Su Hooge was found guilty and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Prince Su Hooge was found guilty and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 上不忍置之法，幽系之。

translations.literal: The Emperor could not bear to execute him by law and had him confined.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor could not bring himself to carry out the sentence and had Hooge imprisoned instead.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命譚泰為征南大將軍，同何洛會討金聲桓。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: ordered Tantai Grand General on a Southern Campaign, together with Hošoi to campaign against Jin Shengheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Tantai was made Grand General on a Southern Campaign and, with Hošoi, ordered against Jin Shengheng.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以耿焞為宣大山西總督。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: appointed Geng Zhun Governor-General of Xuan, Da, and Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Geng Zhun was made Governor-General of Xuan, Da, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，武大定犯寧羌，游擊張德俊等大破之。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: Wu Wuding attacked Ningqiang; guerrilla commander Zhang Dejun and others routed him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Wu Wuding attacked Ningqiang; Guerrilla Commander Zhang Dejun and others routed him.

sentences.zh: 四月丁卯，以楊興國為順天巡撫。

translations.literal: Fourth month, dingmao day: appointed Yang Xingguo Shuntian Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the fourth month, Yang Xingguo was made Governor of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，免渭原、金縣、蘭州衛災賦。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Weiyuan, Jin County, and Lanzhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, disaster taxes were remitted in Weiyuan, Jin County, and Lanzhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬申，官軍復建寧，斬故明鄖西王朱常湖等。

translations.literal: Renshen day: government troops recovered Jianning and beheaded the former Ming Prince of Yuxi Zhu Changhu and others.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, government troops retook Jianning and beheaded the former Ming prince of Yuxi Zhu Changhu and others.

sentences.zh: 己卯，封科爾沁杜爾伯特鎮國公色冷為貝子。

translations.literal: Jimao day: enfeoffed Sereng, Duke Who Stabilizes the State of Khorchin's Dorbet banner, as Beizi.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Sereng, duke of Khorchin's Dorbet banner, was enfeoffed as beizi.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣固山額真阿賴等駐防漢中。

translations.literal: Gengchen day: dispatched Gushan Ejen Alai and others to garrison Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Gushan Ejen Alai and others were sent to garrison Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大軍克辰州，遂破永寧，至全州，故明督師何騰蛟遁，獲貴溪王朱長標、南威王朱寅衛、長沙王朱由櫛等。

translations.literal: Renwu day: the main army took Chenzhou, broke Yongning, reached Quanzhou; former Ming Supreme Commander He Tengjiao fled; captured the Prince of Guixi Zhu Changbiao, Prince of Nanwei Zhu Yinwei, Prince of Changsha Zhu Youji, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the main army took Chenzhou, broke Yongning, and reached Quanzhou; the former Ming supreme commander He Tengjiao fled; the princes of Guixi, Nanwei, and Changsha—Zhu Changbiao, Zhu Yinwei, and Zhu Youji—and others were captured.

sentences.zh: 銅仁、興安、關陽諸苗、瑤來降。

translations.literal: The Miao and Yao of Tongren, Xing'an, Guanyang, and other places came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao and Yao of Tongren, Xing'an, Guanyang, and other districts submitted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命劉之源、佟圖賴為定南將軍，駐防寶慶，李國翰為定西將軍，駐防漢中。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: ordered Liu Zhiyuan and Tongtuhei as Generals Who Fix the South to garrison Baoqing; Li Guohan as General Who Fixes the West to garrison Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Liu Zhiyuan and Tongtuhei were made Generals Who Fix the South to garrison Baoqing, and Li Guohan General Who Fixes the West to garrison Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，吳三桂自錦州移鎮漢中。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: Wu Sangui was transferred from Jinzhou to garrison Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Wu Sangui was moved from Jinzhou to garrison Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 閏四月戊戌，復濟爾哈朗爵為和碩鄭親王。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, wuxu day: restored Jirhalang's rank as Prince of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the intercalary fourth month, Jirhalang was restored as Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以李國英為四川巡撫。

translations.literal: Guimao day: appointed Li Guoying Sichuan Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Li Guoying was made Governor of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 己未，以遲日益為湖廣巡撫。

translations.literal: Jiwei day: appointed Chi Yiyu Huguang Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Chi Yiyu was made Governor of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命貝子吞齊為平西大將軍，同韓岱討陝西叛回。

translations.literal: Guihai day: ordered Beizi Tunqi Grand General Who Pacifies the West, together with Han Dai to campaign against the rebel Muslims of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Beizi Tunqi was made Grand General Who Pacifies the West and, with Han Dai, ordered against the Muslim rebels of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yichou new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, yichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，官軍破叛回於鞏昌，復臨洮、蘭州。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: government troops defeated the rebel Muslims at Gongchang and recovered Lintao and Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, government troops defeated the Muslim rebels at Gongchang and retook Lintao and Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，游擊張勇破叛回於馬家坪，獲故明延長王朱識駉，斬之。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: guerrilla Zhang Yong defeated the rebel Muslims at Majiaping, captured the former Ming Prince of Yanchang Zhu Shijing, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Guerrilla Commander Zhang Yong routed the Muslim rebels at Majiaping, seized the former Ming prince of Yanchang Zhu Shijing, and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以趙福星為鳳陽巡撫。

translations.literal: Renwu day: appointed Zhao Fuxing Fengyang Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Zhao Fuxing was made Governor of Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以朱延慶為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: appointed Zhu Yanqing Jiangxi Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Zhu Yanqing was made Governor of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，官軍破金聲桓，復九江、饒州。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: government troops defeated Jin Shengheng and recovered Jiujiang and Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, government troops defeated Jin Shengheng and retook Jiujiang and Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以劉弘遇為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Jichou day: appointed Liu Hongyu Anhui Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Liu Hongyu was made Governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午朔，免西安、延安、平涼、臨洮、慶陽、漢中上年災賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiawu new moon: remitted last year's disaster tax assessments of Xi'an, Yan'an, Pingliang, Lintao, Qingyang, and Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the sixth month, jiawu, last year's disaster taxes were remitted in Xi'an, Yan'an, Pingliang, Lintao, Qingyang, and Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以周文業為甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: Guimao day: appointed Zhou Wenye Gansu Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Zhou Wenye was made Governor of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，額塞等大破叛回於蘭州，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: Ese and others greatly defeated the rebel Muslims at Lanzhou; the remainder were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Ese and others routed the Muslim rebels at Lanzhou and pacified the remnant.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，京師地震有聲。

translations.literal: Bingchen day: there was an earthquake in the capital that was heard.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the capital was shaken by an audible earthquake.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太廟成。

translations.literal: Guihai day: the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，初設六部漢尚書、都察院左都御史，以陳名夏、謝啟光、李若琳、劉餘祐、黨崇雅、金之俊為六部尚書，徐起元為左都御史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingchou day: Han Ministers of the Six Ministries and the Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate were established for the first time; Chen Mingxia, Xie Qiguang, Li Ruolin, Liu Yuyou, Dang Chongya, and Jin Zhijun were made Ministers of the Six Ministries, and Xu Qiyuan Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the seventh autumn month, Han ministers of the Six Ministries and a left censor-in-chief were appointed for the first time: Chen Mingxia, Xie Qiguang, Li Ruolin, Liu Yuyou, Dang Chongya, and Jin Zhijun as ministers, and Xu Qiyuan as left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳朔，金聲桓、王得仁寇贛州，官軍擊走之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guisi new moon: Jin Shengheng and Wang Deren raided Ganzhou; government troops repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon of the eighth month, Jin Shengheng and Wang Deren raided Ganzhou; government troops drove them off.

sentences.zh: 己亥，陳泰、李率泰等敗鄭彩於長樂，又敗之於連江，復興化。

translations.literal: Jihai day: Chen Tai, Li Shutai, and others defeated Zheng Cai at Changle and again at Lianjiang, recovering Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Chen Tai, Li Shutai, and others defeated Zheng Cai at Changle and Lianjiang and retook Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命和碩英親王阿濟格、多羅承澤郡王碩塞等討天津土賊。

translations.literal: Jisi day: ordered Prince Ying Ajige, Prince Chenze Suose, and others to campaign against local bandits in Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Prince Ajige of Ying, Prince Suose of Chenze, and others were ordered against local bandits in Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 丁未，禁民間養馬及收藏軍器。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: forbade the populace to keep horses or hoard weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, commoners were forbidden to keep horses or hoard arms.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以王一品為鳳陽巡撫。

translations.literal: Jiyou day: appointed Wang Yipin Fengyang Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Wang Yipin was made Governor of Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，令滿、漢官民得相嫁娶。

translations.literal: Renzi day: ordered that Manchu and Han officials and commoners might intermarry.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Manchu and Han officials and commoners were permitted to intermarry.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以夏玉為天津巡撫，張學聖為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Yimao day: appointed Xia Yu Tianjin Governor and Zhang Xuesheng Fujian Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Xia Yu was made Governor of Tianjin and Zhang Xuesheng Governor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌朔，官軍獲故明巡撫吳江等於南康湖口，斬之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renxu new moon: government troops captured the former Ming Grand Coordinator Wu Jiang and others at Lake Kou in Nankang and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the ninth month, government troops seized the former Ming grand coordinator Wu Jiang and others at Nankang Lake Kou and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，和碩英親王阿濟格討曹縣土賊，平之。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: Prince Ying Ajige campaigned against local bandits in Caoxian and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Prince Ajige of Ying campaigned against local bandits in Caoxian and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，封貝勒勒克德渾為多羅順承郡王，博洛為多羅端重郡王。

translations.literal: Jisi day: enfeoffed Beile Lekedehun as Prince of the Commandery Who Inherits Success and Boluo as Prince of the Commandery of Serious Bearing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Beile Lekedehun was made Prince of the Commandery Who Inherits Success and Boluo Prince of the Commandery of Serious Bearing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，和碩鄭親王濟爾哈朗為定遠大將軍，討湖廣賊李錦。

translations.literal: Renshen day: Prince of Zheng Jirhalang was made Grand General Who Fixes the Distant to campaign against the Huguang bandit Li Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Prince Jirhalang of Zheng was made Grand General Who Fixes the Distant and sent against the Huguang rebel Li Jin.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封貝勒尼堪為多羅敬謹郡王。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: enfeoffed Beile Nikan as Prince of the Commandery of Respectful Caution.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Beile Nikan was enfeoffed as Prince of the Commandery of Respectful Caution.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，和碩禮親王代善薨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renyin day: Prince of Li Daishan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the tenth winter month, Daishan, Prince of Li, died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，佟圖賴復寶慶。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: Tongtuhei recovered Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Tongtuhei retook Baoqing.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，降將劉澤清結曹縣賊叛，澤清及其黨李洪基等俱伏誅。

translations.literal: Bingchen day: the surrendered general Liu Zeqing joined with bandits of Caoxian in rebellion; Zeqing and his partisans Li Hongji and others were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the surrendered general Liu Zeqing allied with Caoxian bandits in revolt; Zeqing and his followers Li Hongji and others were all executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，廣東叛將李成棟據南雄，結峒蠻犯贛州，巡撫劉武元等擊走之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiazi day: the Guangdong rebel general Li Chengdong held Nanxiong, allied with cave barbarians, and attacked Ganzhou; Governor Liu Wuyuan and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the eleventh month, the Guangdong rebel Li Chengdong held Nanxiong, allied with cave tribes, and attacked Ganzhou; Governor Liu Wuyuan and others repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，總兵官任珍擊賀珍，破之。

translations.literal: Bingyin day: regional commander Ren Zhen attacked He Zhen and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Regional Commander Ren Zhen attacked He Zhen and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祀天於圜丘，以太祖武皇帝配。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound, with Martial Emperor Taizu as companion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound, with Martial Emperor Taizu as companion.

sentences.zh: 追尊太祖以上四世：高祖澤王為肇祖原皇帝，曾祖慶王為興祖直皇帝，祖昌王為景祖翼皇帝，考福王為顯祖宣皇帝；

translations.literal: Posthumously honored the four generations above Taizu: great-great-grandfather Prince Ze as Founding Ancestor Origin Emperor, great-grandfather Prince Qing as Rising Ancestor Upright Emperor, grandfather Prince Chang as Splendid Ancestor Wing Emperor, and father Prince Fu as Illustrious Ancestor Proclamation Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The four generations above Taizu were posthumously honored: the great-great-grandfather, Prince Ze, as Founding Ancestor Origin Emperor; the great-grandfather, Prince Qing, as Rising Ancestor Upright Emperor; the grandfather, Prince Chang, as Splendid Ancestor Wing Emperor; and the father, Prince Fu, as Illustrious Ancestor Proclamation Emperor.

sentences.zh: 妣皆為皇后。

translations.literal: Their consorts were all made empresses.
translations.idiomatic: Their consorts were all given the title of empress.

sentences.zh: 上詣太廟上冊寶。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to install the registers and seals.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to install the registers and seals.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以配天及上尊號禮成，御殿受賀，大赦。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: because the rites of companion sacrifice to Heaven and the bestowal of the honorific title were complete, he took the throne in court to receive congratulations and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, with the rites of Heaven sacrifice and the honorific title complete, he held court to receive congratulations and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛未，和碩英親王阿濟格、多羅端重郡王博洛、多羅承澤郡王碩塞等帥師駐大同，備喀爾喀。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Prince Ying Ajige, Prince of Serious Bearing Boluo, Prince Chenze Suose, and others led armies to garrison Datong against the Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Prince Ajige of Ying, Prince Boluo of Serious Bearing, Prince Suose of Chenze, and others led troops to garrison Datong against the Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯朔，命郡王瓦克達，貝子尚善、吞齊等詣阿濟格軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinmao new moon: ordered Prince of the Commandery Wakada, Beizi Shangshan, Tunqi, and others to Ajige's army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the twelfth month, Prince Wakada of the Commandery, Beizi Shangshan, Tunqi, and others were ordered to Ajige's army.

sentences.zh: 調八旗游牧蒙古官軍之半，戍阿爾齊土蘇門哈達。

translations.literal: Transferred half of the Eight Banners' nomadic Mongol troops to garrison Erdet Sumun Khada.
translations.idiomatic: Half the Eight Banners' nomadic Mongol forces were posted to garrison Erdet Sumun Khada.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，姜瓖以大同叛，總督耿焞走陽和。

translations.literal: Guisi day: Jiang Xiang rebelled at Datong; Governor-General Geng Zhun fled to Yanghe.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Jiang Xiang rebelled at Datong; Governor-General Geng Zhun fled to Yanghe.

sentences.zh: 丙申，免平山、隆平、清豐災賦。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Pingshan, Longping, and Qingfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, disaster taxes were remitted in Pingshan, Longping, and Qingfeng.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，阿濟格圍大同。

translations.literal: Wuxu day: Ajige besieged Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Ajige besieged Datong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復遣梅勒章京阿喇善、侍郎噶達渾詣阿濟格軍。

translations.literal: Xinchou day: again dispatched Meire Janggin Arasan and Vice-Minister Gadahun to Ajige's army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Meire Janggin Arasan and Vice-Minister Gadahun were again sent to Ajige's army.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，免大同災賦。

translations.literal: Guimao day: remitted disaster tax assessments of Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, disaster taxes were remitted in Datong.

sentences.zh: 壬子，楊捷等復都昌，獲故明兵部尚書余應桂，斬之。

translations.literal: Renzi day: Yang Jie and others recovered Duchang, captured former Ming Minister of War Yu Yinggui, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Yang Jie and others retook Duchang, seized the former Ming minister of war Yu Yinggui, and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以佟養量為宣大總督。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: appointed Tong Yangliang Governor-General of Xuan and Da.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Tong Yangliang was made Governor-General of Xuan and Da.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蘇尼特、扎魯特等部來朝。

translations.literal: That year the Sunite, Jarud, and other tribes came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Sunite, Jarud, and other tribes came to court.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮，喀爾喀部俄木布額爾德尼、戴青訥門汗喇嘛、塞爾濟額爾德尼魏正、碩雷汗、邁達理胡土克圖、扎薩克圖汗下額爾德尼哈談巴圖魯，厄魯特部顧實汗、錫勒圖綽爾濟、諾門汗，索倫部阿濟布，鄂爾多斯部單達，蘇尼特部騰機忒，科爾沁貝勒張繼倫，歸化城固倫第瓦胡土克圖、丹津喇嘛額爾德尼寨桑，土默特部古祿格，烏思藏闡化王王舒克，湯古特達賴喇嘛俱來貢。

translations.literal: Korea; the Khalkha Ombo Erdeni, Daiqing Nomun Khan Lama, Sergi Erdeni Wei Zheng, Sure Khan, Maidari Khutukhtu, Erdeni Khatan Batür under the Jasagtu Khan; the Oirat Gushi Khan, Siletu Janggin, and Nomun Khan; the Solon Ajibu; the Ordos Danda; the Sunite Tengjite; Khorchin Beile Zhang Jilun; the Guihuacheng Gurun Diwa Khutukhtu and Danjin Lama Erdeni Saichan; the Tumed Guluge; the Tibetan Dharma-King Shuk of Chamdö; and the Tangut Dalai Lama all came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Korea; Khalkha and Oirat nobles and lamas; the Solon Ajibu; Ordos, Sunite, and Khorchin leaders; the Guihuacheng Gurun Diwa khutukhtu and Danjin lama; the Tumed Guluge; the Tibetan king of Chamdö; and the Dalai Lama of Tibet.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、厄魯特顧實汗、湯古特達賴喇嘛再至。

translations.literal: Korea, the Oirat Gushri Khan, and the Tangut Dalai Lama came again.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, the Oirat Gushri Khan, and the Tangut Dalai Lama presented tribute again.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月壬戌，官軍復羅源、永春、德化等縣。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day renxu: government troops recovered Luoyuan, Yongchun, Dehua, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the renxu day of the first month of spring, government forces retook Luoyuan, Yongchun, Dehua, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命多羅敬謹郡王尼堪等征太原。

translations.literal: Day guihai: ordered Doroi Jingjin Prince Nikan and others to campaign against Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Doroi Jingjin Prince Nikan and others were ordered to campaign against Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，諭曰：「朕欲天下臣民共登衽席，日夕圖維，罔敢怠忽。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, an edict said: "We wish all officials and people under Heaven to share the same mat and cover; day and night we plot and maintain, daring no neglect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen an edict said: "I desire that all under Heaven—official and commoner alike—may live in peace. Day and night I labor at governance and dare not slacken.

sentences.zh: 往年流寇作亂，慘禍已極，入關討賊，士庶歸心。

translations.literal: In former years roaming bandits rose in disorder and calamity reached its limit; entering the Pass to punish the bandits, scholars and commoners turned their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: When the roaming rebels ravaged the land and misery ran to the utmost, we entered the Pass to punish them, and the people gave us their hearts.

sentences.zh: 乃邇年不軌之徒，捏作洗民訛言。

translations.literal: Yet in recent years unscrupulous men have fabricated slanderous talk of 'cleansing the people.'
translations.idiomatic: Yet in recent years wicked men have spread rumors that the court means to 'purge the populace.'

sentences.zh: 小民無知輕信，惶惑逃散，作亂者往往而有。

translations.literal: Small folk, ignorant and credulous, fled in panic and scattered; those who rose in disorder were often to be found.
translations.idiomatic: Ignorant commoners believed them, fled in terror, and rebellions broke out again and again.

sentences.zh: 朕聞不嗜殺人，能一天下。

translations.literal: We have heard that one who does not delight in killing men can unite all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that he who does not delight in killing can unite the realm.

sentences.zh: 書云：『眾非元後何戴，後非眾罔與守邦。

translations.literal: The Book says: 'If the masses lack a sovereign, whom shall they uphold? If the sovereign lacks the masses, with whom shall he guard the state?'
translations.idiomatic: The Book says: 'Without a sovereign the people have none to uphold; without the people the sovereign has none with whom to keep the realm.'

sentences.zh: 』君殘其民，理所蔑有。

translations.literal: ' A ruler who harms his people—reason affords no such thing.
translations.idiomatic: A ruler who harms his people is a thing reason itself rejects.

sentences.zh: 自元年來，今六年矣，寧有無故而屠戮民者。

translations.literal: From the first year until now, six years have passed—would there be slaughter of the people without cause?
translations.idiomatic: From the first year to this sixth year, would I slaughter the people without cause?

sentences.zh: 民苟思之，疑且冰釋。

translations.literal: If the people but reflect on this, doubt will melt like ice.
translations.idiomatic: If the people but think on this, their doubts will melt like ice.

sentences.zh: 至於自甘為賊，樂就死地，必有所迫以致此。

translations.literal: As for those who willingly become bandits and gladly rush to death, there must be compulsion that drives them to this.
translations.idiomatic: Those who willingly become rebels and rush to death must be driven by some unbearable pressure.

sentences.zh: 豈督、撫、鎮、按不得其人，有司朘削，民難自存歟？

translations.literal: Is it that governors-general, governors, regional commanders, and surveillance commissioners are not the right men, that local officials squeeze and the people cannot keep themselves?
translations.idiomatic: Are the wrong men in the posts of governor-general, governor, regional commander, and surveillance commissioner? Do local officials extort until the people cannot survive?

sentences.zh: 將蠲免賦稅，有名無實歟？

translations.literal: Or is it that remissions of tax and levies exist in name but not in fact?
translations.idiomatic: Or are tax remissions proclaimed in name but never truly granted?

sentences.zh: 內外各官其確議興利除弊之策，朕次第酌行之。

translations.literal: Officials within and without the court should deliberate policies to promote benefit and remove harm; We shall weigh and enact them in order.
translations.idiomatic: Let every official within and without the court propose concrete measures to promote good and abolish abuse; I shall weigh them and put them into practice in turn.

sentences.zh: 」辛未，姜瓖黨姚舉等殺冀寧道王昌齡，陷忻州，固山額真阿賴破走之。

translations.literal: " Day xinwei: Jiang Xiang's party Yao Ju and others killed Jining Circuit intendant Wang Changling, seized Xinzhou; gushan ejen Arai routed and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yao Ju and other partisans of Jiang Xiang killed Jining Circuit intendant Wang Changling and seized Xinzhou; gushan ejen Arai routed and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，諭曰：「設關徵稅，原以譏察姦宄，非與商賈較輜銖也。

translations.literal: Day yihai, an edict said: "Establishing passes to levy tax was originally to scrutinize and detect traitors and villains, not to haggle over cash with merchants.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict said: "Customs posts were established to detect traitors and villains, not to wring cash from merchants.

sentences.zh: 其各以原額起稅，毋得橫徵以充私橐，違者罪之。

translations.literal: Let each levy tax at the original quota; none may levy arbitrarily to fill private purses—violators will be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Each post shall levy only the original quota; none may exact arbitrary surcharges for private gain—violators will be punished.

sentences.zh: 」諭山西大同軍民，無為姜瓖脅誘，來歸者悉予矜免。

translations.literal: " An edict to the military and people of Datong in Shanxi: do not be coerced and enticed by Jiang Xiang; those who come over will all receive clemency.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the army and people of Datong in Shanxi warned them not to follow Jiang Xiang's coercion; all who submitted would be spared.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，行保舉連坐之法。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: implemented the law of joint responsibility for recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the law of joint responsibility for recommendations was put into effect.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，諭言官論事不實者，廷臣集議，毋輒下刑部。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: edict that when censor-officials' memorials on affairs were not factual, court ministers should assemble in deliberation and not rashly send cases down to the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen it was ordered that when remonstrating officials memorialized on false grounds, the court should deliberate in assembly rather than rush cases to the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以金廷獻為偏沅巡撫。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: made Jin Tingxian Governor of Pian-Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Jin Tingxian was made Governor of Pian-Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，譚泰、何洛會復南昌，金聲桓投水死，王得仁伏誅，九江、南康、瑞州、臨江、袁州悉平。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Tantai and Hošoi recovered Nanchang; Jin Shengheng drowned himself, Wang Deren was executed, and Jiujiang, Nankang, Ruizhou, Linjiang, and Yuanzhou were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Tantai and Hošoi retook Nanchang; Jin Shengheng drowned himself and Wang Deren was executed; Jiujiang, Nankang, Ruizhou, Linjiang, and Yuanzhou were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 癸未，山西賊黨劉遷寇代州，阿濟洛遣軍破走之。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Shanxi rebel party Liu Qian raided Daizhou; Ajilo dispatched troops and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Shanxi rebel Liu Qian raided Daizhou; Ajilo sent troops and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，攝政王多爾袞征大同。

translations.literal: Second month, day guimao: Prince Regent Dorgon campaigned against Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the second month, Prince Regent Dorgon marched against Datong.

sentences.zh: 免直隸省六年以前荒賦、四川商民鹽課。

translations.literal: Remitted wasteland tax assessments before the sixth year in Zhili province and the salt levy on Sichuan merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Wasteland tax assessments in Zhili before the sixth year and the salt levy on Sichuan merchants were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，故明宗室朱森釜等犯階州，吳三桂擊斬之。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: former Ming imperial clansman Zhu Senfu and others raided Jiezhou; Wu Sangui attacked and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the former Ming clansmen Zhu Senfu and others raided Jiezhou; Wu Sangui attacked and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，多爾袞拔渾源州。

translations.literal: Third month, day guihai: Dorgon took Hunyuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the third month, Dorgon took Hunyuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，漢羌總兵官張天福平賊渠覃一涵，獲故明山陰王等斬之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Han-Qiang regional commander Zhang Tianfu pacified the bandit chieftain Tan Yihan, captured the former Ming Prince of Shanyin and others, and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Han-Qiang regional commander Zhang Tianfu suppressed the bandit chieftain Tan Yihan, seized the former Ming Prince of Shanyin and others, and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，土賊王永強陷延安、榆林等十九州縣，延綏巡撫王正志等死之。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: local bandit Wang Yongqiang seized Yan'an, Yulin, and nineteen other prefectures and counties; Yan-Sui Governor Wang Zhengzhi and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the local rebel Wang Yongqiang seized Yan'an, Yulin, and nineteen other districts; Yan-Sui Governor Wang Zhengzhi and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，應州、山陰降，多爾袞旋師，留阿濟格於大同。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Yingzhou and Shanyin submitted; Dorgon wheeled the army and left Ajige at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yingzhou and Shanyin submitted; Dorgon turned the army homeward and left Ajige at Datong.

sentences.zh: 辛未，進封多羅承澤郡王碩塞、多羅端重郡王博洛、多羅敬謹郡王尼堪為親王。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: advanced Doroi Chenze Prince Suose, Doroi Duanzhong Prince Boluo, and Doroi Jingjin Prince Nikan to princes of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Doroi Chenze Prince Suose, Doroi Duanzhong Prince Boluo, and Doroi Jingjin Prince Nikan were advanced to princes of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 王永強陷同官。

translations.literal: Wang Yongqiang seized Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yongqiang seized Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，廣信府知府楊國楨等復玉山縣。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Guangxin prefect Yang Guozhen and others recovered Yushan county.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Guangxin Prefect Yang Guozhen and others retook Yushan county.

sentences.zh: 寧夏官軍克臨河等堡。

translations.literal: Ningxia government troops took Linhe and other forts.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia government troops took Linhe and other forts.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，甘、涼逆回米喇印、丁國棟復作亂，甘肅巡撫張文衡等死之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the rebellious Muslims Mi La'in and Ding Guodong again rose in Gansu and Liang; Gansu Governor Zhang Wenheng and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Muslim rebels Mi La'in and Ding Guodong rose again in Gansu and Liang; Gansu Governor Zhang Wenheng and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，輔政和碩德豫親王多鐸薨，攝政王多爾袞師次居庸，還京臨喪。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: assisting regent Prince of the First Rank of Yu Dodo died; Prince Regent Dorgon halted the army at Juyong and returned to the capital to attend the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, assisting regent Prince Dodo died; Prince Regent Dorgon halted at Juyong Pass and returned to the capital for the mourning.

sentences.zh: 甲申，減隱匿逃人律。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: reduced the statutes on concealing fugitive bondsmen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the penalties for concealing fugitive bondsmen were reduced.

sentences.zh: 譚泰、何洛會破賊於南康，進克信豐，叛將李成棟走死，復撫州、建昌。

translations.literal: Tantai and Hošoi defeated bandits at Nankang, advanced and took Xinfeng; the rebel general Li Chengdong fled and died; recovered Fuzhou and Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Tantai and Hošoi defeated rebels at Nankang, advanced to take Xinfeng; the rebel general Li Chengdong fled and died; Fuzhou and Jianchang were recovered.

sentences.zh: 江西平。

translations.literal: Jiangxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，博洛遣鰲拜等大破姜瓖於大同北山。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Boluo sent Oboi and others to rout Jiang Xiang greatly at the northern hills of Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Boluo sent Oboi and others to rout Jiang Xiang decisively at the northern hills of Datong.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂擊敗王永強，復宜君、同官。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui defeated Wang Yongqiang and recovered Yijun and Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui defeated Wang Yongqiang and recovered Yijun and Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，遣羅碩、卦喇駐防太原。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengyin: dispatched Luo Shuo and Guala to garrison Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the fourth month of summer, Luo Shuo and Guala were sent to garrison Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，阿濟格復左衛。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Ajige recovered Zuowei.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Ajige recovered Zuowei.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命貝子吳達海等代征大同。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: ordered Beise Mandahai and others to replace the campaign against Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Beise Mandahai and others were ordered to take over the Datong campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙申，吳三桂克蒲縣。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Wu Sangui took Pu county.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Wu Sangui took Pu county.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，福建官軍復平和、詔安、漳平、寧洋。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Fujian government troops recovered Pinghe, Zhao'an, Zhangping, and Ningyang.
