translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Fujian government troops retook Pinghe, Zhao'an, Zhangping, and Ningyang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜劉子壯等進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: bestowed jinshi and other examination ranks on Liu Zizhuang and others in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Liu Zizhuang and other graduates were granted jinshi and related ranks in differing measure.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇太后崩。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，諭曰：「兵興以來，地荒民逃，流離無告。

translations.literal: Day renzi, an edict said: "Since warfare arose, land lies waste and people flee; the displaced have none to appeal to.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict said: "Since the wars began, fields lie waste and people flee homeless, with none to aid them.

sentences.zh: 其令所在有司廣加招徠，給以荒田，永為口業，六年之後，方議徵租。

translations.literal: Let local officials everywhere widely recruit and induce settlement, grant wasteland as permanent holdings, and only after six years begin to discuss levying rent.
translations.idiomatic: Let local officials everywhere recruit settlers, grant wasteland as permanent holdings, and levy rent only after six years.

sentences.zh: 各州縣以招民勸耕之多寡、道府以責成催督之勤惰為殿最。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties shall be graded on how many people they recruit and how much they urge cultivation; circuits and prefectures on how diligently they supervise and urge.
translations.idiomatic: Counties shall be ranked on how many people they recruit and urge to farm; circuits and prefectures on how diligently they supervise.

sentences.zh: 歲終，撫按考核以聞。

translations.literal: At year's end, governors and surveillance commissioners shall examine and report.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end governors and surveillance commissioners shall examine performance and report.

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，以董宗聖為延綏巡撫。

translations.literal: " Day guichou: made Dong Zongsheng Governor of Yan-Sui.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Dong Zongsheng was made Governor of Yan-Sui.

sentences.zh: 官軍克福寧，福建平。

translations.literal: Government troops took Funing; Fujian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops took Funing; Fujian was pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賊黨陷汾州，命和碩端重親王博洛為定西大將軍，帥師討之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: rebel party seized Fenzhou; ordered Prince of the First Rank of Duanzhong Boluo as Grand General Pacifying the West, leading troops to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao rebels seized Fenzhou; Prince Boluo of Duanzhong was made Grand General Pacifying the West and sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 和碩敬謹親王尼堪移師大同。

translations.literal: Prince of the First Rank of Jingjin Nikan shifted his army to Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Nikan of Jingjin shifted his army to Datong.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，封貝子滿達海為和碩親王。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: enfeoffed Beise Mandahai as Prince of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Beise Mandahai was enfeoffed as a prince of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，遣屠賴率師赴太原軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: dispatched Tolai leading troops to join the Taiyuan army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the fifth month, Tolai was sent with troops to reinforce the Taiyuan army.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以李棲鳳為廣東巡撫，郭肇基為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: made Li Qifeng Governor of Guangdong and Guo Zhaoji Governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Li Qifeng was made Governor of Guangdong and Guo Zhaoji Governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 免太原、平陽、汾州三府，遼、澤二州災賦。

translations.literal: Remitted disaster tax assessments of Taiyuan, Pingyang, and Fenzhou prefectures and Liao and Ze prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster tax assessments were remitted in Taiyuan, Pingyang, and Fenzhou prefectures and in Liao and Ze prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改封孔有德為定南王，耿仲明為靖南王，尚可喜為平南王。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: changed the enfeoffment of Kong Youde to Prince of Dingnan, Geng Zhongming to Prince of Jingnan, and Shang Kexi to Prince of Pingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Kong Youde was made Prince of Dingnan, Geng Zhongming Prince of Jingnan, and Shang Kexi Prince of Pingnan.

sentences.zh: 命孔有德征廣西，耿仲明、尚可喜征廣東，各挈家駐防。

translations.literal: Ordered Kong Youde to campaign against Guangxi and Geng Zhongming and Shang Kexi against Guangdong, each bringing his household to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Youde was ordered to campaign in Guangxi; Geng Zhongming and Shang Kexi in Guangdong—each with his household to garrison the province.

sentences.zh: 裁直隸、江南、山東、浙江、陝西同知十，直隸、江南、河南、湖廣、江西、浙江通判二十一。

translations.literal: Abolished ten subprefects in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Zhejiang, and Shaanxi, and twenty-one assistant prefects in Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ten subprefects in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Zhejiang, and Shaanxi and twenty-one assistant prefects in Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang were abolished.

sentences.zh: 免寶坻、順義五年災賦。

translations.literal: Remitted disaster tax assessments of the fifth year in Baodi and Shunyi.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth-year disaster tax assessments in Baodi and Shunyi were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，吳三桂、李國翰復延安。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Wu Sangui and Li Guohan recovered Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Wu Sangui and Li Guohan recovered Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 壬午，四川邊郡平。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the border prefectures of Sichuan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the border prefectures of Sichuan were pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，和碩端重親王博洛復清源、交城、文水、徐溝、祁等縣。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Prince Boluo of Duanzhong recovered Qingyuan, Jiaocheng, Wenshui, Xugou, Qi, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Prince Boluo of Duanzhong retook Qingyuan, Jiaocheng, Wenshui, Xugou, Qi, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，朝鮮國王李倧薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengzi: the King of Korea Yi Jong died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the sixth month, King Yi Jong of Korea died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免滄州、清苑六年以前荒賦。

translations.literal: Day renzi: remitted wasteland tax assessments before the sixth year in Cangzhou and Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, wasteland tax assessments before the sixth year in Cangzhou and Qingyuan were remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，封張應京為正一嗣教大真人。

translations.literal: Day guichou: enfeoffed Zhang Yingjing as True One Successor-Teacher Great Perfected Man.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhang Yingjing was enfeoffed as True One Successor-Teacher Great Perfected Man of the Daoist church.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免江西四年、五年逋賦。

translations.literal: Day yimao: remitted tax arrears of the fourth and fifth years in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, fourth- and fifth-year tax arrears in Jiangxi were remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午朔，攝政王多爾袞復征大同。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day wuwu: Prince Regent Dorgon again campaigned against Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, wuwu, Prince Regent Dorgon again marched against Datong.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，滿達海、瓦克達征朔州、寧武。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Mandahai and Wakda campaigned against Shuozhou and Ningwu.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Mandahai and Wakda campaigned against Shuozhou and Ningwu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，免開封等府災賦。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: remitted disaster tax assessments of Kaifeng and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, disaster tax assessments in Kaifeng and other prefectures were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，多爾袞至阿魯席巴爾台，校獵而還。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Dorgon reached Arušibar Tai, hunted, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Dorgon reached Arušibar Tai, hunted, and returned.

sentences.zh: 遣纛章京索洪等益滿達海軍。

translations.literal: Dispatched da janggin Suohong and others to reinforce Mandahai's army.
translations.idiomatic: Da janggin Suohong and others were sent to reinforce Mandahai's army.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，官軍平黃州賊三百餘砦，斬故明王朱蘊肏等。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: government troops pacified more than three hundred bandit stockades at Huangzhou and beheaded the former Ming prince Zhu Yunfu and others.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, government troops pacified more than three hundred rebel stockades at Huangzhou and beheaded the former Ming prince Zhu Yunfu and others.

sentences.zh: 甲申，廣東餘寇犯南贛，官軍擊卻之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: remnant bandits in Guangdong raided southern Gan; government troops repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Guangdong remnant rebels raided southern Gan; government troops drove them off.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吳三桂、李國翰復延綏鎮城。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Wu Sangui and Li Guohan recovered Yan-Sui walled city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wu Sangui and Li Guohan recovered the walled city of Yan-Sui.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，攝政王多爾袞還京。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guisi: Prince Regent Dorgon returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the eighth month, Prince Regent Dorgon returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 山西賊黨陷蒲州及臨晉、河津，孟喬芳討平之。

translations.literal: Shanxi rebel party seized Pu prefecture and Linjin and Hejin; Meng Qiaofang suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi rebels seized Pu prefecture, Linjin, and Hejin; Meng Qiaofang suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，免真定、順德、廣平、大名災賦。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: remitted disaster tax assessments of Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, disaster tax assessments in Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming were remitted.

sentences.zh: 滿達海復朔州、馬邑。

translations.literal: Mandahai recovered Shuozhou and Mayi.
translations.idiomatic: Mandahai recovered Shuozhou and Mayi.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，端重親王博洛拔孝義。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Prince Boluo of Duanzhong took Xiaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Prince Boluo of Duanzhong took Xiaoyi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鄭親王濟爾哈朗等克湘潭，獲何騰蛟，不屈，殺之。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Prince of Zheng Jirhalang and others took Xiangtan, captured He Tengjiao; he would not submit and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Prince Jirhalang of Zheng and others took Xiangtan and captured He Tengjiao; when he refused to submit he was executed.

sentences.zh: 辰州、寶慶、靖州、衡州悉平。

translations.literal: Chenzhou, Baoding, Jingzhou, and Hengzhou were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Chenzhou, Baoding, Jingzhou, and Hengzhou were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 進克全州。

translations.literal: Advanced and took Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced and took Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，封朝鮮世子李淏為朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: enfeoffed the Korean heir Yi Ho as King of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Korean heir Yi Ho was enfeoffed as King of Korea.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以張孝仁為直隸山東河南總督。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: made Zhang Xiaoren Governor-General of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhang Xiaoren was made Governor-General of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣英親王阿濟格、貝子鞏阿岱等征大同。

translations.literal: Day renzi: dispatched Prince Ying Ajige, Beise Gongadai, and others to campaign against Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Prince Ajige, Beise Gongadai, and others were dispatched against Datong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，梅勒章京根特等拔猗氏。

translations.literal: Day guichou: meire janggin Gent and others took Yishi.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, meire janggin Gent and others took Yishi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大同賊被圍久，飢死殆盡，偽總兵楊震威斬姜瓖及其弟琳來獻。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Datong rebels, long besieged, starved until nearly all were dead; the false regional commander Yang Zhenwei beheaded Jiang Xiang and his brother Lin and came to present [their heads].
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Datong rebels, long besieged, starved until nearly all perished; the false regional commander Yang Zhenwei killed Jiang Xiang and his brother Lin and presented their heads in surrender.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，寧武關偽總兵劉偉等率眾降，靜樂、寧化山寨悉平。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the false regional commander Liu Wei and others at Ningwu Pass led the masses in surrender; stockaded strongholds of Jingle and Ninghua were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the false regional commander Liu Wei and others at Ningwu Pass surrendered with their followers; stockades in Jingle and Ninghua were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，封鄂穆布為多羅達爾漢卓禮克圖郡王，蘇尼特部噶爾麻為多羅貝勒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: enfeoffed E Muhe as Doroi Dalhan Jirukitu Prince of the Commandery, and Garma of the Sunite tribe as Doroi Beile.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the ninth month, E Muhe was made Doroi Dalhan Jirukitu Prince of the Commandery and Garma of the Sunite tribe Doroi Beile.

sentences.zh: 甲子，鄂爾多斯部額林臣、布達岱、顧祿、阿濟格札穆蘇等來降，封額林臣為多羅郡王，布達岱子伊廩臣、顧祿子色冷為固山貝子，阿濟格札穆蘇為鎮國公。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Elinjin, Budadai, Gulü, Ajige Jamusu, and others of the Ordos tribe came to surrender; Elinjin was enfeoffed Doroi Prince of the Commandery, Budadai's son Yichen and Gulü's son Seleng gushan beise, and Ajige Jamusu Baron of the State Who Pacifies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Elinjin, Budadai, Gulü, Ajige Jamusu, and others of the Ordos came in; Elinjin was made Doroi Prince of the Commandery, Budadai's son Yichen and Gulü's son Seleng gushan beise, and Ajige Jamusu Baron Who Pacifies the State.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以夏玉為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: made Xia Yu Governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Xia Yu was made Governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封固倫額駙祁他特為多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: enfeoffed the imperial son-in-law Qitete as Doroi Prince of the Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the imperial son-in-law Qitete was enfeoffed Doroi Prince of the Commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，滿達海、博洛克汾州、平陽。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Mandahai and Boluo took Fenzhou and Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Mandahai and Boluo took Fenzhou and Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，封多尼為和碩親王，傑書為多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuzi: enfeoffed Doni as Prince of the First Rank and Jieshu as Doroi Prince of the Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the tenth month of winter, Doni was enfeoffed prince of the first rank and Jieshu Doroi Prince of the Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the capital region was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, an earthquake struck the capital region.

sentences.zh: 甲午，封勞親為親王。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: enfeoffed Laqin as prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Laqin was enfeoffed prince.

sentences.zh: 官軍復鄆城。

translations.literal: Government troops recovered Yuncheng.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops recovered Yuncheng.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，降將楊登州叛，陷山陰。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the surrendered general Yang Dengzhou rebelled and seized Shanyin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the surrendered general Yang Dengzhou rebelled and seized Shanyin.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免山東東平、長山等十八州縣五年災賦，江西六年以前明季遼餉。

translations.literal: Day jihai: remitted disaster tax assessments of the fifth year in eighteen prefectures and counties including Dongping and Changshan in Shandong, and Ming-season Liaodong surcharges in Jiangxi before the sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, fifth-year disaster taxes in eighteen Shandong districts including Dongping and Changshan were remitted, as were Ming Liaodong surcharges in Jiangxi levied before the sixth year.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，攝政王多爾袞征喀爾喀部二楚虎爾。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Prince Regent Dorgon campaigned against the Khalkha chieftain Erchughur.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Prince Regent Dorgon campaigned against the Khalkha chieftain Erchughur.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，陝西總兵官任珍擊故明將唐仲亨於屠油壩，斬之，並誅故明王朱常渶、朱由杠等。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Shaanxi regional commander Ren Zhen attacked the former Ming general Tang Zhongheng at Tuyouba, beheaded him, and also executed the former Ming princes Zhu Changying, Zhu Yougang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Shaanxi regional commander Ren Zhen attacked the former Ming general Tang Zhongheng at Tuyouba, beheaded him, and also executed the former Ming princes Zhu Changying, Zhu Yougang, and others.

sentences.zh: 丙午，官軍復潞安。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: government troops recovered Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, government troops recovered Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 丁未，官軍克榆林。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: government troops took Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, government troops took Yulin.

sentences.zh: 己酉，滿達海等拔沁、遼二州。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Mandahai and others took Qin and Liao prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Mandahai and others took Qin and Liao prefectures.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命滿達海還京，留瓦克達等定山西。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: ordered Mandahai to return to the capital and left Wakda and others to settle Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Mandahai was ordered back to the capital; Wakda and others were left to settle Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，免直隸開、元城等縣徭賦，陝西岷州災賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingyin: remitted corvée levies of Kai and Yuancheng and other counties in Zhili and disaster tax assessments of Minzhou in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the eleventh month, corvée levies in Kai, Yuancheng, and other Zhili counties and disaster taxes in Minzhou, Shaanxi, were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，多爾袞自喀吞布喇克旋師。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Dorgon wheeled the army from Khatun Bulag.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Dorgon returned from Khatun Bulag.

sentences.zh: 免宣府災賦。

translations.literal: Remitted disaster tax assessments of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster tax assessments in Xuanfu were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬午，耿仲明軍次吉安，畏罪自殺。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Geng Zhongming's army halted at Ji'an; fearing punishment, he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Geng Zhongming's army halted at Ji'an; fearing punishment, he killed himself.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉朔，山西興、芮城、平陸三縣平。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day yiyou: Xing, Ruicheng, and Pinglu counties in Shanxi were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, yiyou, Xing, Ruicheng, and Pinglu counties in Shanxi were pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊子，故明桂王將焦璉寇全州，勒克德渾等擊敗之，進克道州。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the former Ming Gui Prince's general Jiao Lian raided Quanzhou; Lekedehun and others defeated him and advanced to take Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the former Ming Gui Prince's general Jiao Lian raided Quanzhou; Lekedehun and others defeated him and advanced to take Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 努山等拔烏撒城。

translations.literal: Nusan and others took Wusa city.
translations.idiomatic: Nusan and others took Wusa city.

sentences.zh: 宜爾都齊等克黎平。

translations.literal: Yierduqi and others took Liping.
translations.idiomatic: Yierduqi and others took Liping.

sentences.zh: 己酉，官軍復鄰水、大竹二縣。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: government troops recovered Linshui and Dazhu counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, government troops recovered Linshui and Dazhu counties.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，寧波、紹興、台州土寇平。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: local bandits in Ningbo, Shaoxing, and Taizhou were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, local bandits in Ningbo, Shaoxing, and Taizhou were pacified.

sentences.zh: 是年，朝鮮、阿霸垓、烏朱穆秦、土默特諸部，厄魯特部阿巴賴諾顏、績克什虎巴圖魯台吉、顧實汗子下達賴烏巴什溫布塔布囊，鄂爾多斯部郡王額林臣，喀爾喀部土謝圖汗、碩雷汗、戴青諾顏，歸化城土默特部古祿格等，伊喇古克三胡土克圖下戴青溫布達爾漢囊蘇及達賴喇嘛俱來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, the Abagai, Ujumucin, and Tumed tribes, the Oirat nobles Abalai Noyan, Jekeshi Hubatur Taiji, and the Dalai Ubashi Tabunang under Gushri Khan's son, Ordos Prince Elinjin, the Khalkha Tüsiyetü Khan, Šure Khan, and Daiqing Noyan, the Tumed Güluke of Guihuacheng, the Ila Gukusan Hutuktu's Daiqing Umbadarhan Nangsu and Dalai Lama, and others all came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea, the Abagai, Ujumucin, and Tumed tribes, Oirat nobles including Abalai Noyan and Jekeshi Hubatur Taiji, Ordos Prince Elinjin, Khalkha khans and nobles, Güluke of Guihuacheng Tumed, the Ila Gukusan Hutuktu's Daiqing Umbadarhan Nangsu, the Dalai Lama, and others all presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、喀爾喀土謝圖汗再至。

translations.literal: Korea and the Khalkha Tüsiyetü Khan came again.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and the Khalkha Tüsiyetü Khan presented tribute again.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月庚申，官軍復永寧、寧鄉。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day gengshen: government troops recovered Yongning and Ningxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the gengshen day of the first month of spring, government forces retook Yongning and Ningxiang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，官軍復南雄。

translations.literal: Day renxu: government troops recovered Nanxiong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, government troops recovered Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封鄂爾多斯部單達為貝勒，沙克查為貝子。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: enfeoffed Danda of the Ordos tribe as Beile and Shakcha as Beise.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Danda of the Ordos was enfeoffed Beile and Shakcha Beise.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，故明德化王朱慈業、石城王朱議陷大田，官軍討平之。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the former Ming Prince of Dehua Zhu Ciye and Prince of Shicheng Zhu Yi seized Datian; government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the former Ming Prince of Dehua Zhu Ciye and Prince of Shicheng Zhu Yi seized Datian; government troops suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，和碩鄭親王濟爾哈朗師還。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Prince of Zheng Jirhalang's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Prince Jirhalang of Zheng's army returned.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，上太后諡曰孝端正敬仁懿庄敏輔天協聖文皇后。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: posthumous title of the Empress Dowager was raised as Empress Xiaoduan Zhengjing Renyi Zhuangmin Futian Xiesheng Wen.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the second month, the late Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaoduan Zhengjing Renyi Zhuangmin Futian Xiesheng Wen.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以劉弘遇為山西巡撫，王一品為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: made Liu Hongyu Governor of Shanxi and Wang Yipin Governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Liu Hongyu was made Governor of Shanxi and Wang Yipin Governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 李建泰據太平叛，官軍圍之，出降，伏誅。

translations.literal: Li Jiantai held Taiping in rebellion; government troops besieged it; he came out and surrendered and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiantai held Taiping in rebellion; government troops besieged him; he surrendered and was executed.

sentences.zh: 平陽、潞安、澤州屬境俱平。

translations.literal: The territories subordinate to Pingyang, Lu'an, and Zezhou were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The districts under Pingyang, Lu'an, and Zezhou were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，日赤色如血。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei: the sun was red as blood.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the third month, the sun appeared red as blood.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，孔有德擒故明將黃順、林國瑞於興寧，降其眾五萬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: Kong Youde captured the former Ming generals Huang Shun and Lin Guorui at Xingning and reduced their host of fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fourth month of summer, Kong Youde at Xingning captured the former Ming generals Huang Shun and Lin Guorui and accepted the surrender of fifty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 丙申，封科爾沁貝勒張繼倫為郡王。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: enfeoffed Horqin Beile Zhang Jilun as Prince of the Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Horqin Beile Zhang Jilun was enfeoffed Prince of the Commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，多羅謙郡王瓦克達師還。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Doroi Qian Prince Wakda's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Doroi Qian Prince Wakda's army returned.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，保德州民崔耀等擒故明將牛化麟，斬之，以城降。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou: Baode prefecture commoners Cui Yao and others captured the former Ming general Niu Hualin, beheaded him, and surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the sixth month, Baode commoners Cui Yao and others captured the former Ming general Niu Hualin, beheaded him, and surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，官軍復寧都、石城。

translations.literal: Day guimao: government troops recovered Ningdu and Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, government troops recovered Ningdu and Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子朔，享太廟。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day renzi: offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, renzi, sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，攝政王多爾袞議建邊城避暑，加派直隸、山西、浙江、山東、江南、河南、湖廣、江西、陝西九省錢糧二百五十萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Prince Regent Dorgon proposed building a border city for summer retreat and imposed an additional levy of more than 2,500,000 taels of silver on the nine provinces Zhili, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Shandong, Jiangnan, Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Prince Regent Dorgon proposed a summer palace on the frontier and imposed an additional levy of more than 2,500,000 taels on Zhili, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Shandong, Jiangnan, Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸攝政王多爾袞第。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Emperor visited Prince Regent Dorgon's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the emperor visited Prince Regent Dorgon's residence.

sentences.zh: 多爾袞以貝子錫翰等擅請臨幸，下其罪，貝子錫翰降鎮國公，冷僧機、鰲拜等黜罰有差。

translations.literal: Dorgon because Beise Xihan and others had presumptuously requested the imperial visit punished their offense; Beise Xihan was reduced to Baron Who Pacifies the State, and Leng Sengji, Oboi, and others were dismissed or penalized in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon punished Beise Xihan and others for presumptuously requesting the imperial visit; Xihan was reduced to Baron Who Pacifies the State, and Leng Sengji, Oboi, and others were dismissed or penalized in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以馬之先為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Day renxu: made Ma Zhixian Governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Ma Zhixian was made Governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛未，免西寧各堡寨五年災賦。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: remitted disaster tax assessments of the fifth year at the various forts and stockades of Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, fifth-year disaster tax assessments at Xining's forts and stockades were remitted.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，降和碩端重親王博洛、和碩敬謹親王尼堪為多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dinghai: reduced Princes Boluo of Duanzhong and Nikan of Jingjin to Doroi princes of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the eighth month, Princes Boluo of Duanzhong and Nikan of Jingjin were reduced to Doroi princes of the commandery.

sentences.zh: 己丑，封巴林部塞卜騰、蒿齊忒部孛羅特為多羅郡王，科爾沁國顧穆、喀喇沁部古祿思喜布為多羅貝勒，改承澤親王碩塞、親王勞親為多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Day jichou: enfeoffed Sebuteng of the Barin tribe and Borot of the Haoqit tribe as Doroi princes of the commandery, Gu Mu of Horqin state and Gülsib of the Kharachin tribe as Doroi beile, and changed Prince Suose of Chenze and Prince Laqin to Doroi princes of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Sebuteng of the Barin and Borot of the Haoqit were made Doroi princes of the commandery, Gu Mu of Horqin and Gülsib of Kharachin Doroi beile, and Princes Suose of Chenze and Laqin were reduced to Doroi princes of the commandery.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，故明將鄭成功寇潮州，總兵官王邦俊擊走之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin: the former Ming general Zheng Chenggong raided Chaozhou; regional commander Wang Bangjun repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the ninth month, the former Ming general Zheng Chenggong raided Chaozhou; regional commander Wang Bangjun drove him off.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免蘄、麻城等七州縣五、六兩年荒賦。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: remitted wasteland tax assessments of the fifth and sixth years in seven prefectures and counties including Qi and Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, fifth- and sixth-year wasteland tax assessments in seven districts including Qi and Macheng were remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day xinsi: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, xinsi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己亥，定陝西茶馬例。

translations.literal: Day jihai: fixed regulations for Shaanxi tea and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, regulations for Shaanxi's tea-and-horse trade were fixed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，官軍克邵武，獲故明閣部揭重熙等，斬之。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: government troops took Shaowu, captured the former Ming Grand Secretary Jie Chongxi and others, and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, government troops took Shaowu, captured the former Ming Grand Secretary Jie Chongxi and others, and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免桐城等六縣荒賦。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: remitted wasteland tax assessments of six counties including Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, wasteland tax assessments in six counties including Tongcheng were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，免甘肅去年災賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiayin: remitted last year's disaster tax assessments in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the eleventh month, last year's disaster tax assessments in Gansu were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，吳三桂復府谷，斬故明經略高友才等，餘眾降。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Wu Sangui recovered Fugu, beheaded the former Ming grand coordinator Gao Youcai and others, and the remainder submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Wu Sangui recovered Fugu, beheaded the former Ming grand coordinator Gao Youcai and others, and the rest surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，攝政王多爾袞有疾，獵於邊外。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Prince Regent Dorgon was ill and hunted beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Prince Regent Dorgon, though ill, hunted beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，尚可喜復廣州，餘眾降。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Shang Kexi recovered Guangzhou; the remainder submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Shang Kexi recovered Guangzhou; the remainder surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，攝政和碩睿親王多爾袞薨於喀喇城。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi: Prince Regent of the First Rank of Rui Dorgon died at Khara city.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the twelfth month, Prince Regent Dorgon of Rui died at Khara.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，赴聞，上震悼，臣民為制服。

translations.literal: Day renchen: on receiving word, the Emperor was shaken with grief; officials and people wore mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, when word arrived, the emperor was stricken with grief and officials and people went into mourning.

sentences.zh: 丙申，喪至，上親奠於郊。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: when the coffin arrived, the Emperor personally offered libation in the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, when the coffin arrived, the emperor personally offered libation in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔曰：「太宗文皇帝升遐，諸王大臣籲戴攝政王。

translations.literal: Day jihai, an edict said: "When Literary Emperor Taizong ascended to the remote, the princes and great ministers urgently elevated the Prince Regent.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict said: "When Taizong the Literary Emperor passed away, the princes and great ministers urgently set the Prince Regent upon the regency.

sentences.zh: 王固懷為讓，扶立朕躬，平定中原，至德豐功，千古無二。

translations.literal: The Prince firmly cherished yielding, supported and raised Our person, pacified the Central Plain—supreme virtue and grand achievement, unmatched through the ages.
translations.idiomatic: He steadfastly refused the throne, raised me to the throne, and pacified the Central Plain—virtue and achievement without parallel in history.

sentences.zh: 不幸薨逝，朕心摧痛。

translations.literal: Alas, he has died; Our heart is shattered with grief.
translations.idiomatic: Alas, he is gone; my heart is shattered with grief.

sentences.zh: 中外喪儀，合依帝禮。

translations.literal: Mourning rites within and without the court shall altogether follow imperial rites.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning rites at court and throughout the realm shall altogether follow the rites due an emperor.

sentences.zh: 」庚子，收故攝政王信符，貯內庫。

translations.literal: " Day gengzi: collected the late Prince Regent's seals of office and stored them in the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the late regent's seals of office were collected and stored in the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，尊故攝政王為懋德修道廣業定功安民立政誠敬義皇帝，廟號成宗。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: honored the late Prince Regent as Emperor Maode Xiudao Guangye Dinggong Anmin Lizheng Chengjingyi, temple name Chengzong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the late regent was honored as Emperor Maode Xiudao Guangye Dinggong Anmin Lizheng Chengjingyi, with temple name Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，諭曰：「國家政務，悉以奏聞。

translations.literal: Day yisi, an edict said: "State affairs and government shall all be memorialized and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict said: "All state affairs shall be memorialized to me.

sentences.zh: 朕年尚幼，闇於賢否，尚書缺員，其會推賢能以進。

translations.literal: We are still young and dark as to who is worthy or not; where ministerial posts are vacant, let them jointly recommend the worthy and able for advancement.
translations.idiomatic: I am still young and cannot judge men's worth; where ministerial posts stand vacant, jointly recommend the worthy for appointment.

sentences.zh: 若諸細務，理政三王理之。

translations.literal: As for various minor affairs, let the three princes who govern affairs handle them.
translations.idiomatic: Minor affairs shall be handled by the three princes who govern affairs.
(End of edict.)

sentences.zh: 是年，喀爾喀、厄魯特、烏斯藏諸部巴郎和羅齊、達爾汗囊素、盆挫堅挫等來朝。

translations.literal: That year, the Khalkha, Oirat, and U-Tsang tribes—Balang Heluoqi, Dalhan Nangsu, Penchujianchuo, and others—came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys from the Khalkha, Oirat, and Tibetan tribes—including Balang Heluoqi, Dalhan Nangsu, and Penchujianchuo—came to court.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮，喀爾喀部碩雷汗、札薩克圖汗、土謝圖汗、綽克圖魏正諾顏、戴青諾顏、那穆齊魏正諾顏、察哈爾墨爾根台吉、索那穆，厄魯特部巴圖魯貝勒、台吉鄂齊爾圖、干布胡土克圖、噶木布胡土克圖、舒虎兒戴青，烏斯藏部闡化王，索倫、使鹿諸部，歸化城土默特部古祿格俱來貢。

translations.literal: Korea; the Khalkha Šure Khan, Jasaktu Khan, Tüsiyetü Khan, Choktu Weijin Noyan, Daiqing Noyan, Namuchi Weijin Noyan, Chakhar Mergen Taiji, Sonamu; the Oirat Baturu Beile, Taiji Ergitu, Ganbu Hutuktu, Gambu Hutuktu, Shuhu'er Daiqing; the U-Tsang Dharma-King; the Solon and Shilu tribes; and Güluke of the Guihuacheng Tumed—all came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea; Khalkha khans and nobles including Šure Khan, Jasaktu Khan, and Tüsiyetü Khan; Oirat Baturu Beile, Taiji Ergitu, and other nobles; the Tibetan Dharma-King; Solon and Shilu tribes; and Güluke of Guihuacheng Tumed—all presented tribute.
